text: The movie kicks off with Violet Gates getting attacked by her abusive husband, Blake. He beats her up badly, then gives her a gun and tells her to shoot him. Covered in blood and shaking, Violet screams and puts her finger on the trigger. Several years later, Blake has passed away and Violet has relocated to Chicago with her 5-year-old son, Toby. Influenced by her own traumatic experiences, she now works in a role that supports victims of abuse. Additionally, she has been communicating with Henry Campbell, a photographer employed by the mayor's office, through a dating app. The two have arranged to meet in person for their first date. Violet's younger sister, Jen, arrives at her home to babysit Toby while Violet prepares for her date. After assisting Violet in choosing an appropriate outfit, Jen reassures her that Henry will be nothing like Blake. Violet then leaves to meet Henry. Violet arrives at a high-rise restaurant named Palate. After receiving a message from Henry informing her that he will be late, she decides to order a drink at the bar. On her way, she accidentally bumps into a man named Connor before ordering a glass of wine served by the friendly bartender, Cara. Shortly after, a man named Richard approaches her mistakenly believing she is his blind date, Diane. Violet tells him she is not a blind date and the man apologizes. They then start talking when Diane eventually arrives. She appears visibly disappointed upon seeing Richard, a reaction Violet notices. After that, a man named Phil, the restaurant's piano player, approaches Violet and starts flirting with her. Cara informs him that Violet is on a date and she is waiting for someone to arrive. Phil then leaves from there. Shortly after Phil leaves, Violet begins receiving memes on her phone through an app called DG Drop. She ignores it, but it appears again where an unbalanced car is shown, which is pointing out you. She then looks around and sees Henry just arriving. After that, Violet and Henry sit down at their table and he gives her a hockey puck as a gift for her son, which she finds really sweet. Everything seems to be going fine until their waiter, Matt, shows up and attempts to impress them with his improvisational skills, which proves slightly excessive. After taking their drink orders, Violet continues receiving unusual notifications on her phone from an app prompting her to respond. She shows it to Henry and he suggests it is likely someone in the restaurant playing a prank until the sender, referred to as the dropper, uses Violet's name making the situation more alarming. Though she initially intends to ignore the messages, Violet is forced to respond after seeing, through her home security cameras, a masked intruder armed with a gun inside her house. The dropper then reveals that Violet's phone has been cloned so he can see everything she does. She panics and Henry asked what happened. She says nothing and the dropper warns her that if she tries to call 911 or warn Henry, the masked guy will kill Toby. Violet heads to the restroom and sees every part of her house is now controlled under the dropper. She gets out of the bathroom and goes to seek help from a group of prom girls, but the dropper is able to hear everything she says. She soon realizes that both the bathroom and the lamp at her table have been bugged. The dropper instructs her to retrieve the SD card from Henry's camera. She then takes out her watch and hides it in her bag pretending she has lost the watch so that Henry can leave the table and will go to find it. As he goes to find the watch, she searches his bag and finds a camera inside where discovers incriminating photographs involving the mayor and some money transaction documents. She discreetly takes the SD card before Henry returns. She excuses herself to the bathroom and the dropper demands that she destroy the card and she does. The dropper then directs her to look inside the paper towel dispenser where she finds a small vial of poison. The dropper orders her to put it in Henry's drink to kill him. When Violet refuses out loud, he hints that she's already killed someone before. She comes out of the bathroom and starts looking around the restaurant trying to figure out who the dropper could be. She runs into Connor again and questions him, but he says he's just waiting for his sister. She also sees Diane angrily walking out on Richard calling him a jerk and a loser. Violet heads back to her table with Henry and when she tries to switch to a different table away from the window, the dropper threatens her again saying Toby will get hurt if they move. While Matt is taking their orders, Violet notices Phil playing on the piano. She sees a chance and writes two hostages and her address on a $20 bill and gives it to Matt as a tip for Phil. Phil reads it and heads to the bar, but after that, he suddenly starts to pass out. His drink had been spiked. He manages to get up but only makes it to the lobby before dying. The dropper then contacts Violet warning her that her action was a mistake. She watches through her security cameras as the masked man attacks rendering her unconscious and proceeds to lock Henry inside his room. Violet continues to act as though she is dealing with problems involving Jen and Toby, which causes Henry to believe she is not truly interested in the date prompting him to consider leaving. However, since the dropper insists that she keep Henry there, Violet kisses him in an attempt to persuade him to stay. She then proposes that they take shots and heads to the bar to order tequila, but she forgets to bring her bag as a result Henry sees her watch. Cara, sensing that something is off, observes Violet closely. Though Violet tries to maintain her composure, upon returning to the table, Henry mentions that he saw her watch fall out of her purse. Violet apologizes for the deception and attempts to come up with an excuse. When Henry goes to the bar to grab some limes, Violet quickly slips the poison into his shot glass, but Henry starts getting suspicious when Cara says Violet didn't even ask for limes. Back at the table, Violet asks him why he messaged her even though she's a widowed single mom. Henry talks about what he likes about her and they both share stories about dealing with abusive partners. Just as Henry's about to take the shot, Violet spills wine on his shirt to stop him. As he gets up, the dropper texts her saying that wasn't a smart move. Violet then sees Connor again and thinks he might be the dropper and about go to confront him, but his sister shows up proving he's telling the truth. Cara comes over to Violet and quietly asks if she needs help getting away from Henry. Violet says Henry isn't the problem but asks about Connor's sister. Cara says she's a regular but usually sits at a different table, the one where Richard has been all night. She also says Diane probably left because Richard had been staring at Violet the whole time. Violet then goes to confront Richard and finds out he's the dropper. He admits to working with corrupt individuals connected to the mayor's office and confesses to poisoning Phil. Henry is seen as a rat for collecting evidence and Violet was manipulated into being the one to kill him. The plan was to frame her as a widowed killer who snapped using security footage of her poisoning the drink as evidence. A quick flashback shows that Violet didn't actually kill Blake. He grabbed the gun back and almost shot Toby, but when police sirens got close, he killed himself. Henry returns to the table and Violet, with no choice, gives him the tequila shot and he drinks it. After drinking it, Henry walks off. Richard feels like he's won and starts digging into his dessert. Violet tells him Blake used to eat that same dessert, panna cotta, during one of his fake apology dinners. She says she learned to spot the same patterns in guys like Blake. Then she drops the truth. She didn't poison Henry's shot at all. She poisoned Richard's dessert while he was busy watching Henry. When Richard realizes he's been drugged, he loses it and pulls a gun on Violet. He fires, but Henry jumps in and takes the bullet for her. Richard keeps shooting making everyone run in a panic. Cara steps in to help Violet but gets stabbed in the back. Violet grabs the hockey puck Henry gave her and while Richard orders the masked man to kill Jen and Toby, she throws the puck at the already damaged window. It shatters and the air pressure sucks Richard out to his death. Violet almost falls too, but Henry catches her. They call for help and Henry, who is in pain after being shot, gives her his car keys so she can drive home. She grabs the key and heads to home. Violet speeds through traffic trying to get home fast and calls Jen to informs her about the masked man presence in house. At home, the masked man finds Toby and almost shoots him, but Jen smashes glass over his head and takes Toby to hide. The masked man comes after them and grabs Toby, but Jen stabs him in the leg and hides with Toby. He breaks in anyway and he shoots Jen in the chest. Just then Violet arrives and he shoots Violet in the arm as she gets there. Toby manages to slip away and Violet starts fighting the guy. The masked man then pulls out the mask and reveals his face. Just when he's about to take her down, Toby uses his toy car to roll the gun over to her. Violet grabs it and shoots the masked man dead, then runs to check on Toby and Jen, who is alive. After that, the news report plays where Richard's murder plan gets exposed and it ends up getting the mayor and a bunch of his people arrested. Violet visits Henry in the hospital while he's recovering and brings him some food. Then she suddenly starts getting more drops on her phone, but it's just Jen messing with her from down the hall. Violet asks Henry if he'd be up for a boring second date and he says he'd love that more than anything. Thanks for watching. Like and subscribe for more interesting movie recaps.

रही थी क्योंकि अब रात को वहां का टेंपरेचर बहुत ज्यादा कम हो गया जिसकी वजह से उसे ठंड लगे लगती है तभी उसे आसमान में बादलों के गरजने की आवाज सुने देती है वो समझ जाता है की बारिश होने वाली है वो इस चीज को लेकर काफी खुश था की खाना ना सही आखिरकार मुझे पीने के लिए पानी तो मिलेगा पर बारिश के सिर्फ दो कर बूंदी पड़ती है और बादल वहां से चले जाते हैं जिसकी वजह से एल्बो बहुत ज्यादा निरसा हो जाता है वो सोचता है की शायद भगवान भी मेरे साथ नहीं है वह भी मुझे यहां से बचाना नहीं चाहती थोड़ी डर बाद एलोवेरा वहीं पर सो जाता है अगली सुबह जैसे एलोवेरा की आंखें खोल है तो उसको अपने फोन की रिंगटोंस सुने देती है जिसकी वजह से वो अपने फोन को हर तरफ ढूंढने लगता है पर उसे उसका फोन कहानी नहीं मिलता तभी उसे मिट्टी के नीचे कुछ वाइब्रेट होने का एहसास होता है उसका फोन वहीं पर था एल्वेरो को अपने फोन में उसके मॉम दादा दिखाई देते हैं जो उसको वीडियो कॉल कर रहे थे अलवर और रोटी हुए उनको अपने साथ हुए इस हादसे के बड़े में साड़ी बातें बताता है पर अल में यह सिर्फ एलवारो का ब्रह्म था उसके हाथों में कोई वो नहीं होता और ना ही उसकी मॉम दादा उसको कॉल कर रहे होते हैं एल्बेरॉय इस चीज को समझ जाता है लेकिन वो फिर भी इस ब्रह्म से बाहर निकालना नहीं चाहता क्योंकि ये ब्रह्म उसे नरक से तो कई गुना बेहतर है जिसमें एलोवेरा इस टाइम जी रहा है वो अपने मॉम दादा से अपने की गई साड़ी गलतियां की माफी मांगता है क्योंकि उसे अब तक ही पता चल चुका था की वो यहां से अब जिंदा नहीं बैक पाएगा लेकिन फिर भी एलोवेरा उसे ब्रह्म से बाहर ए जाता है अब एलोवेरा के अंदर से सर पानी खत्म हो चुका था जिसकी वजह से वो अब अपना यूरिन भी नहीं पी सकता था एलोवेरा पानी की अब एक-एक बूंद के लिए भी तरस रहा था वो किसी भी तरह से यहां से बस बाहर निकालना चाहता था लेकिन उसका शरीर अब इस चीज के लिए भी हर मां चुका था तभी उसे समुद्र के किनारे पर वही सर्फिंग बोर्ड दिखाई देता है जिसके पीछे वो पिछली बार गया था और जख्मी हो गया था और इस बार वो सर्फिंग बोर्ड लहरों की मदद से समुद्र के किनारे के काफी पास ए गया लेकिन उसे सर्फिंग बोर्ड के पास जाता है और सोचता है की अगर मैं सर्फिंग बोर्ड की मदद से समुद्र को पर करने की कोशिश करूं तो इस चीज की कोई गारंटी नहीं है की मैं पानी में डब कर ना मैरून लेकिन अगर मैं यहां पर रहा तो भी आज या फिर कल में मारा जाऊंगा यानी मेरी मौत तो ते है अब चाहे तो यहां पर आराम से रहकर हो या अपनी जान बचाने के लिए समुद्र को पर करते हुए लेकिन फिर भी एलोवेरा अपनी जान बचते हुए करने की सोचता है वो फौरन सर्फिंग बोर्ड को अपने हाथ में ले लेट है और पानी में उतार जाता है वो थोड़ी दूर तो पहुंच जाता है पर अब उसके शरीर की साड़ी एनर्जी खत्म हो चुकी थी जिसकी वजह से वो आगे नहीं टायर का रहा था वो अब पीछे भी नहीं जा सकता था वो अपने इस हालात को देखकर समझ जाता है की उसकी मौत पानी में डूबने की वजह से ही होगी जिसके थोड़ी डर बाद एलवरू पानी में डूबने लगता है इस समय उसका शरीर भी पुरी तरह से हर मां चुका था एल्वेरो को भी अब जीने की कोई खास नजर नहीं ए रही थी इसलिए वह भी अपने आप को बचाने की कोई कोशिश नहीं करता और समुद्र की गहराईयां में डूबने लगता है पर उसका बोर्ड अभी भी पानी के ऊपर ही टायर रहा था जिसको देखते हुए वहां पर एक रेस्क्यू टीम ए जाति है और फाइनली एल्वेरो को पानी में डूबकर करने से बच्चा लेती है जिसकी बात एलोवेरा को सीधा पास के अस्पताल में एडमिट किया जाता है जहां पर उसका बेस्ट फ्रेंड लोग और उसकी एक्स गर्लफ्रेंड और अभी उसके लिए वहां पर आते हैं रेस्क्यू टीम वाले बताते हैं की एलोवेरा उनको शहर से पूरे 1 किलोमीटर की दूरी पर मिला उनके हिसाब से एलोवेरा उसे जगह पर पूरे 48 घंटे से फंसा हुआ था जिसके बाद अब हमको मूवी के लास्ट सीन में हमें इस कहानी के असली हीरो एलोवेरा को दिखाए जाता है जिसकी सच्ची घटना पर यह फिल्म बनी है और इसी के साथ एल्वेरो की ये कहानी यही पर खत्म हो जाति है उम्मीद करते हैं की आपको एलोवेरा के इस सच्ची कहानी से कुछ सीखने को जरूर मिला होगा फिलहाल तो आज की वीडियो में बस इतना ही लेकिन हम फिर से जरूर मिलेगी और वो भी एक और नई इंटरेस्टिंग कहानी के साथ text: [Musika] Kamusta kayong lahat? Nandito na naman tayo sa Filipino Chill Cap at ngayon pag-uusapan natin ang buong The Lord of the Rings Film series ang mapapanood niyo mga Tagalog recap sa video na ito mga ka-chil mula The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, The Lord of the Rings, the Two Towers at The Lord of the Rings, the Return of the King. At bago tayo magpatuloy ay isa-shoutout muna natin si Cony Tagalog, Javin Alonso, Mang Kepsap, Gilcrest Calunia, Christopher Kissmundo from Malabon, Graphox Adventure from Quezon City, I am SuperJK from Manitoba, Canada. Junie Valdery from Lucena City, Mar John Barbasa from Bacolod City, Brian Lenox from Pangasinan. Ruben Diaz from Davao City, Ryan Bernard Arbo Lide from San Pedro City. Maghanda na kayo dahil sa mga spoilers na darating. [Musika] Nagsisimula ang pelikula sa isang pro logo na ikinukwento ang sinaunang alamat ng Ring of Power. Noong unang panahon, dalw makapangyarihang singsing ang nilikha. Tatlo para sa mga duwende. Ito para sa mga matitibay na duwende sa ilalim ng lupa. Siam para sa kaharian ng tao at isa ang pinakamakapangyarihan sa lahat na ginawa ng isang madilim at malupit na panginoon na si Sauran sa naglalagablab na apoy ng Mordor. Ang singsing na ito ay pinuno ng kanyang kasamaan at matinding pagnanais na kontrolin ang lahat ng ibang singsing. Isang makapangyarihang alyansa ng mga duwende at tao ang nagkaisa upang labanan ang kasamaan ni Sauran. Sa gitna ng madugong labanan habang si Sauran ay naghahasik ng lagim halos matalo na ang alyansa ng biglang naglakas loob si Isilder at pinutol ang kamay ni Sauron inagaw ang singsing at pinabagsak siya nagwagi ang alyansa ngunit sa halip na sirain ang singsing, Silver ay naakit sa kapangyarihan nito at itinago ito bilang isang pamana ang desisyong iyon ay naging sanhi ng kanyang pagkamatay. Ang singsing sa loob ng 2,5 taon ay nawala at nanatiling nakabaon sa ilalim ng ilog. Nakalimutan ng panahon hanggang sa muling magpakita ang tadhana. Sa kadiliman ng isang kweba, nadiskubre ito ng isang nilalang na si Golem. Nabighani siya sa kapangyarihan ng singsing at pinahaba nito ang kanyang buhay ng 5 taon habang unti-unting sinisira ang kanyang katinuan. Pero may ibang plano ang tadhana. Isang araw, dumulas ang singsing mula sa kanya at napunta sa isang inosenteng habot na si Bilbo Bagans. Bumukas ang eksena sa tahimik at payapang lugar ng mga habat. Ang she ilang taon na ang lumipas mula ng magsimula ang pakikipagsapalaran. Nakilala natin si Sam at si Bilbo Bagens na matanda na kasama ang kanyang binatang pinsan na si Frodo. Dumating si Gandolph na isang wizard upang makibahagi sa pagdiriwang ng ika at 11 kaarawan ni Bilbo. Masaya ang bati ang naganap at napansin ni Gandolf na tila hindi tumanda si Bilbo. Kinagabihan, nagkaroon ng malaking handaan. May fur eworks, sayawan at kasiyahan. Banigun ni Bilbo ang mga batang hub sa kanyang mga kwento ng pakikipagsapalaran. Sa kalagitnaan ng gabi, humarap si Bilbo sa lahat at nagpahayag ng kanyang desisyong tuluyan ng lumisan. Sa isang iglap, sinuot niya ang singsing at naglaho sa paningin ng lahat. Pagbalik niya sa kanyang tahanan, hinarap siya ni Gandolf at iginiit na iwan na ang singsing. Napuno ng tensyon ang silid habang si Bilbo. Kila iba ang pagkatao ay tinawag ang singsing na may precious. Matigas si Gandolf at pinaalala ang panganib na dala ng singsing. Sa huli, matapos ang emosyonal na sagutan, iniwan ni Bilbo ang singsing at tuluyang lumisan. Inukso si Gandolf na damputin ito pero pinigilan siya ng isang nakakakilabot na bisyon. Dumating si Frodo at nalaman niya na minana niya ang lahat mula kay Bilbo. Kasama na ang mahiwagang singsing. Napansin ni Gandolf ang panganib at agad na pinaalalahanan si Frodo na bantayang mabuti ang singsing bago siya umalis upang magsaliksik ng higit pa. Nakakita siya ng isang nakakabahalang palatandaan sa langit, isang gintong bagyo mula sa silangan. Sa isang iglap, pinakita ang Mordor at ang mga nilalang na tinatawag na ring rits na sumasakay sa itim na kabayo. Dumating si Gandolf sa isang sinaunang aklatan. Sinuyod ang mga lumang kasulatan at natuklasan na ang lihim ng singsing ay mahahayag sa pamamagitan ng apoy. Habang papalapit ang ring rate sa bahay nina. Frodo! Bumalik si Gandolf ng walang sinayang na oras. Pinahagis niya ang singsing sa apoy at unti-unting lumitaw ang mga insripsyong elvish sa ibabaw nito. Napagtanto ni Gandolf ang katotohanan. Ang singsing na ito ay ang mismong singsing ni Sauron. Pinaliwanag niya kay Frodo ang koneksyon ng singsing sa kanyang madikong pinagmulan. Ayon sa kanya, nahuli ni Sauran si Gullem at pinilit itong ikwento kung paano ito napunta kay Bilbo. Kaya naman upang mailigtas ang she kinakailangang ilayo ang singsing. Napagtanto ni Gandolf na hindi siya ang dapat humawak nito. Si Frodo ang kailangang maging tagapagdala ng singsing. Ngunit pinaalalahanan niya ito kapag sinuot ang singsing. Gagad itong makakaakit ng masasamang nilalang. Habang nag-uusap sila, nahuli nila si Sam na nakikinig sa usapan. Sa una, nagalit si Gandolf ngunit napagtanto niyang tapat si Sam at itinuring itong kasama ni Frodo sa nalalapit nilang paglalakbay. Habang naglalakad palayo sa sheer, banili na ni Gandolf si Frodo na huwag kailan man isusuot ang singsing maliban na lang kung gusto niyang matagpuan sila ng ring rates. Umalis si Gandolf at iniwan sina Frodo at Sam sa kanilang bagong paglalakbay. Habang papalayo sila sa Sheir, napansin nilang unti-unting nagiging kakaiba ang paligid. Ilang may nagmamasid sa kanila mula sa dilim. Samantala, si Gandolf ay mabilis na pumunta sa kuta ng dati niyang kapanaligaruman. Ikinwento niya ang tungkol sa singsing na natagpuan ni Bilbo, ngunit hindi ito ikinagulat ni Saruman. Alam na pala niya ang mga plano ni Sauran. Ayon sa kanya, hindi matatalo ang Mordor. Sinabi rin niya na ang mga ring rates ay nasa Sheer na at nag-aanyong mga nakabalot na sakay ng kabayo. Habang nagmamadaling umalis si Gandolf upang tulungan si Frodo, bigla siyang pinigilan ni Saruman. Isinara nito ang bawat labasan at tinukso si Gandolph na lumipat na sa panig ni Sauron. Tumanggi si Gandolf kaya't nagsimula ang matinding labanan sa pagitan ng dalawang wizard. Nagpalitan sila ng malalakas na palo ng kanilang mga baston hanggang sa tuluyang natalo si Gandolf at itinapon pa taas ila bilanggo sa tore. Balik sa grupo nina Frodo habang naglalakad sa malawak na bukirin. Kilala nila sina Mary at Tian. Kapwa makulat at bagong galing sa pagnanakaw ng pananim. Tumatakbo ang dalawa palayo sa isang galit na magsasaka. Nagkaysa silang apat at naglakbay ng magkakasama. Ngunit bigla silang nahulog sa burol at si Frodo ay nakaramdam ng kakaibang presensya. Isang masamang enerhiya na papalapit. Habang papalapit ang mga bulong ng ring rates, nagtago sila sa ilalim ng isang puno. Isa sa mga rat sakay ng kabayong kulay itim bumaba upang magsiyasat. Halos mapasuot na ni Frodo ang singsing dahil sa pang-akit nito. Pero pinigilan siya ni Sam. Ginamit ni Sam ang isang sanga upang lumikha ng ingay at linlanggan ang kalaban. Mula sa puntong ito, apat na na sila sa grupo. Habang naglalakbay sa masukal at madilim na gubat, palaging sinusundan ng rate gamit ang talino at pagiging maingat. Pilit nilang iniiwasan ang mga panganib hanggang sa nakita nila ang isang ilog at isang bangkang maaaring sakyan. Tumakbo silang lahat habang papalapit ang mga rate. Sa huli, Rifrodo ang huling tumalon sa bangka. At habang nakalayo sila, huminto ang Ring Rath at tinawag ang mas marami pa sa kaniyang mga kasama. Pagdating nila sa mataong bayan ng Break, pinapasok sila sa loob ng mga bantay at dinala sa praneng ponyin. Doon umaasa silang makipagkita kay Gandolph. Ngunit nang itanong nila sa tagapangasiwa ng in kung nasaan ang wizard, wala itong alam. Habang nagpapahinga sa gitna ng mga karaniwang bisita, tahimik nilang pinaplano ang susunod nilang hakbang. Ngunit may isang misteryosong lalaki ang lihim na nakamasid sa kanila mula sa dilim. Ayon sa tagapangasiwa ng inaw ay si Strider, isang delikadong tagapagtanggol at kilalang ranger. Nabunyag ang kanilang presensya ng isa sa mga habat dahil sa isang pagkakamali ay nabanggit ang pangalan ni Frodo ng malakas sa harap ng lahat. Sa pag-aakalang maayos ang sitwasyon, nadulas si Frodo at aksidenteng naisuot ang singsing. Bigla siyang nadala sa madilim na mundo ng paningin ni Saurant. Dahil dito, tunton ng mga ring rates ang eksaktong kinaroroonan niya. Sa gitna ng kaguluhan, agad na umaksyon si Strider at dinala si Frodo sa isang ligtas na kwarto. Doon, pinakilala niya ng maayos ang sarili at pinagsabihan ang mga habot sa kanilang kapabayaan. Pinaliwanag din niya ang papalapit na panganib. Makalipas ang ilang sandali, nilusob ng mga ring rates ang bayan at tahimik na pumasok sa in. Hindi nila alam na ang mga habet ay hindi pala natutulog sa kanilang kama. Sa halip, mga patibong lang ang nandoon. Dahil sa pagiging maagap ni Strider, ligtas ang mga habat. Kinabukasan, ipinaliwanag ni Strider ang pinagmulan ng mga ring wath. Dati silang makapangyarihang hari na naakit ng siyam na singsing. Ngunit dahil sa kasakiman, naging mga alipin sila ng kadiliman. Sa pagsikat ng araw, sinimulan ni Strider at ng mga habot ang kanilang paglalakbay patungong Rivendell santuaryo ng mga duwende. Umawid sila sa iba't ibang uri ng lupain at Sam ilong sa ilalim ng mga bituin sa gabi. Samantala, sa kadilimang bumabalot sa tore ng Eceng Guard, nakikipag-usap si Saran, sa anino ni Sauran. Inuutusan siya nito na gumawa ng isang hukbo na kayang tapatan ang takot at kapangyarihan ng Mordor. Habang si Gandolf ay nakakulong sa tuktok ng Ortang, nasasaksihan niya mula sa taas ang mga ginagawang sandata at baluti ng mga or doon isinilang ang isang bagong nilalang mula sa putik. Ang urok high mas malakas at mas mabagsik kaysa sa karaniwang or habang nagpapatuloy sa paglalakbay sina Strider at ang mga habet ay pansamantalang nagpahinga sa isang lumang bantay ang tore. Pagdating ng gabi, iniwan ni Strider ang grupo upang magmasid sa paligid. Binigyan niya ng mga almas ang mga habet bilang proteksyon. Ngunit sa kabila ng kanyang babala, nagsindi sila ng apoy. Ang liwanag ng apoy ay nagsilbing hudyat sa mga ring rat na malapit sila. Nang maramdaman ang kakaibang lamig, mabilis na umakyat ang mga habot sa tuktok ng tore. Dumating ang limangg. text: Havana, Cuba. An elderly musician named Andres Hernandez goes to the town plaza with his pet kinkajou named, Vivo. The two perform a song to an excited crowd, as they have known Andres for years and view him as a great musician. Vivo explains through song that Andres found him when he was little and alone after saving him from two big dogs. The two have spent the last few years together making music, and Vivo couldn’t be happier. Andres receives a letter from his old flame, Marta Sandoval, who is a famous singer and is performing her farewell shows, with her hoping that Andres will join her in Miami to perform together once again. Andres brings Vivo home and explains to him that he and Marta used to write music and play together, and he was deeply in love with her, but when she got her big break, he chose not to tell her for fear that she may miss out on her dreams because of him. He even wrote her a song to express his true feelings for her. When Andres tells Vivo that he is planning to make the trip, Vivo scurries out of the apartment in a huff because he doesn’t want anything to ruin what he has right now. However, after some reflection and realizing that Andres has always been there for him, Vivo decides to go back and help pack Andres’s suitcase. The next morning, Vivo is ready to go, but he sadly discovers that Andres passed away in his sleep. Soon, the other citizens in town learn of his death and mourn him in the town plaza. There, Andres’s niece Rosa goes to speak while her daughter Gabi, who knows who Vivo is and wants to keep him as a pet, but he refuses because he thinks Gabi is weird. When Vivo overhears Rosa telling Gabi that they are heading home to Florida, Vivo stows away in the luggage of Andres’s belongings and returns home with Gabi and Rosa so that he may personally deliver Andres’s song to Marta, who is in Miami. Upon arriving in Florida, Vivo tries to get out of the luggage but gets his tail caught in the zipper. Gabi finds him and is excited, thinking he stowed away for her, and she brings him to her room where she expresses how she is different from everyone else. However, she is still missing her late father Carlos. Rosa wants Gabi to put on a uniform and sell cookies with the Sand Dollars troop, but Gabi refuses. She then comes across Marta’s letter to Andres, and Vivo gives Gabi the song Andres wrote. Realizing what Vivo came to Miami for, Gabi agrees to help him deliver the song to Marta, and she promptly books a bus ticket for the trip. While heading to the bus, Gabi encounters the Sand Dollars – Becky, Eva, and Sarah. who are well-meaning but overzealous in their efforts to get Gabi to join them. She shows them Vivo, whom Eva and Sarah start cooing over, but Becky points out that a kinkajou needs to be vaccinated and kept safe. Gabi sees the bus leaving and she gets on her bike to chase after it but ends up falling through a rising bridge and onto a boat with sand. The Sand Dollars vow to get Vivo to safety, while Rosa finds the website for bus tickets and realizes what Gabi is up to. Gabi makes a small boat to sail on as they get off the larger boat. They end up sailing into the Everglades and try to navigate through an increasingly dangerous storm. The song flies away from Vivo, so Gabi goes after it, causing her and Vivo to get separated. Vivo wanders through the forest and comes across a bird named Dancarino, who is despondent that the other birds have successfully found partner while he is alone. Vivo agrees to help him,if he helps Vivo find Gabi. Dancarino succeeds and has found his partner, but he flies away with Valentina and leaves Vivo behind as he comes across a large python named Lutador. He attempts to eat Vivo but the kinkajou scurries through the trees and leaps high until Dancarino catches him and fulfills his end of the deal. For Vivo Gabi is found by the Sand Dollars, and Becky pulls out the song that she knows Gabi is looking for. She promises to give it back on the condition that Gabi gives up Vivo so they can quarantine him. Gabi reluctantly agrees. As they make their way on the Sand Dollars boat through the swamp, Lutador comes across them and tries to attack. Gabi manages to keep the girls safe by hiding under a cage, but Lutador begins to squeeze it and nearly breaks through until Vivo swoops down on Dancarino and lures Lutador to get himself knotted up in a tree. Their victory is short-lived when the girls find that the song fell into the water and is now destroyed. The Sand Dollars are remorseful and begin to take Vivo and Gabi back home. On the ride back, Gabi begins to sing the lyrics to the song to herself, but Vivo says that she is out of sync with the melody. He plays the tune on his recorder, and both he and Gabi realize that they can rewrite the song since she remembers the lyrics and he knows the melody. The group then resolves to make it to Miami to finish the job. Meanwhile, Marta has been waiting to hear from Andres all day before her performance, but her assistant brings her a newspaper reporting Andres’s death, and Marta is devastated. The girls make it to Miami, and Vivo and Gabi ride off on a bike to the Mambo Cabana to make it to the show on time. When they arrive, Rosa shows up as well and goes after Gabi. They are chased by security until they make it close to Marta’s dressing room, but only Vivo can make it through. Gabi says farewell to him and gives him the song. Vivo finds Marta, who recognizes him from the picture in the paper with Andres. He hands her the song, and Marta realizes that Andres was in love with her. She sees a photo of him and says “I love you too Andres”. Her spirits are now lifted and she gets ready to perform her last concert. Rosa is driving Gabi home and scolding her for running off as she did. In the argument, Rosa acknowledges that she is not as great as Carlos was but that she is doing her best. Vivo shows up, surprising Rosa since she thought he was still in Cuba, and she realizes Gabi was telling the truth about their mission. Gabi breaks down as she tells Rosa that she just wanted Marta to know that Andres loved her since she never got to tell Carlos that she loved him before he died. Rosa says that her father knew he always loved her, and she goes to hug Gabi and Vivo. She then turns the car around and they catch the end of Marta’s show where she performs Andres’s song. Vivo returns home with Gabi and now goes with her to the town plaza to perform, joined by the Sand Dollars, Rosa, and even Marta. The crowd adores them, and Vivo has found his new family.

text: Have you ever wondered what would happen if a father who can't even handle breakfast suddenly had to run an entire household by himself? What if the person who always believed parenting was easy discovered that he had absolutely no idea what he was doing? Well, that's exactly what happens in The Breadwinner. And trust me, what starts as a simple family comedy slowly turns into a hilarious disaster where everything that can go wrong does go wrong. From destroyed homes to family secrets to a horse that absolutely should never have been brought into the suburbs, this father is about to learn the hardest lesson of his life. And by the end, he'll realize that earning money for a family is sometimes the easiest job in the house. So, grab your snacks, sit back, and let's dive into the story. The movie begins by introducing us to Nate Wilcox. On the surface, Nate seems to have everything figured out. He has a stable job, a nice house, three daughters, and a wife who appears to have mastered every aspect of family life. Nate works as a successful car salesman. In fact, he's so good at his job that he's one of the dealership's top performers. Every day, he leaves for work believing he's carrying the weight of the family on his shoulders. After all, he's the breadwinner. He's the one bringing home the paycheck. But there's something Nate completely fails to notice. While he's spending his days selling cars, his wife Katie is doing everything else. And when we say everything, we mean everything. Katie cooks, Katie cleans, Katie manages schedules, Katie handles school activities, Katie solves family problems, Katie keeps three daughters organized. And somehow, she manages to do all of that without receiving much recognition. To Nate, life feels perfectly balanced. He works, Katie handles the rest. Simple. At least that's what he believes. But Katie has been working on something nobody expected. In her spare time, she's created an invention. It's a simple but clever organizational tool designed to help children complete daily tasks. Another has personal problems. The youngest seems determined to create chaos wherever she goes. And suddenly Nate discovers something shocking. Parenting isn't one job, it's a hundred jobs happening at the same time. But instead of admitting he's overwhelmed, Nate does what many people do when they're afraid of looking incompetent. He pretends everything is under control, even when it clearly isn't. And that decision will create far bigger problems than he realizes. Because while Katie is building a business on the other side of the world, back at home, Nate's carefully constructed image of being a capable father is about to fall apart one mistake at a time. And what happens next, nobody sees coming. Because Nate isn't just struggling to run the household, he's about to start making decisions that will turn a manageable situation into complete and total chaos. And believe me, the arrival of a horse is only the beginning. To find out how Nate's simple parenting experiment turns into one of the biggest disasters of his life, at first Nate believes he can handle everything. After all, how hard can parenting really be? But within days, his confidence completely disappears. The house becomes a mess. Laundry piles up everywhere. Pizza becomes the family's primary food source. And every problem seems to create two new ones. Meanwhile, Katie is thriving. Her Shark Tank deal is moving forward, and her business is growing faster than she ever imagined. Wanting her to focus on her dream, Nate starts hiding the truth. Every time Katie calls, he lies. He tells her everything is under control. But But reality, the family is barely surviving. Things become even more complicated with the daughters. His oldest daughter starts showing interest in boys. His middle daughter is preparing for an important spelling bee. And his youngest daughter develops a strange habit of hugging and kissing classmates. Instead of having a serious conversation with her, Nate comes up with a ridiculous solution. He buys her a horse, a real horse, while living in the suburbs. As expected, this decision creates even more chaos. And if things weren't bad enough, Nate also has workplace problems waiting for him. His rival co-worker is slowly taking his place at the dealership. For the first time, Nate begins feeling like he's losing control of everything. But what happens next changes everything. Because the lies he's been telling are about to catch up with him. And the damage is far worse than he realizes. >> As the days pass, Nate's situation becomes impossible to hide. The horse creates disaster after disaster. Household repairs spiral out of control. And a well-meaning contractor named Keegan only makes things more chaotic. Soon, parts of the house are literally being destroyed. At the same time, Nate continues disappointing the people closest to him. He misses important moments. He makes promises he can't keep. And he keeps choosing shortcuts instead of responsibility. The biggest blow comes when he fails to properly support his middle daughter's spelling bee competition. By now, his daughters are frustrated. His co-workers don't take him seriously. And the perfect image he tried so hard to maintain is collapsing. Then the truth finally comes out. Katie learns that Nate hasn't been honest. The house is a disaster. The family is struggling. And all the problems he claimed to have solved have actually become worse. For the first time, Nate is forced to face reality. This was never about cooking meals or washing clothes. It was about respect. For years, he underestimated everything Katie did. Now, he finally understands how difficult her job really was. But, can he fix the damage before it's too late? The answer comes in the movie's emotional final act. As the story reaches its conclusion, Nate stops making excuses. Instead of hiding behind lies, he finally accepts responsibility. He apologizes to Katie. He apologizes to his daughters. And most importantly, he admits that he was wrong. For years, he believed earning money made him the most important part of the family. But, now he understands something much bigger. A family isn't held together by paychecks alone. It's held together by time, effort, patience, and love. Katie's business continues moving forward. Proving that her dreams matter just as much as anyone else's. Meanwhile, Nate becomes a more involved husband and father. Not because he's perfect. But, because he's finally paying attention. In the end, The Breadwinner isn't really about Shark Tank, business deals, or even role reversal. It's about learning to appreciate the people whose hard work often goes unnoticed. It's about recognizing that parenting is a full-time job. And it's about understanding that love isn't just something you feel. It's something you actively show every day. And with that lesson learned, the Wilcox family finds a new balance. One built on teamwork instead of assumptions. That's the story of The Breadwinner 2026. If you enjoyed this movie recap, don't forget to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and let us know in the comments. Do you think Nate deserved a second chance, or should Katie have been much harder on him? Thanks for watching, and we'll see you in the next movie explanation.

Stark supports it, Rogers does not. That leads to Civil War with some heroes on either side of the conflict. Stark gives Peter a high-tech suit and battle ensues. As the Civil War escalates, Stark brings Peter home and tells him he can keep the new suit and promises to be in touch when Spider-Man is needed again. Finally, he leaves him with a few words of advice. >> Don't do anything I would do, and definitely don't do anything I wouldn't do. There's a There's a little gray area in there, and that's where you operate. >> Well, does that mean that I'm an Avenger? >> No. >> After all the excitement, it's back to normal life. Peter's best friend Ned, his crush Liz, and his other friend who might kind of like Peter but won't admit it yet, Michelle. Normal life is okay and all, but Peter misses feeling important and is eager for his next Spider mission, another chance to prove to Stark he's ready for the Avengers. He gets a chance when he notices alien weapons on the streets of New York. Four years ago, the Avengers stopped an alien invasion, but a lot of their tech stayed behind. Adrian Toomes and his salvage company were hired to clean up the mess, but they were fired when Stark partnered with the federal government to form the Department of Damage Control, and they handled the clean up instead. Rather than deprive his employees of sorely needed paychecks, Toomes entered a new business, hoarding the alien equipment to build high-tech weapons and sell them on the black market. Peter tries to stop Toomes, difficult considering he's used some of that tech to build himself a vulture-like suit. Though Peter gets some help when he accidentally reveals his identity to Ned, and he becomes Spider-Man's guy in the chair. The one who helps with intel and strategy without actually putting himself in harm's way. When Peter nearly gets himself killed fighting the Vulture, Stark admonishes him, tells him to stand down, and Peter doesn't. He and Ned nearly blow up the Washington Monument on an academic decathlon trip when Ned brings an alien battery through an x-ray machine, which becomes a chance for Spider-Man to save the day, including Liz. Worse than that, Peter finds out Toomes' next weapons deal will be on the Staten Island Ferry. Peter's meddling leads to a fight, which leads to the ferry nearly torn in half. Peter almost gets himself torn in half holding it together until Iron Man steps in. Personally, this time Peter went too far. Stark knew about the weapons deal. This whole thing was a sting operation with the FBI, and Peter ruined it. Stark told him to stand down, and he didn't listen. Clearly, he can't handle the responsibility. Stark demands back the suit. No more Spider-Man. Now, he's just Peter Parker. On the bright side, that means he can stop disappointing his friends, stop disappearing to play hero. It means he can ask Liz to the homecoming dance. The night of the dance, he arrives at Liz's house and meets her dad, Adrian Toomes. The villain quickly recognizes Peter's voice. Turns out Spider-Man is just a kid, someone Adrian can intimidate. He tells Peter to stay out of his business or die along with everyone he loves. So, it's back to disappointing his friends. Peter ditches Liz and the dance to play hero again with Ned as his guy in the chair. They quickly figure out Toomes' next move. Stark's once driver, then head of security, now head of asset management, Happy Hogan, is overseeing a shipment tonight of weapons and tech from Stark Tower to the new Avengers facility upstate. That is Vulture's target. Peter tries to stop him and ends up buried under rubble. Except, even if Stark took away the suit, Peter realizes he is still Spider-Man. He lifts that rubble and stops the Vulture after all. Once Vulture is arrested, Liz's mom decides to move with her to Oregon, meaning that the decathlon team needs a new captain, Michelle. Though, she reminds them her preferred name, MJ. Happy takes Peter upstate where Tony welcomes him to the Avengers. Except, Peter isn't sure he's ready for that. For now, he'll stay the friendly neighborhood Spider-Man. Though, Tony does give him his suit back. Also, he accidentally reveals his secret identity to Aunt May. >> What the >> Two years later, the mad Titan Thanos attempts to retrieve all six Infinity Stones so he can snap his fingers to extinguish half of all life in the universe. His insane answer to the fears of overpopulation and limited resources. Peter joins Stark in a galaxy-hopping adventure to stop the villain, and they fail. Thanos gets the stones and snaps his fingers. Half of all life vanishes, including Peter's. >> I don't want to go. I don't want to go, sir. Please. Please, I don't want to go. I don't want to go. Stark. After that, Thanos atomizes the stones so his work cannot be undone. And for that, Thor beheads him. It would seem now all hope is lost, except time travel. Five years after the snap, the Avengers hatch an insane plan to save the world, a time heist. They cannot change the past, but they can visit it in an alternate timeline. They can borrow stones from that alternate timeline and use them in their own reality to bring back all those who were lost in the snap. It works. Everyone comes back, including Spider-Man. Except a problem, Thanos from that alternate timeline comes to this one to finish the work of his dead predecessor. The heroes band together to stop him, but only do so with great sacrifice. They already lost Natasha Romanoff to get the soul stone. Now, they lose Tony Stark, too. Humans cannot handle the power of the stones. That's why Hulk wielded them to reverse the snap. But in this final battle, it's Stark who gets a hold of them. And with no time to waste, he snaps. He erases Thanos and his army at the cost of his own life. Peter goes to the funeral and he mourns. But at least his best friend is there for him when he returns home. Eight months later, Peter still grieves, but tries his best to move forward. His class trip to Europe should help. It's an important one. That's when Peter plans on confessing his newfound crush to MJ. He suspects she feels the same way about him. He often catches her looking at him. But Peter is still Spider-Man and duty often calls at the worst possible times. The trip is interrupted by a giant water monster. Thankfully, another hero is there to save the day. Someone the kids nickname Mysterio. Nick Fury fills Peter in. Mysterio is actually a man named Quentin Beck from another world in the multiverse. His Earth was destroyed by elemental beings like that water monster. Now he's here to save this world. Fury also gives Peter a gift that was left to him by Tony, a special pair of sunglasses providing Peter with access to the entire Stark global security network. Something that comes in handy when Brad takes an embarrassing photo of Peter. Peter asks the glasses AI EITH to delete that photo, but accidentally orders a drone strike on Brad and nearly gets him killed. When Fury admonishes him for that, Peter gets the idea that maybe he isn't responsible enough for that kind of power. When the fire elemental attacks and Mysterio stops it, Peter gets the idea that maybe Quentin Beck is responsible enough for that kind of power. So he transfers ownership of EITH to him, which turns out to be a grave error. Beck is not actually a hero from another world. In truth, he's a master illusionist with an axe to grind against Tony Stark who fired him for being unstable. The elemental attacks were all realistic holograms using Beck's technology. And now, with Stark's global system of drones, he can make the holograms more real and dangerous. His plan, stage another major elemental attack, then save the day as Mysterio to look like a hero and win the world's accolades. Though Peter is blissfully unaware of all that and returns to the hotel to enjoy his night. First, he prepares to confess his feelings for MJ. Except first, she confesses that she knows he's Spider-Man. Wait, is that why she's always looking at him? Guess she doesn't like him after all. Also, during the fire elemental attack, she found this weird device which turns out to be a holographic projector. That's when Peter realizes Mysterio is a bad guy and the elementals were all fake. When Beck realizes one of his projectors is missing, he worries the truth will get out. Anyone who knows must be eliminated. So, he uses those holograms to make Spider-Man believe he's talking to Fury. Fake Fury asks who else knows about the holograms and Spider-Man admits that his friends do, MJ and Ned. Another grave mistake he realizes too late. Spider-Man just gave his enemy a hit list. Peter freaks out until Happy gives him a talk about how Stark second-guessed everything he ever did, except one thing, his belief in Peter Parker. Mysterio begins the attack to make himself look like a hero. Holograms make it look real. Stark attack drones make it dangerous. But, this time Peter sees through the hallucinations by listening to his Peter tingle or spider-sense. He's able to stop it all, but in the chaos and Beck's blind obsession, he shoots too many bullets in close quarters and gets himself killed by a stray bullet. Afterward, Peter and MJ find each other and finally confess their true feelings for each other and they officially start dating. A happy ending, except Mysterio had a contingency planned, a message left behind in case he dies, a video edited so it looks like Spider-Man killed Mysterio and a tip for J. Jonah Jameson at dailybugle.net revealing Spider-Man's true identity. Jameson puts it out there for the world to know that Peter Parker is Spider-Man. >> What the f- >> The revelation upends Peter's life. The FBI suspects him of murder, but worse than that, his friends pay the price. Happy is wanted for holding on to some Stark tech after much of it was confiscated due to the involvement of Stark drones in Mysterio's attack. MJ and Ned are rejected from every college they applied to, thanks to their association with a vigilante, and Peter has a crazy idea. He asks Doctor Strange if he can use the time stone to change the past, make it so his identity was never revealed. No, he can't do that, but he could cast a spell to make the world forget who he is. But, as Strange casts that spell, Peter realizes he doesn't want everyone to forget, certainly not MJ or Ned or Aunt May. Making too many modifications mid-casting causes the spell to grow unstable. Thankfully, Strange is able to contain it. Except, apparently not fast enough. Before they shut it down, the unstable spell opened some rifts to other worlds. Where they hoped to erase anyone's knowledge that Peter is Spider-Man, the spell instead brought from other worlds anyone who knew Peter is Spider-Man. That includes Doctor Otto Octavius, Norman Osborn or the Green Goblin, Flint Marko or Sandman, Doctor Connors aka the Lizard, and Max Dillon aka Electro. Also Venom. They quickly capture the villains and prepare to send them home until they realize that would mean condemning some to death. Otto and Norman both died in the worlds they came from. Apparently, the spell pulled them here just before that happened. So, should they be sent back to their deaths or should this be a second chance, an opportunity to reform? May convinces Peter the right thing to do is help them. Strange disagrees. They cannot meddle with time in the multiverse like that. So, Peter steals the doctor's magic ring, traps him in the mirror dimension, then gets to work helping the villains. First, Peter works with Norman, a good man when his Goblin side isn't awake, and they build a device to put Auto back in control instead of his arms. Before they can help Electro, that Goblin side wakes up, and the Goblin hurts Aunt May. Bad enough, she only lives long enough to tell Peter one more thing, that Peter did the right thing trying to help these people. Peter has a gift, he has power, and with great power, there must also come great responsibility. She dies as cops surround the place. Happy parks between them and Peter. He gives himself up for arrest and tells Peter to run. Once Peter takes a bullet in the arm, he listens. But, where does he run to? Ned and MJ can't get a hold of him, so they get a crazy idea, Doctor Strange's ring, the one Peter stole. Ned tries using it to open a portal to Peter, and it works, but it brings them a different Peter Parker. Like the villains, he was brought to this world from another one, so they try again and find yet another older Peter Parker. These Peters from other worlds suggest that their Peter might be doing what they've often done when they need a time out. Both Peters have a place they go to get away from everything. MJ realizes that for her Peter, that'd be the school rooftop. They find him there, and the other Peters offer their experience. Both have suffered losses and become rageful or sought revenge, but it never helped. When this world's Peter tells them what May said about power and responsibility, it resonates. The older Peter assures him that his Aunt May did not die for nothing, having taught him this powerful lesson. With their help, Peter does not give in to rage. Instead, they work on cures for all these villains, something to turn Sandman back into Flint Marko, Lizard into Dr. Curt Connors, Electro into Max Dillon, and the Green Goblin back into Norman Osborn. And it works. The villains are all cured. Except some bad news. Before they cured the Goblin, he destroyed the box holding the unstable spell. Now, it's wreaking havoc. Tears are opening in the fabric of reality. Soon every being in the multiverse who knows Peter's identity will pour in. Dr. Strange has returned from the mirror dimension, but even he cannot stop them. Peter has an idea. They're coming because of him, because he is Peter Parker. What if Strange cast a spell to make everyone forget Peter Parker? And that works, too. The visitors return home, and the day is saved. Except now, Peter is entirely and utterly alone. Ned and MJ no longer remember Spider-Man's identity, and they've never met or heard of a Peter Parker. But that's okay. Peter still knows the truth, that he is still the friendly neighborhood Spider-Man. But a brand new day is just around the corner, and now you're ready for it. Well, technically a couple more things. Also, the spell kind of glitches and sent Adrian Toomes, aka the Vulture, to Venom's world, and he proposes an alliance with Morbius. But uh let's just say Dr. Strange cast a spell, and would you look at that? Sony and Marvel forgot all about these loose ends. Okay, now you're ready for Brand New Day.

text: [Music] The Shrouds is a haunting, cerebral, and darkly funny meditation on grief, technology, and the secrets we bury, sometimes literally. Directed by David Croninberg, the film follows KH, a lonely businessman still reeling from the death of his beloved wife, Becca. For years after her passing from cancer, KH has poured his pain and obsession into inventing Graveete, a revolutionary tombstone system that lets the living watch alive interactive 3D feed of their loved ones decomposing bodies. The technology uses a special shroud that wraps the corpse and broadcasts a real-time image to a screen on the grave and even to a phone app. Ka's plan is to be buried beside Becca, forever united in death and in data. But as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the line between love, loss, and madness is as thin as the shroud itself. The movie opens with KH at the dentist, where he's told that grief is rotting your teeth. This sets the tone for the film's blend of the clinical and the emotional, the physical, and the psychological. Kar is a man haunted by loss, unable to move on or find new love. He spends his days running his restaurant, which is inside the cemetery, managing graveete, and maintaining a close but complicated friendship with Becca's identical twin sister, Terry. Their relationship is full of unresolved tension, shared memories, and a mutual inability to let go of the past. Ka's invention, Grave Tech, is both a technological marvel and a source of controversy. Some see it as a way to stay connected to the dead, while others find it morbid and invasive. The cemetery is filled with high-tech headstones, each with a screen showing the body beneath, wrapped in Kara's special shroud. The system is encrypted and supposedly secure thanks to code written by Terry's ex-husband my a paranoid eccentric tech genius who also created Honey, a virtual assistant for KH modeled after Becca. Ksha's grief is compounded by recurring dreams and hallucinations of Becca, who returns to him in increasingly disturbing forms, sometimes whole, sometimes mutilated, always slipping further away. He's also plagued by the knowledge that Becca's ex-lover and former doctor, Jerry Eckler, was the one who treated her cancer. Karia's jealousy and insecurity simmer beneath the surface, especially as he learns more about Becca's past and the secrets she kept. The plot thickens when several tombstones in the grave tech cemetery, including Becca's, are destroyed in a mysterious act of vandalism. At the same time, the Graveete Tech network is hacked and encrypted, leaving KH and the other families unable to access the shroud feeds. My investigates and traces the hack to Iceland, one of the countries where KH hopes to expand his business. But as the investigation deepens, it becomes clear that the situation is far more complicated than a simple cyber attack. Mory, whose mental health is deteriorating, becomes obsessed with the idea that the hack is part of a larger conspiracy involving Chinese investors in Grave Tech, Russian hackers, and even the CCP. He notices strange artificial looking protrusions on Becca's bones in the Shroud images. Growths that KH initially believes are the result of her cancer. Mory's paranoia grows as he discovers that the destroyed tombstones had their data lines tapped, suggesting that someone was after specific information. Meanwhile, KH is approached by Sumin, the blind wife of a powerful CEO who wants to sponsor a grave tech cemetery in Budapest. Sumin is mysterious, seductive, and deeply interested in Ka's work. Their relationship quickly turns physical, providing KH with a brief respit from his grief and loneliness. But Sumin also brings warnings. She tells Kh that Honey's code is unstable and that the AI may not be as trustworthy as he thinks. As Kara's relationships with Terry and Sumin become more entangled, the lines between love, lust, and obsession blur. Terry, aroused by Kara's stories of sex with Sumin and his growing fascination with the grave tech conspiracy, initiates a sexual relationship with him. Their encounters are charged with jealousy, grief, and a shared sense of being haunted by Becca's memory. At the same time, Honey, the AI assistant, begins to take on Becca's naked, amputated form, taunting KH about his inadequacy compared to Eckler and blurring the boundaries between the virtual and the real. The mystery deepens as my uncovers more evidence that the hack did not originate in Iceland after all. He becomes convinced that the Chinese investors in Graveete, who helped design and manufacture the shrouds, are involved in a plot to use the technology for surveillance and espionage. Mory's paranoia reaches a fever pitch when he claims to have been tortured by Chinese agents who believed he was a Russian mole. He shows K the bloody remains of his hand, claiming to have lost two fingers during the ordeal. Terry later reveals that my actually lost the fingers in high school, suggesting that his story may be another product of his delusions. As the network is restored in the tombstones are repaired, a doctor examines the protrusions on Becca's bones and confirms that they are artificial implanted after her death, not the result of cancer. This revelation shakes KH to his core, forcing him to confront the possibility that Becca was the subject of unethical experiments, possibly orchestrated by Eckler and the Chinese company behind the shrouds. The film's climax arrives when Kh discovers that Eckller's murdered body has been buried in the spot next to Becca Kha's own reserved grave. Terry, ever the provocator, theorizes about how Eckler ended up there, suggesting everything from a hitman hired by K to a revenge plot by Eckllar's ex-wife. The ambiguity is never fully resolved, leaving K and the audience to wonder whether he is the victim of a vast conspiracy or simply the architect of his own misery. In a moment of dark catharsis, KH pretends that he hired a hitman to kill and bury Eckler, a fantasy that arouses Terry and cementss their twisted bond. Believing that Becca now has someone to keep her company in death, KH relinquishes his claim to the grave and decides to leave with Sumin for Budapest, where he plans to start a new. As they board a private jet, Sumin suddenly appears to K with identical scars to Becca and speaking in Becca's voice, offers to be buried with him in Budapest. Kh, finally ready to let go of the past, accepts her offer, embracing the possibility of a new life and a new death together. The ending of The Shrouds is as ambiguous and unsettling as the rest of the film. Kara's journey is one of obsession, grief, and the search for meaning in the face of loss. The film raises profound questions about the nature of memory, the ethics of technology, and the ways in which we try to hold on to the dead. Is grave techch a tool for healing or a symptom of Ksha's inability to move on? Are the conspiracies real or the product of damaged minds? And in the end, can love survive death, or does it inevitably become something darker and stranger? The Shrouds is a film that lingers long after the credits role, inviting viewers to ponder its mysteries and draw their own conclusions. It's a story about the things we can't let go of, the secrets we keep, and the ways in which technology both connects and isolates us. With its blend of psychological drama, dark humor, and Croninburggian body horror, The Shrouds is a unique and unforgettable exploration of what it means to grieve, to love, and to be Human.

text: Reagan wins reelection in 1984, defeating Democratic presidential nominee Walter Mondale (John Gibson Miller). By the time of Reagan’s second term, Leonid Brezhnev’s successors had died in office, frustrating Reagan (“How can I negotiate with them if they keep dying on me?!”), making diplomacy difficult. This is a biopic based on Paul Kengor’s book The Crusader: Ronald Reagan and the Fall of Communism. In 1981, U.S. President Ronald Reagan (Dennis Quaid) delivers a speech before the AFL-CIO’s Building and Construction Trades at the Washington Hilton and is shot and wounded as he departs, even as initial T.V. reports state he escaped unscathed. In present-day Moscow, Russian agent Andrei Novikov (Alex Sparrow) arrives at the home of former KGB agent Viktor Petrovich (Jon Voight) and questions why the Soviet Union fell. Petrovich, who was assigned to surveil Reagan, discusses the Soviet Union’s past ambitions to infiltrate Washington, D.C., and Hollywood. Petrovich details Reagan’s childhood in northern Illinois. Reagan’s father Jack (Justin Chatwin) was an alcoholic, but his mother Nelle (Amanda Righetti) instills Reagan with Christian values. Reagan becomes a born again Christian baptized by Rev. Cleaver (Kevin Sorbo) and works as a lifeguard and radio announcer. He moved to Hollywood, where he became an actor for Warner Bros. After World War II, Reagan’s status as a leading man was in decline, and he was elected president of the Screen Actors Guild in 1947. During the Hollywood blacklist era, Reagan becomes an FBI informant and feuded with Herbert Sorrell (Mark Kubr), a union organizer. Reagan’s marriage to actress Jane Wyman (Meena Suvari) ends in divorce due to his political involvement and the premature death of their daughter Christine. In 1949, Reagan met actress Nancy Davis (Penelope Ann Miller) and had her name removed from the blacklist after she was mistaken with another Nancy Davis. They are married in 1952. Reagan turns to television, appearing in commercials and hosting the General Electric Theater program. In 1964, Reagan campaigns for Republican presidential nominee Barry Goldwater, and delivers his “A Time for Choosing” speech. Reagan discusses his political future, and decides to run for governor of California in 1966. In 1969, Governor Reagan clashes with student radicals at the University of California, Berkeley, and has the state National Guard sent in to quell the protests. In 1970, the Reagans hold prayers with Pat Boone (Chris Massoglia) and pastor George K. Otis (Pat Boone!), who prophesies Reagan will become president if he “walks uprightly” before God. Six years later, Reagan challenges incumbent President Gerald Ford (who appears on file footage) for the Republican nomination at the Republican National Convention but loses in the delegate count. Ford loses to Democrat Jimmy Carter (also appearing on file footage), and Reagan runs again for president in 1980. He beats Carter and forms a friendship with Tip O’Neill (Dan Lauria), the Democratic Speaker of the House. The movie returns to 1981. As President Reagan recovers from his attempted assassination, he is visited by O’Neill in his hospital bed. Back in the White House, Reagan clashes with David Stockman, the White House budget director, over his tax cut proposal. When Reagan learns that air traffic controllers are on strike, he fires the air traffic controllers who do not return to work within 48 hours. Reagan selects George Shultz (Xander Berkeley) as his Secretary of State to handle diplomacy with the Soviet Union. Back in the present day, Petrovich explains how Reagan became obsessed with Communism, going all the way back to a talk by a Russian refugee at his home church. This undercurrent continued through the Hollywood union disputes and the many, many books he reads about the party. This is why Petrovich had nicknamed him “The Crusader,” a term he uses throughout when mentioning Reagan to Novikov. Despite Shultz’s involvement, in 1983, Reagan labels the Soviet Union as an evil empire. Tensions between the U.S. and the Soviet Union escalate when Soviet interceptor planes shoot down a Korean Air passenger plane with a U.S. congressman onboard. Meanwhile, there are nationwide protests against Reagan’s handling of the AIDS crisis. Reagan wins reelection in 1984, defeating Democratic presidential nominee Walter Mondale (John Gibson Miller). By the time of Reagan’s second term, Leonid Brezhnev’s successors had died in office, frustrating Reagan (“How can I negotiate with them if they keep dying on me?!”), making diplomacy difficult. Reagan meets with U.K. Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher (Lesley-Ann Down), who persuades him to meet with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev (Olek Krupa). It will take place in Geneva, Switzerland and in the house where the Reagans are staying there are goldfish that Reagan promises to personally feed. Despite his best efforts, one of the fish dies and Reagan leaves a handwritten note apologizing to the boy they belonged to, promising to send him new ones. At the Geneva Summit in 1985, the two leaders negotiate nuclear disarmament, but Reagan is reluctant to sign an agreement due to his support for the Strategic Defense Initiative (SDI), which had been dubbed “Star Wars”. A year later, the Iran-Contra scandal breaks, and Reagan is threatened with impeachment. Reagan denies there were arms traded for hostages but backtracks in an Oval Office speech. Despite Shultz’s opposition, Reagan delivers a speech near the Brandenburg Gate, and demands for Gorbachev to tear down the Berlin Wall. In 1989, Reagan leaves office and the Berlin Wall falls shortly thereafter; the Soviet Union would be dissolved two years later. In retirement, Reagan experiences memory lapses and finds out he has been diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease. Reagan takes one last horse ride with his Secret Service agent, John Barletta (Trevor Donovan), the only member of the Secret Service who could ride horses. Reagan dies in 2004, and international leaders attend his funeral to pay their respects. Archival pictures and additional details are shown during closing credits, including, for instance, that Nelle and Jack moved to Hollywood with Reagan, and she answered his fan mail and volunteered at prisons and hospitals or that Nancy survived him by a decade and supervised the construction of the Reagan museum and library in Simi Valley, CA. A post-credits scene features a photo of the letter sent to President Reagan by the boy regarding the fish that died and the replacements Reagan had sent.

text: Welcome To Movie Recall. In Today's video, we will be going through the 2021 science fiction, action movie “Free Guy”. The Movie Shows Ryan Reynolds Aka Deadpool As A Non Playable Character In Open-world Video Game Where He Has Powers Same As Avengers Captain America And Hulk. It's Time To Recall. Let's Get Started. Turn On Subtitles and Spoilers Ahead! Make sure to give this video a thumbs up and subscribe for more videos like these. Have you ever played or heard of Grand Theft Auto or GTA? The movie takes place in an open-world desktop video game called Free City, where players can take part in action-packed missions like spy jobs or bank robberies in order to gain money and level up their characters. The strongest characters in the game are obviously the ones with sunglasses because they are controlled by real players. To support the storyline of the game, the developer also created non-playable characters or we call it NPC. An NPC is a character that is not controlled by a real player, instead it is programmed to do certain daily activities in the game. And of course, an NPC cannot die. Among the many non-playable characters in the game, there is Guy, a NPC who is programmed to be a bank teller in the game and unaware that his world is a video game. He works and spends most of his time with his best friend Buddy, who works as security in the bank. The pair works in the bank that will always be robbed by real players and they always have to play the part of helpless bank employees as they get robbed. On the other side, there is a sunglasses character called Molotov Girl, who is making a deal with another player for a coordinate of a safe house that keeps a video that contains top secret information. Later on, as Guy and Buddy on their way to home, they suddenly walk past her. Guy seems surprised as she sings the song he says his dream girl will like. He comments on the song, which surprises the girl because she is used to hearing all the phrases each NPC has to say. Because of that, Guy begins to deviate from his programming and follows where The Molotov Girl goes. But unfortunately, he is hit by a train, sending him back to his home and having to start his boring daily activities again. The next day, when the robbery takes place in the bank, Guy sees the girl he met yesterday and starts to rebel. He tries to fight back and manages to grab the sunglasses from the robber. When he puts them on, he finally discovers many features of the game that supposedly only appear to real players. He sees a first aid kit floating. He casually goes near the kit and looks at a businessman sitting next to it. Guy points to what looks like nothing And Ask him if he can see it. the businessman looks at him like he's crazy and walks off. Guy takes off the sungalsses and the kit isn't there. Puts them back on and it is still there, clear as day. He touches the first aid and the kit disappears with a glowing light floats up his body healing all his wounds. While Walking guy sees a dead player and sees money floating. Guy appraches the stack of money and touches it. And the money status bar on his glassess jumps by two thousand dollars. Guy Goes to the ATM and checks his balance. Sure enough - he has TWO THOUSAND more dollars in his account than he did few minutes ago. In the real world, Keys and Mouser, who work at Soonami, a company that runs Free City, detect Guy's weird activities and suspect that he is a hacker who uses NPC skin to take down other players. To resolve the problem, they decide to go into the game as their avatars to confront Guy. Then they enter the game and meets guy who has brought his favourite shoes with huge amount of money. As they closes in Guy runs deep into the construction site and they follows him. Then guy notices a button on his new shoes which can help him jump far. Then he presses the button and use it to go far from them. At first time he loses his balance because it was his first time. And he does not know how to control it, and the same time the police and rabbit was closing in and starts to fire at him. Guy tries to run away from there and he learns to control the shoes. He jumps to the highest level of the building. Unfortunately his shoes battey is out. They keep chasing after him. Guy tries to escape by grabbing onto a wrecking ball, but he misses and falls. Luckily, he manages to save himself with a bubble suit. However, The employees find him and hit him with the police car, thinking they have taken the “hacker out for good. Keys feels something strange as the number of online players did not change even after they killed him, indicating that it wasn't a hacker. Suddenly, an interview of Keys with Millie in earlier years is displayed, discovering Keys and Millie are the masterminds behind the Free City before Antwan, owner of Soonami Company, stole their original code from Life Itself game - a game which was originally developed by Keys and Millie - and used that code to build Free City franchises. Surprisingly, Millie is the player behind The Molotov Girl character. Millie visits Keys and asks him to help her get evidence of Antwan's crimes because she knows the proof of their stolen code is hidden in a safe house, which she is going to infiltrate while playing as Molotov Girl. Later on, Guy approaches Molotov Girl outside the safe house. The house guards spot them and start shooting at them, so they have to flee. Guy offers to help her in her mission, but it is impossible as he is only at level 1, while she is already at level 195. Guys then starts taking on missions and pulls off several heroic acts like returning stolen money and pulling kids away from traffic. Because of his uniqueness, players in real life start to notice him and Guy suddenly goes viral with his unique nickname called “The Blue Shirt Guy”. He even shows up as an answer on one of America's Quiz Show, Jeopardy. Long story short, he manages to reach level 102. The next day, Guy comes to the bank and persuades Buddy to join him after stealing sunglasses from a player who is doing a heist mission at the bank, but Buddy refuses to do so because he thinks it is too dangerous. Antwan realizes the popularity of Guy and wants his employees to keep Guy on the game. Additionally, The company is also going to launch Free City 2 in two days, despite not being fully coded and still contains bugs, and he makes it worse by telling Keys that the game is not backward compatible with the first game, meaning that most of the characters will not be able to be played in the Free City 2. The Molotov Girl goes back to the safe house and manages to take the stolen code. But, she is confronted by the house's guards and gets cornered. Out of nowhere, suddenly Guy crashes through on a motorcycle and helps her to eliminate the guards before escaping by using a hang glider. After the event, the two hang out and Guy surprisingly manages to guess The Molotov Girl's favourite ice cream flavour, which is bubblegum ice cream. She is impressed because nobody likes that flavour and he manages to guess it right. It's just like Guy knows everything about this Molotov Girl. They end up kissing before Millie disconnects from the game. Keys finally realizes there is something strange about the codes of the Free City's NPCs. He tells Millie that Guy is not controlled by a hacker, instead he is the first living AI which could be able to decide his own path.This proves that Antwan has stolen their code and implemented it to the Free City, because their main idea for the game was to have the NPCs grow and develop over time as they adapt, and that is what Guy has been doing recently. He also warns Millie that the current world of Free City will be completely erased when the Free City 2 is launched, which is 48 hours from now. Thus, they decide to ask Guy's help. Millie goes back to the game as Molotov Girl. She reveals to Guy that he is just a character in a video game who does not exist in real life and he will be completely deleted if he doesn't help Millie. After knowing the truth, Guy feels so sad and runs to the beach. There, he realizes that something is hidden behind the beach and he decides to help the Molotov Girl. Guy then asks Buddy to go with him to the safe house, where the stolen code is kept. But surprisingly, the guard`s real player is a big fan of Guy and is very excited to meet him. He basically lets Guy rob him and take what he wants, even asking Guy to kill him, but Guy refuses the request. He later brings the file to Millie. On the other hand, Guy's popularity has risen sharply, even popular streamers in real life like Poki mane, Dan TDM and Ninja are talking about him! Knowing about that, Antwan gets pissed off and thinks that Guy's presence in the game will hurt the Free City 2's sales. Mouser suggests to reboot the system, so that Guy will get back to its default form. In the game, Guy and Millie manage to access the file, showing an island which proves that Antwan really stole their code. Guy claims that he has seen this island, but doesnt remember when or where. The game then is successfully rebooted before he can tell where he saw it to Millie. Millie manages to get back into the game after the reboot, but Guy doesn't remember who she is as he is already back to his default setting. She asks Keys for help, and he tells her that Guy is created to always be searching for his dream girl, and he just needs something to help trigger the code. Molotov Girl decides to kiss Guy and it brings back all his memories, including where he saw the island. It turns out that the image of it is reflected off the blinds in his apartment. Because of that, Keys figures out that the island is just hidden beyond the city's horizon. Guy and Millie then gather all the NPCs in the game and tell them that there is an island across the city that allows them to move and act freely instead of what they were coded to do. The speech inspires all the NPCs and they start to move at their own will. With all the NPCs gone, the players are left confused. Mouser then shows Antwan a recording of Guy and Millie taking the secret file at the safe house. Antwan then realizes that Millie is involved and orders Mouser to kill them and kick them out from the game. Mouser uses his power as the game developer to destroy Guy and Millie as Guy is driving them outside the city. With the help of Keys, a ramp suddenly pops out and they manage to escape. They arrive at the beach, but Keys gets caught and fired from the company. Before he leaves Antwan room, Keys launches his last help to the pair. He creates a bridge for them so that they can cross the sea safely. On the other side, Antwan orders Mouser to boot the game, which disconnects Molotov Girl and all the players from the game, but Keys secretly conducts a live broadcasting of Guy to all Free City players, so that they can still be able to watch him despite being disconnected from the game. Furthermore, Antwan also commands his employees to deploy DUDE, a bigger, stronger, but dumber version of Guy who is not fully programmed, but it is the final weapon of Antwan to get rid of Guy. Buddy arrives to help while Guy gets tossed around by DUDE. Before receiving the final blow, Guy manages to pick up sunglasses and deploy a Captain America's shield, which surprises Chris Evans who is watching it live in a cafe. He also manages to deploy a Hulk's fist, and a lightsaber. However, Dude is too strong and keeps beating Guy until he puts the glasses on Dude, who now is able to see the world as Guy does and starts dancing randomly. Guy and Buddy then start running toward the island. Antwan starts to lose it and brings Mouser to the server room, where he plans to destroy the server and delete the game entirely. Mouser stops helping Antwan when he figures out that Antwan was really stealing the code from Keys, so Antwan begins to destroy everything with an axe, causing the city environment to be deleted, including the bridge. Unfortunately, Buddy can't make it to the end and is deleted from the game, but he tells Guy that he has had the best day of his life because of Guy. Guy runs and finally breaks through the barriers and makes it to the island, which is then revealed to all the NPCs and the players in the real world. Millie then confronts Antwan in the server room and makes a deal with him. She will let Antwan keep the Free City name for sequels and spin-offs, but Antwan has to let her have the original code of the game and stop destroying the server. Soon, Free City 2 is launched, but the sales slump because of numerous bugs and lagging online play, resulting in Antwan being kicked out from the company. On the other side, Millie, Keys and Mouser develop Free Life which brings all NPCs from Free City to there. Millie then watches a recording of Keys explaining that Guy's character is always going to fall in love with Molotov Girl because he created the algorithm based on Keys own love to Millie. She realizes this and decides to approach Keys and kiss him. Back in the game, Guy and Dude finally become friends and surprisingly Buddy is brought back to life in the game and they reunite.
