In the morning Bob makes a comment about Joan's music being like oil paintings in a dentist's office. He then starts to play Blowin' in the Wind which Joan joins him in singing. Sylvie returns from her trip just as Bob's career really starts to take off. He performs Girl from the North Country during a show with Joan. Sylvie begins to notice how close she and Bob are. More people begin to recognize Bob on the street and buy his album. And he even receives a letter from Johnny Cash saying that his Freewheelin' album is a prized possession. The two become pen pals and even perform at the same show. Bob performs The Times They Are a Changin' And admit that that's what we mean I see which impresses people watching, such as Pete, Toshi, Joan, and Cash, while Sylvie is moved to tears. By 1965, Bob has become very famous, but he feels restricted or limited. People expect him to only play one style of music, folk music. Which makes him feel stuck or unable to explore other styles freely. He meets fellow musician Bobby Neuwirth and goes with him to one of his performances. Things get sour when an overzealous fan grabs Bob's glass off his face and he gets punched by her boyfriend when he tries to get them back. He goes to Sylvie's apartment so she can tend to him, but he sees that she is already with another man. She reminds Bob that they already broke up, but Bob only asked for towel to his wound. He then leaves the apartment. Bob starts responding to the political and social changes happening around him by changing his music style to electric folk rock. This new direction surprises and upsets the planning committee of a music festival as they were used to his usual folk style. Bob records new songs like Subterranean Homesick Blues and Highway 61 Revisited. After this, we see Pete on his TV show Rainbow Quest where Jesse Moffett is a guest on the show. Bob then shows up on the show and Pete introduces him to Jesse. Jesse lets Bob borrow his guitar to play the song It Takes a Lot to Laugh, It Takes a Lot to Cry. Later that night, Bob goes to Joan's apartment to reconnect, but she hardly allows him inside. He then starts singing a song while Joan is sleeping. She wakes up and asks him why he came here. He replies that he just wanted to see her. She then asked him to go and Bob politely leaves. The next day, they go on their same tour, but things take a turn when Bob tries to play his own music apart from the set list while Joan tries to start playing Blowin' in the Wind. Bob makes a scene and tries to get Joan to play something else, but she plays the song herself while he walks off stage. Bob gets a band together and they begin to record like a Rolling Stone. Once upon a time After recording, he goes to pick up Sylvie on his motorcycle as he is heading to the Newport Folk Festival. He calls Sylvie and she looks outside to see him. She then gets ready and they both head to Newport. There Sylvie watches as Bob and Joan perform It Ain't Me, Babe. Seeing the chemistry between them, Sylvie starts crying and leaves. After the performance, Bob asks Neuwirth about Sylvie's whereabouts. He tells him that she had already left Newport. He then gets on his bike to talk to her. text: The movie opens in a dark, quiet room where a woman named Violet is pleading with her abusive husband, Blake, to stop tormenting her. But Blake takes a sick pleasure in her suffering. He points a gun at her and coldly reminds her that she is the reason they're in this situation. He hands her the gun and tells her to shoot him. Violet trembles, her hand hesitantly reaching for the trigger. The scene then shifts forward a few years where Violet, after her husband's death, has moved to Chicago with her 5-year-old son, Toby. She also works as a therapist, helping survivors of abusive relationships. Each session she leads is her way of telling others what she once desperately needed to hear herself, that they are not alone and they are seen. Violet then hears the doorbell and finds a man who claims to be from the electric company asking for permission to read the meters. She agrees. Violet has also been talking to a man named Henry Campbell for the past 3 months. They met on a dating app. Henry works as a photographer at the mayor's office, and today they've decided to meet for the first time in person. While Violet is reading the messages from Henry, she's startled by the sound of Toby's toy truck rolling across the floor. Inside it, Violet finds a note that says, "Find me." They're in the middle of a game of hide and seek when her sister, Jen, arrives. After greeting her sister, Violet continues getting ready for her date. Jen frowns at her outfit, causing Violet to second-guess not only her choice of clothes, but the entire idea of going out. She's anxious about leaving Toby home for the first time. Jen encourages her, reminding her that she deserves happiness and not everyone is like her ex-husband. With her sister's help, Violet picks out a prettier dress and begins to feel a little more confident. Later, as she comes downstairs, Toby looks up and tells her she looks pretty. She smiles and thanks him. Before leaving, she reminds Jen to put Toby to bed by 8:00 and lets her know there are cameras set up around the house so she can check in if needed. She arrives at Palate, a fine dining restaurant located at the top of a high-rise building. While in the elevator, she receives a text from Henry saying he'll be a little late and asks her to wait at the bar. At the reception desk, she confirms her reservation. The hostess helps her remove her coat and gives her direction to the bar area. Just as Violet is walking in, she receives a message from Jen. Momentarily distracted, she bumps into a man. She quickly apologizes and takes a seat at the bar, ordering a drink. The bartender compliments her outfit. Violet laughs and says her sister made her wear it and that it's her first date in a long time. A few moments later, an elderly man approaches and mistakes her for his blind date, Diane. Violet apologizes and gently tells him he has the wrong person. He admits it's his first blind date and the two strike up a light conversation about how strange and complicated modern dating can be. Soon after, a man in a suit sits beside her and after a pause, asks her what her favorite song is. The bartender cuts in, informing the man, who goes by the name Phil, that Violet is waiting for someone. Phil doesn't seem to care. After some persistence, Violet finally gives in and says, "Baby Shark." Disappointed, Phil smiles weakly and walks away. The bartender explains that Phil is their new piano player and kind of a flirt. A few minutes later, the elderly gentleman's actual date arrives. She looks unimpressed by his appearance and Violet watches the awkward exchange with a quiet smile. Checking her phone, Violet looks for any updates from Jen about Toby. Instead, she gets a drop notification from the DigiDrop app. Similar to AirDrop, it's a meme and she ignores it. Then, another one comes through. Curious, she scans the room to see who might be sending them. That's when she sees Henry. He walks up to her and apologizes for being late. Violet tells him it's no bother, and the two walk to their reserved table. The view from the top is breathtaking. Floor-to-ceiling windows overlook the sparkling city below. After sitting down, Richard explains that he had to bring his camera bag with him as work ran late. As they settle in, she asks if it's okay to keep her phone on the table. She wants to keep an eye on her son, Toby, who's being baby-sat by her sister. Henry assures her it's not a problem. He then pulls out a small hockey puck with the logo of the Chicago team engraved on it and says it's for Toby. Violet is genuinely touched by the gesture. Their server, Matt, arrives at the table with contagious enthusiasm. He excitedly announces it's his first day and launches into a rambling story about his entire life. Noticing the polite but strained expressions on their faces, he eventually stops and asks for their order. Henry starts by ordering a drink. Just then, Violet receives another drop on her phone. She shows Henry and tells him someone's been sending her random memes through DigiDrop. Henry shrugs and says it happens to him too sometimes, especially on trains. Since DigiDrop only works within 50 ft, he figures it's someone nearby. Looking around, Henry rules out the elderly couple nearby, saying they don't look like they even know how to unlock an iPad. Violet adds that the older man, Richard, is actually here on a blind date. They both glance around and land on a group of well-dressed prom kids, guessing it's probably one of them playing a prank. The phone vibrates again, but this time it's Jen. Violet smiles and shows Henry a picture of Toby. But then, almost immediately, another meme drop comes through, disturbing this time. And it includes her name. Violet frowns saying someone knows who she is. Henry tries to reassure her saying that on the Digidrop app names are visible to everyone. But he does admit one thing feels off. He can see the profile of everyone who are with them in the restaurant on the app, so he couldn't guess who the anonymous dropper could be. He excuses himself and uses a distance checking app to scan the area. When he returns, he tells her the kitchen and lobby are out of range. Which means whoever is sending these drops is definitely in the dining room. Violet receives another message and shows it to Henry. Just as their drinks arrive, she gets a chilling notification from the dropper. It instructs her to check the security cameras at her house. She opens the app and what she sees makes her heart stop. A masked man is inside her home. Henry notices her face go pale and asks if everything is okay. Violet quickly excuses herself saying she needs to make a call to Jen. She steps away and dials 911, but before the call can go through, she receives a message from the dropper. Your phone is cloned. Panicking, Violet bumps into the same man from the lobby. She mutters an apology and hurries into the women's restroom. When she's about to ask the women there for help, her phone suddenly buzzes again. The dropper has sent another message somehow already knowing what she was about to do. Desperate, Violet borrows eyeliner from one of the women and writes help on her hand. But the women don't seem to understand what she's trying to say. After they leave, Violet scans the bathroom and notices small discreet hearing device tucked under the sink. She returns to her table shaken but trying to compose herself. She apologizes to Henry for walking out so abruptly and tells him that this is her first time leaving Toby alone since he was born. Henry gives her a sympathetic look and says he understands completely. Then Violet glances at the table lamp. Hidden inside it, just like in the restroom, is another hearing device. When Violet messages and asks who he is, the dropper playfully replies that he could be their waiter or the hostess or anyone. Henry then turns to Violet and, noticing her discomfort, asks if someone is still sending her drops. She lies and says it's just the height making her nauseous. Understanding, Henry calls out to Matt and asks if they can change tables. After checking with the hostess, Matt returns and tells them that another table is available. However, the dropper threatens Violet. Violet raises her voice, getting the attention of both men, and says she'd like to go back to their original table since Henry specifically reserved it for the view. On the way back, Violet notices security cameras in every corner, likely how the dropper tracks her every move. Later, the hostess stops by to check on them. She also mentions that Henry specifically called to request this table. Henry denies it, saying he only asked for any table with a good view. Then, the server arrives to take their order. Violet discreetly messages the dropper, asking what he wants. The dropper replies, "Get the SD card from Henry's camera." Violet orders a salad and Henry chooses the filet. Thinking quickly, Violet hides her watch in her bag. She then pretends to have lost it and asks Henry to check with the hostess. Without complaint, he heads off. Taking the chance, Violet gets on her knees, retrieves Henry's camera, and finds compromising photos of the mayor along with financial statements hinting at corruption in the mayor's office. She removes the SD card and returns to the table. Henry returns, apologizing that the hostess had no information about the missing watch. Violet then suggests she might have left it in the restroom and excuses herself to go check. In the restroom, she smashes the SD card and flushes it. Then, she messages the dropper to get the man out of her house. To her dismay, the dropper tells her to open the towel dispenser. Inside, she finds a vial of poison. He instructs her to pour it into Henry's drink. Horrified, she refuses, but the dropper reminds her she's already killed a man before. Leaving the restroom, Violet heads to the lobby and asks the hostess to check who had originally reserved their table, explaining that she doesn't want to take someone else's reservation. The hostess confirms that it was Henry who made the reservation. After the hostess walks away, Violet tries calling 911 from the hotel phone, but the call doesn't go through. She attempts the abuse hotline, but the dropper intercepts and tells her to stop. Then, she notices the man she's bumped into earlier walking around the hotel. She confronts him, and he claims he's waiting for his sister. Still suspicious, she leaves him and returns to the table to find Henry paying the check. He tells her he understands that her son comes first and says she should go home. To stop him, she kisses him and pleads with him to stay. He agrees. The waiter returns to their table, and Violet hears the Baby Shark song that Phil is playing on the piano. She reveals to Henry that she requested it earlier. Quickly, she takes out some money, scribbles two hostages and call cops on it, and gives it to the waiter, telling him it's a tip for the pianist. Moments later, the pianist, Phil, receives the tip. Henry excuses himself for a business call. Violet watches as Phil looks at her, seems to make a call, but then resumes playing the piano. Henry returns, and the waiter brings their food, salad and filet. Then, Violet notices the money intended for Phil is inside her salad. She texts the dropper an apology. Just then, Phil collapses. Violet checks her security camera feed and sees Jen being knocked out while the man locks Toby in a room. Moments later, Phil gets up and heads toward the elevator. The dropper messages Violet. Phil is dead. She notices an ambulance outside the hotel. Violet suggests doing shots to lighten the mood. Henry agrees and flags down Matt, but he's busy, so Violet volunteers to go herself. In her rush, she drops her bag, and Henry sees the watch inside. Violet reaches the bar and orders two tequila shots. Just as she is about to pour the poison into the drink, the dropper instructs her to spike the drink at her table. The bartender then asks if she would like lemon wedges. Violet declines and takes the shots to their table. Wordlessly, Henry hands her the watch. Feigning surprise, Violet asked where he found it. Unbothered, he replies, "In your bag." Then Henry, concerned, asks if she's all right. Just then, her mind flashes back to her ex-husband screaming at her and pointing a gun at Toby, his cries echoing through the room. Violet is snapped back to reality when Henry calls her name. She then asks Henry why he messaged her on the dating app, knowing that she is a widow with a son. With a wistful tone, Henry explains that he was close to deleting the dating app because everyone on there portrayed a perfect persona, which he knew wasn't true. Then he came across Violet's profile and explains that she seemed kind, genuine, and a good mom. But Violet argues that she's a bad mother because she stayed with her abusive husband even after Toby was born, and Toby saw things no child should ever witness. Henry points out that she got out, and that's all that matters, but Violet counters, saying she didn't get out. She's still trapped in the room where her husband tried to kill her child and she did nothing. Henry shares that he was in a similar situation before and the person he trusted most turned out to be a bad person. He tells her that her ex-husband didn't take her hope because she's here now, just like he is. Violet, with a small smile, acknowledges his words. She then tells him she forgot the lemon wedges. Henry volunteers to get them from the bar. At the bar, when Henry asks for lemon wedges, the bartender questions if she changed her mind. Suspicious, Henry lies and replies, "Yes." Meanwhile, Violet notices the man from earlier staring at her and then she spikes Henry's drink. When Henry returns to their table, they toast to their first date. Violet deliberately spills wine on Henry. He quickly excuses himself to go wash up in the bathroom. Violet decides to confront the man, but just as she approaches, his sister arrives. The bartender returns and asks if her date is going well. Violet replies that everything is fine. She then gestures toward the woman who just arrived and asks if she comes here often, mentioning that she feels like she's seen her before. The bartender confirms that the woman is a regular and usually sits at the table Richard is occupying now. She also adds that Richard has been a creep, staring at Violet throughout his entire date. Now realizing Richard is the dropper, Violet approaches him with the shots. He asks her to take a seat and have a shot. She does. Richard then reveals that he's been hired by the mayor's office to get rid of Henry and the incriminating SD card. Violet threatens to call the police as she has evidence that Richard has sent the drops, but Richard dismissively replies that drops are untraceable. Then, he drops a bombshell. Henry is actually an FBI informant. Violet, shaken, asks why he chose her. Richard replies that Violet has a reputation for having killed her husband. Since the court couldn't find her guilty, they thought she'd be the perfect candidate, given her track record. Violet denies killing her husband, but her mind flashes back to the moment where Blake took his own life, further complicating her life. Richard then reveals that because of her stupidity, Phil had to die. Just then, the waiter serves panna cotta for Richard. Then he boastfully mentions that the footage of her spiking Henry's drink is recorded. A moment later, Henry arrives from the washroom. Richard cheerfully introduces himself, mentioning that he met Violet at the bar, and offers the spiked drink to Henry. Henry hesitates, but Violet encourages him to drink, which he does. Violet then asks Henry to wait at their table, promising to explain everything. She then asks Richard to get the man out of her house. Richard makes a call, then enthusiastically starts eating the dish. Violet opens up about how her ex-husband always took her to a restaurant and bought her a panna cotta as an apology dinner. She would pretend everything was fine, just as she pretended to spike the shot, when instead, she spiked the panna cotta. Richard furious pulls a gun on her, but Henry shields her, taking the shot meant for Violet. The bartender also comes to her defense, but is violently stabbed in the process. Richard then calls the man to kill Violet's child. Violet notices the cracks in the glass window and throws the hockey puck at it, and the air suction causes Richard to fall to his death while she dangles for her life. Luckily, Henry arrives just in time and saves her. After ensuring Henry is okay, Violet grabs her phone and sees that the man is heading toward her son's room. After getting the car keys from Henry, she calls Jen and warns her about the intruder. Meanwhile, Jen and Toby manage to hide in a room, but the intruder manages to break inside the room and shoots Jen. Just as the situation seems dire, Violet arrives, grabs a knife, and stabs the intruder. A violent fight ensues, but in the end, Violet spots his son's toy truck heading towards her, and inside it is a gun. She shoots the intruder, ending the threat. Jen, though wounded by the gunshot, manages to get downstairs. A few days later at the hospital, Henry learns that the mayor has been arrested in connection with embezzlement. Violet arrives at Henry's hospital room, and Jen, though recovering, is healing nicely. The two then decide to go on a second date.

ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಗೊತ್ತಾಗ್ತಾ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ನೋಡಿದ್ರೆ ಆ ಜಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲ ನೀರಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕ್ಯಾಟ್ ನ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಚ್ುನ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೋಗೋಣ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಫಾಸ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿ ಹೋಡ್ತಾ ಆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಚ್ು ಮೇಲೆ ಬಂದು ನಿಂತ್ಕೊತಾನೆ. ಆಗ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದಂಗೆನೆ ಇವನ ಇದ್ದಂತಹ ಮನೆ ಜಾಗ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾನು ಕೂಡ ನೀರಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ದಲೇ ಈ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿರುವಂತ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಚುನು ಕೂಡ ನೀರಿಂದ ಕವರ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಬಿಲ್ಲಿಗೂ ಕೂಡ ತುಂಬಾ ಭಯ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಏನ್ು ಮಾಡೋದು ಈಗ ಇದು ಕೂಡ ತುಂಬಾ ಇದ್ದಲ್ಲ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದಂಗೇನೆ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಚುನು ಕೂಡ ಮುಳುಗೋಕೋ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ಬಂದುಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಯಾರಾದರೂ ಇದ್ರೆ ಕಾಪಾಡ್ರೋ ನನ್ನ ಅಂತ ಬಡ್ಕೊತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಇವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಕಾಣುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಆ ಬೋಟ್ ನ ಕಲಿತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ ನಾನು ಇಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀನಿ ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಂತ. ಇನ್ನೇನು ಆ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಚುನ ಮುಳುಗಹೋಗಿ ಇವನು ಮುಳುಗ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನಷ್ಟಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಬೋಟ್ ಕೂಡ ಇವನ ಹತ್ರ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಇವನು ಪೀಸ್ ಆಗಿ ಅದರ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಹತ್ತಕೊಂಡು ಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಬೋಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಬಂದು ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಅದರೊಳಗಡೆ ಒಂದು ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಅವನ ನೋಡಿ ಹೆದುರುಕೊಳ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಈ ಬಿಲಿ ಇದರಿಂದ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರನು ಕೂಡ ನಾನೇನು ಮಾಡೋದಿಲ್ಲ ತಲೆ ಕೆಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಬೇಬೇಡ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಸುಮ್ನೆ ಅದರ ಪಾಡಿಗೆ ಅದು ಮಲ್ಕೊಂಡು ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಬಿಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ಇನ್ನೇನು ಮಾಡಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಇಲ್ಲೇ ಇರಬೇಕು ಅಂದಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅದರ ಪಾಡಿಗೆ ಅದು ಕೂಡ ಮಲ್ಕೊಂಡು ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಸೀನು ನಾಳೆ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಶಿಫ್ಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ನಾಳೆ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಆಗ್ತಿದ್ದಂಗೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ಬೋಟ್ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಂದು ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀವಿ ನಾವು ಏನು ನಡೀತಾ ಇತೆ ಭೂಮಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಚೂರು ಅರ್ಥ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗ ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಇದ್ದಂಗೆ ನೀರೊಳಗಡೆಗೆ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಆ ನೀರೊಳಗಡೆ ಬಿದ್ದೋದಾಗ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೆಲವು ಮೀನುಗಳು ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಹೆಂಗಿದ್ರೂ ಇದು ಬೇಕಲ್ವಾ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ಹಸದೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಮೀನುಗಳು ಬೇಕಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಆ ನದಿ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಹಾರಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮೀನ ಹಿಡಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ನೋಡ್ತಾರೆ ಬೋಟ್ ಇವರಿಗಿಂತ ಮುಂದೆ ಉಂಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಟ್ಟೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಅಯ್ಯಯ್ಯೋ ಬೋಟ್ ಮುಂದೆ ಉಂಟು ಹೋಯ್ತಲ್ಲ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವನು ಕೂಡ ಬೋಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಹೋಗೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆಗ ನೋಡ್ತಿದ್ದಂಗೆನೆ ಕೆಲವು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಗಳು ಈ ಒಂದು ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಟ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಇವನು ಬಚಾವಾಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನೀರು ಕೆಳಗಡೆ ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಇವನಿಗೆ ಹೊಸರಾಡಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗದಲೆ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ತಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸೀಲ್ ಫಿಶ್ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವನ್ನ ಮೇಲ್ಗಡೆಗೆ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಬರುತ್ತೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಇವನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಆಗ ದಿಡೀರನೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಅಟ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವ್ನ ಎತ್ತುಕೊಂಡು ಉಂಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇವನು ಕೂಡ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇದೆ ಅಂತ ಗೊತ್ತೆ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಇಳಿಸೋ ನನ್ನ ಕೆಳಗಡೆ ಪ್ಲೀಸ್ ನನಗೆ ಏನು ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಡ ಅಂತ ಆ ಒಂದು ಬರ್ಡ್ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಫೈಟ್ ಮಾಡೋಕ್ಕು ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಕೂಡ ನೀನು ನೀನು ಕೆಳಗಡೆ ತಾನೇ ಇಳಿಸಬೇಕು ಇಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ ಬಾ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಕೈ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಇವನು ಸಿಸಾಗಿ ಬೋಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಬಂದು ಬಿದ್ದು ಹೋಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಿಲಿ ಬೋರ್ಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಏನು ನನಗೆ ಥ್ಯಾಂಕ್ಸ್ ಹೇಳಲ್ವ ಅಂದಾಗ ಇದನ್ನ ನೋಡಿ ಇನ್ನು ಭಯ ಪಡ್ಕೊತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಇವರು ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಈ ಬೇಕು ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಚ್ುಗಳನ್ನೇ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾಗೆ ಇನ್ನು ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಒಂದು ಜಾಗ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬಿಲಿ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಹತ್ರ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ಜಾಗ ಇದೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರೋ ಇದ್ದಾರೆ ನೋಡೋ ನಡಿ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಬೋಟ್ನ ಆ ಕಡೆ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ಹತ್ತರಗೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಲೆಮೂರ್ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಲೆಮೂರು ತುಂಬಾ ತೀಟೆ ಆಗಿರುವಂತ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ಇದು ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರನು ಕೂಡ ಅದರ ಹತ್ರ ಹೋಗಿದಾಗ ಅದು ಕೆಲವು ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಹಾಕೊತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಗಾಜಿನ ಪೀಸ್ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು ಬಾಟಲ್ಸ್ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು ಪ್ರಜ್ ಚಮಚ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಬಾಟಲ್ಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಕೊತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಇವಾಗ ಬಾ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಒಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟಿನ ಎಳ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ಈ ಲಿಮೂರ್ ಕೂಡ ಬಿಡೋ ನನ್ನ ಪುಟ್ಟಿ ನನ್ನ ನೆಲಗೂ ಬರೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಅವನು ಕೂಡ ಪುಟ್ಟಿನ ಹಳಿತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ ಆದ್ರೆ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಬಿಡೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಳ್ಕೊಂಡು ತನ್ನ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆಗೆ ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ ಆಗ ಲಿಮೂರ್ ನೋಡುತ್ತೆ ಇದ್ದಂತಹ ಜಾಗ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಮುಳುಗೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಇವನು ಇವರುಗಳ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ಗೆ ಬರ್ತಾನೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿಮೂರ್ ಕೂಡ ಇನ್ಮೇಲೆ ನೀ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆನೆ ಇರಬೇಕು ಇಲ್ಲೇ ಇರಬೇಕು ಅಂದಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೇಳ್ತಾನೆ ಸರಿ ಆಯ್ತು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮತ್ತೆ ಇವರು ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಹಾಗೆ ಬಾಳೆಹಣ್ಣ ಒಂದು ಗಿಡ ಕಾಣುತ್ತೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಳೆಹಣ್ಣು ಕೂಡ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಅದನ್ನ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಕಿತ್ಕೊಳ್ತಾನೆ ಕಿತ್ಕೊಂತಾನೆ ಬೋಟ್ಗೆ ತಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕೊಡ್ತಾನೆ ತಿನ್ನೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ಇವನು ಕೂಡ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ತಿಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮಲಕೊಂಡುಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ ಈ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ಬೋಟ್ನ ಹೈಟ್ಗೆ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ ಯಾದರ ಸೇಫ್ ಆಗಿರೋ ಜಾಗ ಇದೆಯಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೋಗಬಹುದ ನಾವು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅವಾಗ ಇವನಿಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳು ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗೋದ್ರೆ ಹೇಗಿರುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ಯೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಬೋಟ್ ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್ ತಪ್ಪಿ ಬೇರೆ ಕಡೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನ ಬೋಟ್ನ ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಒಂದು ಜಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ತಂದು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಆಚೆ ಬಂದು ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಭೂಮಿ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಬಂದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾರೆ ಏನಾದರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ ಅಂತ. ಅವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಡಾಗಿ ಬರ್ತಾನೆ. ಡಾಗಿ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನ ನೋಡಬಿಟ್ಟು ಸಿಕ್ಕಪಟ್ಟೆ ಖುಷಿ ಪಡ್ತಾನೆ ನೀ ಇನ್ನು ಬದುಕಿದೀಯಾ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಜೊತೆ ಇರೋನ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಮೀಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ ಈ ಡಾಗಿ ಈ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರೋಸೆಸ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಏನು ತಿಂದೆ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಸಿಕ್ಕಪಟ್ಟೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಅಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಒಂದು ಮೀನನ್ನ ಕ್ಯಾಚ್ ಮಾಡೋಣ ಅಂತ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದರೆ ಈ ಡಾಗಿ ಅವನ ಒಂದು ಸಂತೋಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಹಾಳು ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಈ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀನ್ನ ಕ್ಯಾಚ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಅವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವನಿಗೆ ತಿನ್ನೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಒಂದು ಮೀನ್ನ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೆ. ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ಆ ಮೀನ್ನ ತಿಂತಿರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಈ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ನ ಲೀಡರ್ ಬಂದುಬಿಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಬಂದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಈ ಬರ್ಡ್ಗೆ ಬೈತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ತರ ಇರೋವರಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ನೀನು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ಬೇರೆಯವರಿಗೆಲ್ಲ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಬಾರದು ಅಂದಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬೈದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಮೀನು ಕೂಡ ಕಿತ್ತುಕೊಂಡು ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ಇವರೆಲ್ಲ ಎಲ್ಲಿರ್ತಾರೆ ಅಂತ ನೋಡಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ಒಂದು ಆಸೆಯಿಂದ ಈ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಗಳನ್ನ ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಅವರಿಂದನೇ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ಬಂದು ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಇವರುಗಳ ತರನೇ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಗಳಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಅದನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಈ ಡಾಗಿ ಬಂದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಡಿಕ್ಕಿ ಹೊಡೆದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೂಡ ಗ್ಯಾಂಗ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋದಾಗ ಆ ಒಂದು ಬರ್ಡ್ನ ಲೀಡರ್ಗೆ ಕೋಪ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. ಇವರು ಯಾರು ನಮ್ಮ ಗ್ಯಾಂಗ್ ಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಈ ರೀತಿ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದಾರಲ್ಲ ಇವರಿಗೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಪಾಠ ಕಲಿಸಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹಾಗೆ ಇವರ ಹತ್ರ ಬರ್ತಿರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಭಯ ಆಗ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಓಡೋಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ. ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ನ ಟೀಮ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇರೋರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೂಡ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನ ಹಿಡಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅವರು ಕೂಡ ಬರ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಇವರಗಳ ಕೈಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ದಂಗೆ ಓಡೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನಲ್ಲ ಒಂದು ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬನ್ನಿ ನಿಂದ್ಕೊತಾನೆ ಯಾಕೆಂದ್ರೆ ಬಾಕಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ನೀರೇ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಇನ್ನ ಮುಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಲೀಡರ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಕೂಡ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನಮ್ಮ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನ ಮುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಅವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಈ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಇವನನ್ನ ಕಾಪಾಡಿ ಇವನಿಗೆ ಮೀನು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತ್ತಲ್ಲ ಆ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವನಿಗೆ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ ನನ್ನ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ ಇವನು ಅಂತ ಈ ರೀತಿ ಬೆಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಶಿಪ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕ್ಕೆ ನಿನಗೆ ನಾಚಿಕೆ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಬೈತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಆಗ ನೋಡ್ತಿದ್ದಂಗೆನೆ ಇವನ್ನ ಕಾಪಾಡಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಈ ಒಂದು ಲೀಡರ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಫೈಟ್ ಗೆ ಎಳಿಯುತ್ತೆ ಈ ಒಂದು ಫೈಟ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಲೀಡರ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಈ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ಗೆ ಸರಿಸರಿ ಹೊಡೆದು ಹಾಕಿಕಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಹೊಡೆದು ಹಾಕಬಿಟ್ಟು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ನ ಹಾರದೆ ಇರೋ ತರನೇ ಅದರ ರೆಕ್ಕೆನೆ ಮುರದಾಕಿಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಮುರದಾಕಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವನ ಟೀಮ್ ಿಂದ ಬಹಿಷ್ಕಾರ ಮಾಡಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇನ್ಮೇಲೆ ನೀನು ನಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಬರಬಾರದು ನಮ್ಮ ಗ್ಯಾಂಗ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನೀನು ಇರಬಾರದು ನಿನ್ನ ಜೀವನ ನೀನು ನೋಡ್ಕೊ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದು ಕೂಡ ಹಾರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಬಟ್ ಆದ್ರೆ ಇದರ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾತಾನೆ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಜಾರಾಗಿ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಬಿಲ್ಲಿಗೂ ಕೂಡ ತುಂಬಾ ಬೇಜಾರಾಗಿ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ನನ್ನಿಂದ ತಾನೇ ಈ ಬರ್ಡ್ಗೆ ಈ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬಂದಿದ್ದು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ಅವನ ಹತ್ರ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಸಾರಿ ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ನನ್ನಿಂದಾನೇ ಈ ರೀತಿ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ತಲೆ ಕೆಡಿಸಕೊಂಬೇಡ ನಾವು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೂಡ ಉಂಟಿನೆ ಈಗ ನೀನು ಕೂಡ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಸೇರಕೋ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಇವರ ಜೊತೆನೆ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಸಲ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಶಿಫ್ಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂದುಬಿಟ್ಟಾಗ ಇವನ ಮುಂದೆ ಡಾಗಿ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಡಾಗಿಗೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಜೊತೆ ಆಟಾಡಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಆಸೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇವನ ಜೊತೆ ಆಟಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಡಾಗಿ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಲೆಮೋರ್ ಇರ್ತಾನಲ್ಲ ಅವನ ಒಂದು ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನ ತಗೊಂಡು ಆಟ ಆಡೋಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಇಬ್ಬರು ಕೂಡ ತೀಟೆಗಳೇ ಅವನು ಕೂಡ ತೀಟೆ ಇವನು ಕೂಡ ತೀಟೆ ಒಬ್ಬರು ಒಬ್ಬರು ಆಟ ಆಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಆ ಬೋಟ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಆಟಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೀಗೆ ಇರ್ತಾರೆ. ಆಗ ಲಿಮೂರ್ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಇವನ ತರನೇ ಇರುವಂತ ಲಿಮೂರ್ಸ್ ಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಆ ಒಂದು ಲಿಮೂರ್ಗಳು ಕೂಡ ಈ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ಗೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಇವರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಬೈದು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಕಳಿಸ್ತಾನೆ. ನೀವೆಲ್ಲ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಬಾರದು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡಿ ಅಂದುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇದರಿಂದ ಲಿಮೂರ್ಗಳು ಕೂಡ ಏನು ಒಬ್ಬನ ಸಾಟಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಬೋಟ್ ಇದೆ ಬರು ಅಂದಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅವರು ಕೂಡ ಅವರ ಪಾಡಿಗೆ ಬೋಟ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೊಂಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಈಗ ಅವರು ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಮಾಡಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರುಡು ಮನೆಗೆ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ ನೈಟ್ ಅಲ್ಲೇ ಈ ಬೋಟ್ನ ಓಡಿಸ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬಿಲಿನೇ ಈ ಬೋಟ್ ನ ಓಡಿಸ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಕರೆಕ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿ ಓಡಿಸ್ತಾ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದರಿಂದ ವೈಟ್ ಬೋರ್ಡೇ ಬಿಡು ನಾನೇ ಓಡಿಸ್ತೀನಿ ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ನಿನ್ನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಇರೋದು ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಅದನ್ನು ಮುರದು ಹಾಕಬಿಟ್ಟಿ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಈ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡೆ ಓಡಿಸಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಇವರು ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಆ ಒಂದು ಉದ್ದು ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಇರುತ್ತಲ್ಲ ಅದರ ಹತ್ತರ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಇವರು ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡು ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದುಬಿಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಬಂದಾಗ ಅದರೊಳಗಡೆ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಅದೊಂತರ ಟನೆಲ್ ರೀತಿ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಇವರೆಲ್ಲ ದಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಡಾಗಿ ಇರುತ್ತಲ್ಲ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವಾಗ್ಲೂ ನೋಡಿ ಆಟಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕು. ಇದರಿಂದ ಆ ಬೋಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಒಂದು ಬಾಲ್ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಆ ಬಾಲ್ನ ತಗೊಂಡು ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ನ ಆಗ್ತಾನೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾನೆ ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿತಾನೆ ತಂದು ದಡುಕ ಆಗ್ತಾನೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಒಂದಷ್ಟು ಮೀನುಗಳನ್ನ ಕಲೆಕ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊತಾನೆ. ಹಾಗೆ ಅವನೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ತಿಂತಾನೆ. ಹಾಗೆ ಆ ಡಾಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೂ ಕೂಡ ಕೊಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಮೀನ ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಒಂದು ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ಗೂ ಕೂಡ ಕೊಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಒಟ್ಟಲೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡು ತಿಂತಾನೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಹಾಗೆಲ್ಲ ಇವರು ಮನಗಿರ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಾಗೆ ಇವರಿಗೆ ಡಾಗಿಗಳು ಬೊಗಳು ಅಂತ ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಈ ಡಾಗಿ ಎದ್ದೋಗಿ ನೋಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದು ಇವರುಗಳ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಗಳೆ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೆ ಅವರನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಕಾಪಾಡೋಣ ಅವರನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ನಮ್ಮ ಬೋಟ್ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಹತ್ತಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ ಅಂತ. ಆದ್ರೆ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದೇ ಇಲ್ಲ ನಾವು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಾಕು ಅವರನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಸೇರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಬೇಡ ಅಂತ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಡಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಈ ಬಿಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ತುಂಬಾ ಫೋರ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡಿರೋದ್ರಿಂದ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ಳರಪ್ಪ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಸುಮ್ಮನಾಗಿಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ ಇವನು ಕೂಡ ಯಾವ ಒಂದು ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರನು ಕೂಡ ಬೋಟ್ನ ಇವರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲರನ್ನು ಕೂಡ ಬೀಳಿಸ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತವೆ ಅವನು ಕೂಡ ಸಿಕ್ಕಪಟ್ಟೆ ಕೋಪ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ ಇವರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನೆಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ಆ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ನ ತುತ್ತು ತುದಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಂದು ಕೂತ್ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೆ ಹಾಗೆ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಮುಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಏನು ಕಲ್ಲ ಹತ್ರ ಕಲ್ಲ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬಂದು ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಒಂದು ಮೆಟ್ಲುಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಆ ಮೆಟ್ಲನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ ಇವಾಗ ಆ ಮೆಟ್ಲು ಕೂಡ ಫುಲ್ ಹೋಗ್ತಾನೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಅದು ಎಲ್ಲಿವರೆಗೂ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೋ ಇವನು ಕೂಡ ಅದನ್ನ ಹಾಗೆ ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ತಾನೆ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆಗ ನೋಡ್ತಿದ್ದಂಗೆನೆ ಇವನು ಆ ಒಂದು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತುತ್ತ ತುದಿಗೆ ಬಂದುಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವೈಟ್ ಬರ್ಡ್ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಅದರ ಹತ್ರ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಏನಂತ ಕಿಲಿಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದೆ ಅಂತ ಹಾಗೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಅದರ ಅಕ್ಕ ಪಕ್ಕ ಇದ್ದಂತಹ ಹನಿಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಗಾಳಿಲಿ ತೇಲಾಡಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರುವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಆವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲೊಂದು ಕಾಸ್ಮಿಕ್ ಎನರ್ಜಿ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಆಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರುವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಇಬ್ಬರು ಕೂಡ ಗಾಳಿಲಿ ತೇಲಾಡ್ತಾ ಆ ಒಂದು ಕಾಸ್ಮಿಕ್ ಎನರ್ಜಿ ಒಳಗಡೆ ಹೋಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಏನಪ್ಪಾ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಅದರೊಳಗಡೆ ಹೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇವನು ಕೆಳಗಡೆ ಬಂದುಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಬರ್ಡ್ಡು ಅದರೊಳಗಡೆ ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಹೊರಟು ಹೋಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಮಾಯಾನೆ ಆಗಿಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿಗಂತೂ ಸಿಕ್ಕಪಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಜಾರಾಗಿ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋದ ಇವನು ಇಷ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬಿಲ್ಲಿಗಂತೂ ಏನು ಅರ್ಥನೇ ಆಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಈಗ ನೆಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ ಏನು ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ನಾನು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ ಇವನು ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಕಾಣುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಅದರೊಳಗಡೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡೋಣ ಮತ್ತೆ ನನ್ನ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಹತ್ರ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮತ್ತೆ ಇವನು ದಡಕ್ಕೆ ಬರ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ ಬೋಟ್ ಇವನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಾ ದೂರ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಈ ಹೊಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡೋಣ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇದು ಮತ್ತೆ ಆ ನೀರಿಗೆ ಹಾರಿಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾರ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೀಗೆ ಈ ಹೊಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಬಟ್ ಆದ್ರೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕ್ಯಾಚ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಹಾಗೆ ಅಲ್ಲೊಂದು ಬಲೂನ್ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಇವರು ಕಿತ್ತಾಡ್ತಿದ್ರಲ್ಲ ಆವಾಗಲೇ ಆ ಒಂದು ಬಲೂನ್ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಇವನು ಈ ಹೊಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಆಗ ನೋಡ್ತಾ ನೋಡ್ತಿದ್ದಂಗೆನೆ ಆ ಜಾಗ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಬದಲಾಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರುವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಏನಪ್ಪಾ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲ ಗಿಡ ಮರಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಬೆಳ್ಕೊಂಡು ಮತ್ತೆ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಗುಟ್ಟ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬೆಳ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹಾಗೆ ನಾರ್ಮಲ್ ಈಗ ಭೂಮಿ ಹೇಗೆ ನಾರ್ಮಲ್ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೋ ಆ ರೀತಿ ಆಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಆಗ್ಬಿಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದೇನು ನಡೀತಾ ಇದೆ ಅಂತನ ಗೊತ್ತೆ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರೋದೆಲ್ಲ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿದಂತು ಮತ್ತೆ ಆ ನೀರಿನ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಆಗಿ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಗಳನ್ನ ಹುಡುಕೋಣ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಈಗ ಮತ್ತೆ ಇವನು ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಮಾಡಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ನ ಹುಡುಕ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ ಎಲ್ಲೂ ಕೂಡ ಸಿಗನೆ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಈ ಲಿಮೂರ್ ಒಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟಿ ಇಟ್ಕೊಂಡಿರ್ತಾನಲ್ಲ ಯಾವಾಗ್ಲೂ ಆ ಪುಟ್ಟಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅದನ್ನ ನೋಡ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋದ್ರೆ ಸಿಗ್ತಾನೆ ಅಂತ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಲಿಮೂರನ ಒಂದು ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಒಂದು ಸೈಡ್ಗೆ ಬಂದು ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಇವನ ತರನೇ ತುಂಬಾ ಜನ ಇರ್ತಾರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ. ಹಾಗೆ ಅದರೊಳಗಡೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಲಿಮೂರ್ ಇವನಿಗೆ ಸಿಗತಾನೆ. ಅವನು ಅವರ ಗ್ಯಾಂಗಗಳಲ್ ಜೊತೆ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬೇರೆಯವರೆಲ್ಲ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾ ನನಗೆ ತೋರಿಸುವರನ್ನ ಹುಡುಕೋನ ಅಂದಾಗ ಇವನು ಅದಕ್ಕೆಲ್ಲ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದಿಲ್ಲ ನಾನು ಬರಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬಿಲಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಪಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಜಾರ ಆಗ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನಾನೇ ಹುಡ್ಕೊತೀನಿ ಅಂದಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಇವನು ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರೋದನ್ನ ನೋಡಿ ಇವನಿಗೂ ಬೇಜಾರಾಗಿಬಿಟ್ಟು ಸರಿ ಆಯ್ತು ಬಾ ನಿನಗೆ ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅವರನ್ನ ತೋರಿಸೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಈ ಒಂದು ಜಾಗ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಒಂದು ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಗಾಕೊಂಡು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಇವಾಗ ಮರ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗೋಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಇವರುಗಳನ್ನ ಹೇಗಾದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡಿ ಕಾಪಾಡಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಇರ್ತಾರೆ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಆ ಮರ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗೋ ಟೈಮ್ಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಒಂದು ಬೋಟ್ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬಿಂಡ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಡಾಗಿಗಳು ಈ ಸೈಡ್ಗೆ ಬಂದುಬಿಡ್ತಾವೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಟ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇನ್ನು ಅಲ್ಲೇ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಮರ ಇನ್ನು ಬೆಂಡಾಗಿರೋದ್ರಿಂದ ಆ ಒಂದು ಲೆಂತ್ ಸಿಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಗರೋದಿಕ್ಕೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಆ ಮರನ ಹತ್ತುತ್ತೆ. ಹತ್ತಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆ ಬೋಟ್ ಮುಂದಗಡೆ ಒಂದು ದಾರ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಆ ದಾರನ ಇವರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಎಸಿಯುತ್ತೆ. ಅದನ್ನ ಹಿಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೇಳಿರಿ ಬೋಟ್ ಹತ್ರ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಅವನು ಹೆಗರುಕೊತಾನೆ ಅಂತ. ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ ಆ ಡಾಗ್ಗಳು ಕೂಡ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ಎಳಿತಾ ಇರ್ತಾವೆ ಆ ಬೋಟ್ಗಳನ್ನ ಇವರ ಕಡಿಕೆ. ಈ ಗ್ಯಾಪ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಮಾರ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗೋ ಟೈಮ್ಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿನು ಕೂಡ ಕೆಳಗಡೆ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬಾರ ಕ್ಯಾಚ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡುಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಡಾಗಿಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಎಳಿತಿರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಮೊಲ ಪಾಸ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅದನ್ನ ನೋಡ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಡಾಗಿಗಳು ಅದನ್ನೇ ಹಿಡಿಯೋಕೆ ಅಂತ ಒಟ್ಟು ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಹೋಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆ ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಡಾಗ್ ಇವರನ್ನ ಕಾಪಾಡಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ತನ್ನ ಪವರ್ಸ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಯೂಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೆಳಿಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿ ಬರನು ಕೂಡ ಸೂಪರ್ ಆಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಜಂಪ್ ಮಾಡಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಬೋಟು ಸಿಸ್ತಾಗಿ ಆ ಪಾತಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಫುಲ್ ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿ ಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಗಳು ಕೂಡ ಸೇಫ್ ಆಗಿ ಒಂದಾದ್ವಲ್ಲ ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೀಗೆ ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿರಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಈ ಜಿಂಕೆಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಓಡಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾವೆ. ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಿದ್ನಲ್ಲ ಜಿಂಕೆಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಓಡೋದಾಗ ಮತ್ತೆ ಈ ಸುನಾಮಿ ಬಂತು ಅಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇವಾಗ ಹೆದುರುಕೊಂಡು ಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ ಇವನು ಹೆದುರುಕೊಂಡು ಮತ್ತೆ ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಹತ್ರ ಓಡಹೋಗ್ಬಿಡೋಣ ಅವಾಗೆಲ್ಲ ಸುರೋಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ಲೋಡ್ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ ಇವನು ಹೋಗೋ ದಾರಿಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀಲ್ನ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಅದು ನೀರಿಲ್ಲದಲೇ ಒದ್ದಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾಗೆ ಅದರ ಹತ್ರ ಬಂದ್ಬಿಟ್ಟು ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದೀಯಾ ನೀನು ನಿನಗೂ ಹೇಗಾದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಹಾಗೆ ಅದರ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಾಗ text: Superman. Great guy. Hey buddy, eyes up here. The narrative begins at a point of extreme vulnerability for the man of steel. A Superman lying almost defeated in desolate, icy Antarctica. It's a setting that drastically contrasts with the invulnerable image the world has of him. Blood drips from his nose. His breath is ragged. And the brutal fight he just endured has left him on the brink of death. The rawness of the scene is palpable. A hero, a god to many, reduced to a fragile figure in an unforgiving environment. Amidst the freezing blizzard, a silhouette materializes, dispelling the despair. It's Krypto, his loyal and beautiful superdog, who oblivious to the gravity of his master's situation, jumps on him with his tail wagging, offering a moment of pure innocence and devotion. With the little strength he has left, Superman begs his faithful companion to take him home. The icy surface suddenly opens, revealing the majestic fortress of solitude. This crystal bastion with the unmistakable S etched into its door emerges as a technological and spiritual sanctuary. Immediately, Superman's robots rush to assist him. Their automatism contrasts with the hero's humanity. Despite Superman thanking them, the robots coldly inform him that they lack consciousness and their sole function is to serve. His gratitude therefore holds no meaning for them, a subtle reminder of the inherent solitude of his existence as the last son of Krypton. To help him calm down and accelerate his recovery, the robots activate a projection, a message from his biological parents, Jorel and Lara. In the recording, his parents explained the desperate act of sending him from the dying planet Krypton to Earth to save him, imbuing him with a love that transcends heaven and earth and placing all their hopes in him. However, the transmission abruptly cuts out. Only half of the message survived the arduous journey to Earth, the rest lost or damaged. The robots diagnose him with 14 broken bones in addition to kidney, liver, and bladder damage. He desperately needs a large dose of solar radiation to heal completely. So they take him directly under the sunlight, a vital process for the recovery of his extraordinary powers. As Superman recovers, the narrative introduces us to Angela Spa, a metahuman serving Lex Luthor. Angela is tracking Superman in Antarctica, but radios her team that for now she cannot locate him. Luthor's presence in the plot already looms like a shadow, anticipating the intrigue and adversity to come. Still at 85% recovery, Superman, disregarding his robot's warnings, insists on returning to action, his determination is unwavering, driven by a sense of duty that goes beyond his own safety. At the same time, we witness the minations of Lex Luthor, who leads his team with a single objective, to bring down Superman. It's in this context that the enigmatic hammer of Boravia appears, delivering a brutal blow to Superman, leaving him on the ground totally defenseless. The precision of the attack is alarming, as if the adversary knew Superman's every move in advance. At this critical moment, a civilian, Malikali, who once shared a meal with Superman, runs to help him to his feet. However, Luor immediately locates the civilian, revealing the extent of his surveillance. Angela, meanwhile, tracks Superman to the Fortress of Solitude, catching a brief glimpse before the hero disappears. Luthor from the comfort of his office observes everything through a network of cameras he has strategically installed, demonstrating his ability to manipulate information and events. The hammer of Bovia proclaims that this will be Superman's final fight and the crowd seeing him on the ground begins to mock him. The plot becomes more complex as it's revealed that the hammer of Boravia is not who he claims to be. He is a powerful robot named Ultraman who has been impersonating the hammer of Boravia to deceive the public. Luther explains that Ultraman has spent decades meticulously studying Superman's every move. Back in Metropolis, Clark Kent returns to his job as a journalist. He receives a warm call from his adoptive parents, reminding him of their love and asking him not to forget them. Clark's brevity in the conversation, though understandable given the pressure he faces, suggests a tension between his two lives. Lois Lane appears, playfully joking with Clark, her usual light-hearted demeanor contrasting with the seriousness of the events around them. News reports state that Vassel, the president of Boravia, publicly denies any connection between his country and the hammer of Boravia. Clark mentions his numerous interviews with Superman, while news broadcasts show how public opinion has started to turn against the hero. At Luther Corp, Lex Luthor gathers a group of business elites, introducing them to Ultramen and a squad of raptors, superpowered beings created to eliminate extraterrestrial threats. Luther tries to convince them to invest in his metahumans, arguing that Superman is a potential threat. However, the representatives object, pointing out that Superman has prevented a war and remains popular. Luther insists on Superman's danger, though he admits to having no solid proof, which leads the representatives to refuse to take drastic measures. Lois and Clark, after 3 months without a date, finally have their night out. They discuss the recent chaos surrounding the Hammer of Bavia. Superman asks Lois for an interview, which she accepts. The recording begins and Lois gets straight to the point, asking about the pressure he's been receiving. She notes that even the secretary of defense has announced an investigation into his actions in Boravia. Superman explains his intervention in Jarampa and his conversation with the president of Moravia, but refuses to share details, claiming it's private. Clark responds that he acted because he's convinced the Boravian government harbors shady intentions. Lois asks if he at least asked permission to enter Boravian airspace, and Superman admits he didn't. He states he acted solely on his own, doing what he believed was right, as many lives were at stake. Lois tells him she's received a lot of social media criticism due to the situation, but Superman replies he doesn't have time for social media. Superman confides in Lois about his biological parents, revealing he's from Krypton, a planet that no longer exists, annihilated along with its history, culture, and everything he ever loved. He shares how his parents sent him to Earth to save him and give him the opportunity to serve humanity. Lois confesses that a large part of the public suspects he's on Earth for some shady or secret reason, which completely angers Clark. Frustrated, Lois admits she more or less expected this conversation wouldn't go well and says relationships have never been her strong suit. Hearing that, Clark decides to leave without a word, walking away and leaving Lois alone in her thoughts. This moment underscores Superman's difficulty in reconciling his Kryptonian identity with his role as Earth's protector and the pressure he feels to be transparent while protecting his origins. Meanwhile, in Antarctica, Luther and his team arrive at Superman's ice fortress. Surprisingly, Luther manages to activate and fully invade the place, even though Angela has no idea how he did it, as it's supposed to only open with Superman's DNA. With his superhumans, Luor annihilates all the robots in his path. With Angela being of great help, Krypto appears but is merely covered and pushed aside given no real prominence. The true reason for Luthor's presence is to unearth incriminating evidence against Superman. Simultaneously, Otus, a member of the Luthor Corp team, arrives in Metropolis carrying a box with something dangerous inside. The plan is to unleash it and keep Superman distracted while crucial information is extracted from his fortress. Back with Angela, she's busy working to recover the rest of the damaged message from Superman's parents. Finally managing to reconstruct it after a great effort. In Metropolis, Otis unleashes the small creature, which quickly grows into a giant beast. Superman rushes to save a dog about to be crushed. Lois watches the chaos unfold on the news. Suddenly, the Justice League bursts onto the scene with Hawk Girl, Green Lantern, and Mr. Terrific in the lineup. Together, they manage to take down the monster. Just as the enormous creature is about to collapse and crush the crowd, Superman intervenes to ensure everyone gets out safely. Yet, even after this heroic act, no one applauds. News outlets have been spreading stories that Superman is actually a menace, sowing distrust in the public. News reports confirmed that fortunately, there were no casualties, but public perception of Superman remains negative. It's revealed that the full message from his parents, supposedly recovered by Angela and analyzed by 28 of the world's best linguists, contains an alarming translation. In it, his parents say they love him, that Krypton is gone forever, but hope rests in him because Earth is the best place for him. However, they also state that the people of Earth are simple, confused, and weak-minded. Therefore, as the last son of Krypton, he must eliminate anyone who cannot serve him and honor his legacy by ruling mercilessly. This revelation is devastating. Luor seizes the opportunity to publicly declare that Superman is subjugating humanity and paving the way for his descendants to take over Earth, something Luther swears he will never allow. Superman wanders the streets, heartbroken as people hurl insults and accusations at him. Finally, he retreats to a room where Green Lantern appears, ready to confront him, convinced after hearing Superman's parents' message that Superman is indeed a threat. But Superman insists he never heard the complete message because the second half was damaged on route. Just then, Mr. Terrific intervenes, telling him that the forensic department wouldn't have certified the message as authentic if there had been the slightest doubt. So, there's no way it's fake. Hearing that, Superman decides to return directly to the Fortress of Ice, convinced it's the only place the original recording could have come from. Meanwhile, representatives from different countries gather for an emergency summit to debate whether Superman is truly a threat to the planet. On the news, the president of Boravia appears, claiming that Superman only intervened in Boravia's invasion of Jarampa to enslave its people and keep them under his control. After finishing the interview, the president returns to his office and slips through a secret portal that leads directly to Luther. The president is animated, thinking they've successfully taken Superman out of the game thanks to the supposedly false message Luor fabricated. But Luther corrects him, explaining that the message is actually true. He tells him that taking down Superman was ridiculously easy and part of the reason was due to Superman's own parents. When Superman arrives at his fortress and finds it completely destroyed, he encounters one of his robots, F, who admits he did his best to protect it, but couldn't complete his mission. Just after saying that, he shuts down in Superman's arms, leaving him visibly affected. Soon after, Superman realizes Krypto is missing. Determined, he heads directly to Luther Cororp to demand that Luther tell him where Krypto is, but Luther swears he has no idea what Superman is talking about. As the two argue, Eve, Luthor's girlfriend, secretly films them and streams the entire conversation live. At the same time, news outlets begin showing footage of Peacemaker, who seizes the opportunity to rant about Superman. Completely broken, Superman appears at Lois's apartment. She's surprised and casually mentions she didn't even know he had a dog, then sweetly offers him a cup of hot chocolate. Superman finally opens up and tells her that the ship he was sent in was damaged on the way to Earth and he'd only been able to hear the first half of his parents' recording. Lois, trying to support him, tells him she believes him, but also points out that one of his biggest flaws is blindly trusting everyone and assuming all humans are good-hearted. Superman whispers that he loves her and the two say goodbye, marking a moment of deep emotional connection amidst the adversity. The next day, Superman surrenders to Luthor's soldiers, who immediately throw him to the ground and mercilessly beat him. After that, he's put on a ship and taken to one of Luthor's secret desert bases. Once there, a squad of raptors escorts him to a pocket universe, which Luthor created by opening a small rift between the two worlds, accessible via multiple portals scattered across the planet. Finally, they arrive at a hidden prison where Luor keeps all kinds of people locked up on Baravia's orders. Among the prisoners are troublemakers, inconvenient political figures, and even some of Luthor's ex-girlfriends. He's even imprisoned a woman whose only crime was writing a bitter breakup blog about him. Superman is then thrown into a cell with Rex, a shape- shifter who can transform his body however he wants. Luthor orders Rex to transform one of his hands into kryptonite, the only thing that can weaken Superman. Rex has no choice but to obey because Luthor has his son captive in a cell within the same prison. Luthor's morality is further revealed as perverse, torturing innocents to control the powerful. Meanwhile, back at the newspaper office, Lois is investigating why Luther Corp is meddling in Boravian affairs. During her search, she stumbles upon something alarming. Luther Corp had been selling weapons to Boravia at ridiculously low prices. Just then, Jimmy, her colleague, appears and tells her that thanks to a contact, he discovered that Superman is trapped in a pocket universe. Inside that pocket universe, Luor appears before Superman and drops the bombshell that they have Krypto under their control. Luther tells him that the dog will remain locked up, be examined and investigated and eventually be sacrificed forever, but not before going through a lot of pain. Still, she promises to investigate further as long as Jimmy agrees to go on a date with her. Instead of helping, he pushes the kryptonite even closer to Superman, leaving him writhing in agony. At the same time, Lois meets with the Justice League, determined to find Superman and get him out of there. Mr. Terrific manages to track Superman's location thanks to the nano sensors he had secretly implanted in Superman's bloodstream earlier. He tells the team that Superman is in an abandoned military base. And although the signal cuts out there, he confirms that Superman is trapped in a pocket universe. But Green Lantern and Hawk Girl aren't exactly eager to join the rescue mission. Both say they don't want to fight to save Superman. Once he clears the path, the two continue to advance and finally reach a tent containing the entrance to the pocket universe. There, Mr. Terrific explains to Lois how dangerous it is to create a pocket universe, as it could trigger a black hole and tear space apart every time someone enters or exits. Once inside, they come face to face with a river of antirotons blocking their way. If they tried to cross it, they'd be vaporized in seconds and would never reach Superman. Back in the cell, where Superman is still imprisoned, Rex explains that although he cannot create a real sun, he can improvise something similar by mixing various substances his body produces. When Superman is fully recovered, he immediately flies to Rex's son's cell and takes him out, reuniting the baby with his father. Together, they set out to find Krypto. Just as they are about to escape, they are ambushed and pushed directly towards the river of anti-rotons. At that moment, Krypto bravely jumps in to help. At the most critical moment, Superman is about to be absorbed by a black hole and desperately shouts Krypto's name. Rex also rushes to help. And thanks to their efforts and Superman's powerful breath, they manage to get to safety. Mr. Terrific finds them and jumps in to help them escape, pulling everyone out just before the portal closes forever. After the escape, Superman and Lois reunite, although Superman is still weak, he tells Lois that there are more people who still need to be saved. Hearing this, Mr. Terrific offers his ship so he can travel safely. Meanwhile, Eve contacts Jimmy and tells him she has all the information they need to bring Luther down. But before handing it over, she makes Jimmy promise to go on a date with her on Saturday, just the two of them. But then, out of nowhere, Luther appears, snatches Eve, and although she manages to send some files, it turns out everything she transmitted were provocative selfies of herself. Later, Lois goes with Superman to visit Clark's parents. Not long after, Jimmy contacts Lois to tell her about Eve and sends her the photos. To everyone's surprise, hidden in the background of those selfies are crucial data files belonging to Luor, which actually turn out to be super important. Eve's cleverness in disguising vital information in a seemingly frivolous format demonstrates her ingenuity and her courage in betraying Luor. Meanwhile, Luthor prepares to reopen the portal to the pocket universe. Although doing so could open a three-dimensional fissure, the possibility of such a massive catastrophe doesn't affect Luthor at all. He goes ahead and activates the Fisser, demonstrating exactly why creating a pocket universe is always a terrible idea. The next day, Superman's father, Jonathan Kent, tells him that Lois is a good woman and that he's noticed Clark has been different lately. Superman admits he feels terrible because his biological parents sent him here to kill. But Jonathan Kent tells him that parents don't decide what their children want to be. It's their choices and actions that make him the man he is. And today, Jonathan says he couldn't be prouder of him. They share a hug. This moment is crucial for Superman's identity redefinition, reaffirming that his values and decisions define him, not his origin. Meanwhile, Green Lantern is watching the news about the war raging in Boravia. Superman also sees it and learns that the children of Boravia are asking for his help. So, he's ready to go there. But Terrific intervenes and tells Superman about the fissure, saying he has to deal with that first because it could wipe out the entire Earth. Later, Jimmy and Lois brief Perry, the head of the news communications department. They explain that Luor is pulling all these strings because he wants to keep half of Jiren for himself and that he's plotting to crown himself king. He's even in cahoots with the president of Moravia, Vassel, who created the Fisser specifically to distract Superman and prevent him from intervening during the war. Mr. Terrific can't stop the Fiser, nor can the Luthor Corp team because Luthor flatly refuses to. So, they end up pulling the ship out of the building. Mr. Terrific explains that there's a code that can close the Fisher, and it's stored at Luther Corp., but before Superman can go get it, he has to find Krypto, whom he' taken for a walk so the dog wouldn't go around killing his parents' cows. Then Ultraman appears and drags Superman to a football stadium where they end up fighting alongside the metahuman Angela. Luthor orders Angela to fill Superman's lungs with air and she does so as Luthor watches. With Superman literally on the verge of death, Vassel is sent to start the war. Superman's body is plagued with nanites and Luthor tells Angela to finish injecting them completely. Superman rises as high as he can, even leaving the planet. And when he can't go any further, they fall at full speed. It's a fall Angela couldn't even survive due to the impact. But when they land, Superman is still alive and manages to expel all the nanites from his body. Luthor then sends the raptors because they realize Angela is somehow still alive, though barely standing, and Ultraman has also survived. It's then that Ultra Man's mask falls off and Superman realizes he's been cloned. Luther had dug through the debris left after Superman's battles and found a single hair that he used to create the clone. That's how Ultra Man was able to open Superman's Fortress of Solitude because he has his DNA. But the clone turned out to be defective. He's clumsiest than Superman, easier to control, though physically stronger. So Luor orders Ultra Man to hit Superman with everything he's got, trying to prove that intelligence trumps brute force. Elsewhere, we see a small child praying for Superman to come save them from the war. Superman tells Luthor that no matter what he does, he won't win. And his plans in Bavia are doomed to fail because he's called some friends. It turns out he sent the Justice League, who arrived to help stop the war alongside Rex and his baby. Meanwhile, Perry says they're ready to publish the whole truth. As Jimmy and Lois now know everything Luor has been doing, that he's been instigating the war just to have an excuse to kill Superman. Luthor wants Superman dead because, as he admits, Superman is supposedly destroying everyone. And deep down, Luthor is consumed by envy, a feeling that has driven him throughout this nefarious plot. Superman, even as he's being beaten, smiles and declares that mind overcomes force. Then he calls Krypto. Once Superman frees himself from his clone, he sends Krypto to collect the spheres, which were actually surveillance cameras Luor had placed. Just then, the raptors also appear and Superman prepares to face them. After taking down the raptors, the clone returns for more, trying to keep hitting him. But this time, Superman fights back with even more force and sends the clone flying directly into a black hole, eliminating this distorted threat of his own image. Then he heads with Mr. Terrific to close the Fisser. And they arrive at Luther Corp. Superman declares that he is as human as anyone else, that he knows how to love, and that he also has fear. He says that every day when he wakes up, he puts one foot in front of the other and keeps going and that he makes many mistakes because that's what being human is about. He says he hopes that one day Luthor will understand that. But Luthor replies that he doesn't care because the governments have given him the green light to kill Superman. It is then that Krypto intervenes and begins to give Luthor a serious beating. Meanwhile, Lois and the rest of the team observe how everything unfolds and they see how the fissure finally closes thanks to Mr. Terrific who deciphered the code. Krypto's intervention often underestimated is crucial at this moment. Reminding us that even at the height of his power, Superman is not alone. On the news, everything comes to light about Luor. His secret collusion with Vassel and the government of Baravia. Now the whole world knows that Luthor is a traitor. It is revealed that the whole world had turned against Superman. But now everyone realizes that they owe him an apology. Superman is and always will be the hero they believed in from the beginning. Luthor is arrested and all the prisoners he held, including his ex-girlfriends, are released. Eve reunites with Jimmy and later Lois meets Superman. She goes to interview him somewhere private, but it's actually just an excuse to kiss. In the end, Lois tells Superman that she loves him too, solidifying their relationship and providing a moment of joy and hope. Afterward, Superman returns to his fortress of solitude, where his robots have fixed everything and even repaired themselves. A little later, his cousin Supergirl appears. It turns out she's Krypto's true owner and loves to party on other planets, as their Kryptonian metabolism prevents them from getting drunk under yellow suns. That's why she prefers to travel to worlds with red suns. Now, Superman prepares to relax, watching a message from his human parents, recalling all his memories, and feeling truly happy. Superman's story then is a continuous cycle of challenge, sacrifice, and redemption. A reminder that even the greatest heroes face doubts and adversities..

text: Here's my weekly movie review recap. How to Make a Killing is a dark comedy crime thriller about a blue-collar man willing to eliminate anyone standing between him and his inheritance. The inheritance plot is genuinely engaging and keeps you invested in how far he's willing to go to get this fortune. Margaret Qualley brings another great performance. She's seductive, scene-stealing, has unpredictability, and elevates this material. Glenn Powell plays it cool and restrained, and the polished production design, crisp sound work, and dark comedy give this movie some bite. The third act is where this movie really unravels. Momentum stalls, Powell never fully realizes the anti-hero role, and the finale feels rushed and illogical instead of delivering a sharper, more satisfying ending the premise sets up. Watch it, but set your expectations. The first half really hooks you, but the ending doesn't hit quite with the same force. Psycho Killer is a serial killer revenge slasher horror movie about a highway patrol officer hunting down the man who murdered her husband. There are brief flashes of visual promise like you'll see in the trailer. There's moody lighting that suggests the director had technical competence. Georgina Campbell also gives a committed performance even though she didn't have much to work with. This movie was really bad. One of the worst horror movies that was a theatrical release in years. The biggest issue is the killer. There's no menace, no mythology, no identity, just random guy in a mask. Most kills happen offscreen. The CGI gore looks really cheap and fake when it does appear. And the dialogue is painfully rough. Skip it. This commits nearly every modern slasher horror movie sin: sanitized violence, a generic villain, and a finale that fizzles instead of exploding. This Is Not a Test is a young adult zombie survival thriller about a teenage girl and her classmates sheltering in their high school as infected close in. Olivia Holt is the emotional backbone of this film. She brings real presence and weight to this role. The confined setting in the high school builds solid early tension and the resourceful direction makes smart use of the right framing even with a limited amount of effective gore. Biggest issue is the writing. It leans heavily on familiar zombie lockdown beats without adding any surprises. Outside Holt, most of these supporting characters are lightly sketched out. The middle stretch loses momentum and the rushed ending just undercuts the emotional payoff. I am going to say stream this, watch it later. It's competently made and emotionally grounded. Think Breakfast Club meets zombie apocalypse drama, but if you're expecting sustained zombie horror, this won't satisfy you. This is Rusty Rails, out until next time.

text: In an isolated mountain chalet near Grenoble, Samuel Maleski is playing music in his attic so loudly that his wife, novelist Sandra Voyter, asks to reschedule with the female student interviewing her. Their son, Daniel, returns from a long walk with his guide dog Snoop to find Samuel dead below his attic window. Talking to an old friend, lawyer Vincent Renzi, she says the fall must have been accidental. When Vincent says that the court will not believe that, Sandra tells Vincent about Samuel's attempt to overdose on aspirin six months earlier, after having gone off antidepressants. Vincent notes a bruise on her arm, which she tells him occurred from bumping into a countertop. Daniel tells the police investigation that his parents were having a calm talk when he left the house but gives conflicting accounts of exactly where he was standing. This, combined with an autopsy revealing Samuel's head wound occurring before his body hit the ground, blood spatter, and an audio recording Samuel made of a fight he and Sandra had the day before he died, prompts an indictment. During the trial, Sandra's defense team claims Samuel fell from the attic window and hit his head on a shed, while the prosecution's theory is that Sandra hit him with a blunt object and pushed him from the third-floor balcony. During a courtroom argument with Samuel's psychiatrist, who insists Samuel had no suicidal intent, she talks of her resentment towards Samuel. In the recorded fight, Samuel accuses her of plagiarism, infidelity, and exerting control over his life. The protracted argument turns physically violent, but it's not clear who is hitting whom. The prosecution claims that all the violence was coming from Sandra. She says that she had thrown a glass at a wall and slapped Samuel's face, and that the bruises on her arms were due to Samuel grabbing her, and that the rest of the violence heard was Samuel beating on himself. After Sandra admits to having had an affair with a woman the year before Samuel's death, the prosecution argues that Samuel's loud music indicated jealousy over Sandra's flirting with the interviewer, leading to a physical confrontation where the prosecution claims Sandra killed him. The prosecutor notes her pattern of writing her personal conflicts into her stories and how murdering Samuel could mirror a minor character's thoughts from her most recent novel. Sandra protests that one audio recording does not remotely represent the nature of their marriage, nor do the words of a character in one of her novels reflect her own inclinations. Disturbed by what has transpired, Daniel insists on testifying before closing arguments the following Monday, and the judge lays strict ground rules to prevent anyone from influencing Daniel's testimony. Daniel then asks that Sandra leave their house for the weekend so there will only be his court monitor, Marge, to watch over him and Snoop. After hearing Sandra's testimony about Samuel's aspirin overdose, Daniel has remembered that Snoop became sick at that time and now suspects that Snoop had eaten some of Samuel's vomit, so that weekend he deliberately feeds Snoop aspirin and finds it has the same effect, which aligns with Sandra's testimony. Daniel confides to Marge his anguish over trying to determine what is truth, who advises him that sometimes when we don't know what's really true, we can instead just decide what's true for us. On the witness stand, Daniel says that if his mother did this, he can't understand it, but if his father did it, he can. He testifies that when he and Samuel were driving Snoop to the veterinarian, his father spoke to him about the need to be prepared that those he loves will die and to know that his life will go on, which Daniel now sees as Samuel's own suicidal thoughts. Sandra is soon acquitted after Daniel's testimony. When she comes home, Daniel tells her he was afraid of her homecoming and she says that she was too, which leads to a warm reuniting hug. As Sandra heads off to bed, she lingers at a photo of her and Samuel before falling asleep with Snoop.

text: In 2002, during the initial outbreak of the Rage virus, Jimmy Crystal flees his house in the Scottish Highlands as his family are attacked by the infected. He takes refuge in the local church with his father, a minister, but finds him praying in ecstasy because he interprets the virus as a harbinger of the end times. Jimmy's father bequeaths him a cross necklace and helps him to safety before submitting to the infected as they break in. Twenty-eight years after its second outbreak, the Rage virus has been eradicated from continental Europe. The British Isles remain under indefinite quarantine with few survivors. A civilised community has subsisted on Lindisfarne, an island defended naturally from Great Britain by a causeway that floods with the tide. Among them are Jamie, a scavenger; his wife, Isla, who has a mentally debilitating illness; and their 12-year-old son, Spike. Jamie and Spike cross to mainland Britain for a coming-of-age hunting ritual. They find an infected tied up and branded with the name "Jimmy". They then escape a pack of infected who are led by an "alpha", an evolved infected that is stronger and more intelligent than the others. Jamie and Spike shelter overnight in the attic of a run-down cottage, where Spike observes foreign boats on quarantine patrol and a fire further inland. When the attic collapses, the alpha pursues Jamie and Spike across the partially inundated causeway until the village sentries kill it with a ballista. The village throws a party for Spike to celebrate his first kill. Spike is upset by Jamie's embellishment of his deeds, and he discovers Jamie's affair with Rosie, the village schoolteacher. He discusses the fire with a family friend, Sam, who suggests that it was made by Dr Ian Kelson, a former doctor in exile. The next morning, Spike confronts Jamie over his unwillingness to seek medical care for Isla and his infidelity. Jamie insists that Kelson, whom he once witnessed burning corpses en masse, is too mentally unstable to help. Unconvinced, Spike and Isla escape the island and journey to mainland Britain. Spike and Isla are rescued from a pack of infected by Swedish Navy seaman Erik, the sole survivor of a stranded NATO quarantine patrol boat. Isla discovers a pregnant infected and helps it deliver an uninfected baby girl. A paranoid Erik shoots the infected mother and threatens to kill Isla and Spike alongside the newborn if they do not let him kill it, but an alpha appears and decapitates Erik. Spike, Isla, and the newborn flee from the alpha, and Spike shoots him with arrows; despite this, the alpha catches up with Spike. Dr. Kelson appears and temporarily subdues the alpha (whom he has named Samson) with a blowgun and a tranquilizer dart. Kelson leads Spike and Isla to a monument he has constructed out of cleaned human bones. He explains the idea of memento mori—meaning a reminder of the inevitibilty of death—and uses Erik’s skull in the monument. Kelson examines Isla and deduces that she has advanced terminal cancer. Kelson consoles Spike with the phrase memento amoris – which means "remember you must love". Isla and Spike share their last moment together as she accepts her mortality and arranges for Kelson to euthanize her, after which he gives her skull to Spike to place at the top of the monument. When Samson infiltrates Kelson's sanctuary, Spike subdues him with a medicated dart and saves Kelson's life. Kelson encourages Spike to go home with the infant. Instead, Spike leaves her at the village gate and returns to the mainland, still disillusioned. Jamie reads a note from Spike that reveals he has named the infant after Isla and promises he will return when he is ready. Jamie tries to follow Spike to the mainland but is blocked by the rising tide. Twenty-eight days later, Spike is rescued from a pack of infected by a group styled after Jimmy Savile, a once-famous British TV personality later revealed to be a serial abuser. Their leader, the adult Jimmy Crystal, bears an inverted cross.

text: The movie begins with a boy named Sho, who visits his grandmother's house to spend some time. After getting out of the car, he watches a cat playing with the plants in the garden. He thinks he sees a tiny girl in the plants. She was hiding from both him and the cat. Before he can find out more, his grandmother calls him and he goes inside. Once Sho leaves, the tiny girl escapes the cat by going under a vent. It is revealed that she has a home under the vent near a storage area. Her name is Arrietty, and she lives there with her parents. They collect small things that humans wouldn't miss if they disappeared. This is why they are called "Borrowers," because they borrow what they need. Later, Arrietty's father returns home after a borrowing mission. He tells the family that a new boy is living in the house above them. Arrietty then tells her parents about her encounter in the garden. At dinner, her father tells her she is ready for her very first borrowing mission. Arrietty is excited. She packs her gear and heads out with her father. Using a small pulley system, they make their way into the human part of the house. Her father prepares by putting double-sided tape on their feet to help them climb. Arrietty watches the giant humans nearby while they are eating their meal. Once the humans leave, they enter the kitchen to start their mission. Arrietty is amazed and shocked by the size of the human furniture. Her father points to a sugar bowl on a table across the room. He tells her that their goal is to reach that table. They climb down using a long piece of thread as a rope. Using the tape on his feet, Arrietty's father climbs up the table like a spider. They reach the top. Arrietty follows him and stands by his side. Her father hands her a sugar cube, which she carefully puts in her bag. She finds a pin on the floor and picks it up to use as a sword. Her father tells her that this is her first successful borrow, and she is very happy. Traveling through a narrow path, they reach a place with items suited to their size. Her father explains that they have found a beautiful, man-made dollhouse. As they leave the dollhouse, Arrietty notices that Sho is staring at them. She panics and accidentally drops her sugar cube. Sho tells her not to be afraid and says he saw her earlier that morning. He says his mother told him that tiny creatures live in the house. She doesn't reply. She and her father quickly retreat and hide. Arrietty apologizes, and her father warns her that they must be even more careful now. That night, Arrietty finds it impossible to sleep. She goes outside to relax and notices Sho near the vent outside her home. He left a sugar cube and a note there for her to find. She almost takes it, but then she changes her mind and stops. She leaves it there and returns to her home. Arrietty's parents decide it is time for them to move away. They believe the humans know about them, which makes her mother very upset. Her father says they must stop all borrowing for a few days to stay safe. They will stay inside so that no one can see them... ...and they plan to leave the house in a few days. Later, Arrietty checks the sugar cube and sees many ants on it. She picks up the note, which says: "You forgot something." She takes the note to Sho's window and tells him to leave her family alone. Sho explains that he only wants to help and wishes to see her. Arrietty is nervous, but suddenly a crow appears and attacks her. Sho rushes to the window to save her, just as the maid, Haru, enters the room. Haru tries to hit the crow. Sho protects Arrietty by hiding her in his hands. After Haru drives the crow away, she tells Sho it is time for his medicine. While they are talking, Arrietty manages to slip away unnoticed. Her father sees her returning from the dollhouse area and becomes angry. He tells his wife that they must leave the house immediately. Meanwhile, Haru the maid has been suspicious for a long time. She asks for the contact information of a pest control company. During dinner, it is revealed that Sho has a serious heart condition. He needs an operation soon, which is why he is staying with his grandmother. He asks his grandmother about the history of the dollhouse. She says his grandfather built it because he believed tiny creatures lived here. He hoped they would use it, but it has remained empty for many years. She then shows Sho the detailed rooms inside the dollhouse. The kitchen and rooms are filled with tiny furniture and real household items. It looks like a real home. Meanwhile, Arrietty's father returns after being injured. A tiny boy named Spiller helps him return. Arrietty meets him for the first time. Her father says they must leave, and Spiller offers to help them find a new home. Arrietty is sad to leave. Her father explains that other families used to live here... ...but they disappeared, so it is safer for them to move on now. Suddenly, their roof begins to shake violently while they are talking. Someone lifts their roof and replaces it with a new, different one. It was Sho's doing. He used the dollhouse kitchen to upgrade their home. He only wanted to help, but Arrietty's family is already packed and ready to go. Arrietty goes to say goodbye to Sho, who is resting outside and feeling sad. He sees Arrietty clearly and tells her that she is very beautiful. He explains that his only wish was to be her friend and to help her. He talks about his heart condition and feels guilty for making them leave. He apologizes. Meanwhile, Haru finds the entrance under the floorboards while cleaning. She finds their hidden storage area and removes the cover. She discovers the Borrower's home and the dollhouse kitchen inside. Arrietty's mother screams when she sees the maid looking down at her. Arrietty hears the scream and runs back to rescue her mother. Haru captures the mother in a jar and hides it in the kitchen pantry. Haru locks Sho in his room and calls the pest control company. She tells them she has caught a tiny creature and wants to find more. Arrietty returns to the home and finds it empty and damaged. Her mother is gone, and Arrietty realizes she has been captured. She goes to Sho's window and calls out to him for help. When Sho answers, she tells him that her mother has been taken. Sho tries to help her, but he finds that Haru has locked his bedroom door. Sho climbs out his window to help Arrietty get inside the house. They see Haru on the phone and realize she is responsible for the kidnapping. Arrietty's mother must be hidden somewhere in the house. Sho suspects the mother is in the kitchen since the maid works there often. They go to the kitchen, but Haru suddenly appears while they are searching. Haru is nervous to see Sho. He notices her looking toward the pantry door. Sho pretends to be hungry to distract her from the pantry. While Haru is busy cooking, Sho signals Arrietty to search the pantry. Arrietty climbs down a rope to search for her mother. She carefully moves through the storage area to find where her mother is hidden. She calls out, and her mother hears her and replies. Arrietty finds her mother in a jar and uses her pin to break the seal and free her. Sho joins them. At first, Arrietty's mother is confused and scared. Arrietty explains that Sho is a friend and there is no danger from him. Meanwhile, the pest control workers arrive at the house. Haru invites them in just as the grandmother returns home. Haru excitedly tells the grandmother that she found the tiny creatures. She takes her to show the hidden home, but Sho has already cleared everything. All evidence of the Borrowers' home is now gone. Haru tries to show the missing kitchen in the dollhouse... ...but Sho put it back. Haru then claims she has captured one Borrower in a jar. When she shows the jar, it is empty. Arrietty's mother is gone. Haru is confused and nervous. The grandmother finds a tiny tea leaf in a jar. She realizes that the Borrowers were real after all. Sho tells his grandmother that they are not thieves, but Borrowers. Haru is embarrassed and angrily tells the pest control workers to leave. There is nothing left for them to find. Arrietty and her parents finally prepare to leave for good. They rest at a temporary spot. Arrietty feels very sad. Her father says Spiller will guide them to their new home. Arrietty steps outside and sees the cat from the garden one last time. It seems like the cat understands her and is saying goodbye. She sees Sho and realizes he has come to say a final farewell. Spiller brings a tea kettle boat for the family to travel in. They prepare to sail away to find a safe new place to live. Arrietty hears Sho's voice and runs to the edge of the water to see him. She thanks him for his kindness and for saving her family. She wishes him luck for his surgery, and Sho gives her a sugar cube. Arrietty gives him her hair clip as a special gift to remember her by. They set off on their new journey, and the movie ends.
