text: During a Little League Baseball game in the small town of Millbrook, New York, the Abbott family – wife Evelyn, husband Lee, deaf daughter Regan, and sons Marcus and Beau – and other spectators witness a strange meteor-like object hurtle toward the Earth. Shortly after, hostile extraterrestrial creatures emerge from the meteor and begin slaughtering the townspeople. The blind creatures possess armored skin, extraordinary speed, and strength, and track victims with hypersensitive hearing, attacking anything that makes even the slightest noise. Over a year later, the creatures have killed much of the Earth's population, including Lee and Beau. Regan has discovered that high-frequency audio feedback makes them vulnerable, and devises a makeshift method of transmitting the noise from her cochlear implant through a portable microphone. With their home destroyed, the family searches for other survivors. Entering a fenced-off area, Evelyn accidentally sets off a sound alarm, alerting the creatures. As they flee, Marcus steps into a bear trap, attracting a creature with his screams. Regan and Evelyn kill the creature, free Marcus, and run into an abandoned steel foundry. An old friend, Emmett, takes them to his soundproof underground hideout. Emmett, who has recently lost his family and developed a cynical outlook on life, refuses to help further. Marcus hears the song "Beyond the Sea" playing on the radio, and Emmett says the song has aired continuously for four months. Regan determines it is a hint that survivors are on a nearby island a day's travel to the southeast. She theorizes that if she can reach the island's radio tower the hearing aid's high-frequency noise can be broadcast so other survivors can weaponize the signal. She ventures out alone to find the island; Emmett saves her from a creature. Regan persuades him to help complete her mission. Evelyn leaves Marcus and her newborn baby at the foundry to fetch medical supplies in town. Marcus discovers the corpse of Emmett's wife. Startled, he alerts a creature and accidentally locks himself and the baby inside an air-tight compartment. Emmett and Regan arrive at a marina to board a boat to the island. They are attacked by bandits, and Emmett deliberately attracts creatures that slaughter the attackers. When one creature drowns, he realizes that the creatures cannot swim. The two row to the island where a small colony of survivors are living normally. The colony leader reveals that when the U.S. government discovered the creatures were unable to swim, the U.S. National Guard attempted to move people to the islands. However, the chaos from boarding created noise that attracted the creatures, leaving only two boats that made it to the island. Evelyn returns and frees her children before they suffocate. The three hide inside the bunker as the creature prowls the foundry. At the island the next day, a creature that's drifted to the island attacks the colonists and kills the colony leader. At the radio station, Regan transmits the high frequency via the station's signal and plays it over the station's speakers, incapacitating the creature, and then killing it with a metal pole. At the foundry, Marcus picks up Regan's transmission and plays the high-pitched frequency through his portable radio before shooting the creature. Regan leaves the hearing aid connected to the radio station's microphone, allowing the broadcast signal to be weaponized by others.

text: The movie begins deep in the Brazilian jungle where Anna and her friend Chad sit inside a van talking about how they can escape. Chad tells her it is too dangerous to leave right now because something deadly is out there, but Anna does not listen. She gets on a bike and tries to run away. A man named Mark sees her and tells his group to go after her. They chase her by boat, but during the chase, one of Mark's men falls into the river and Anaconda attacks him right away and eats him. Meanwhile, in California, we meet a man named Doug. He tells a couple his movie idea about a monster that attacks two people and how those two later team up to kill it. But the couple does not like his idea. Doug works as a wedding videographer, and most people only want plain wedding videos that look just like his older ones. Doug has always wanted to make monster movies since he was a kid, but he feels stuck doing the same wedding work again and again. At the same time, we see an actor named Ron getting ready in his vanity van. He then goes to the film set to say a small line in a scene with the main actor. But no matter how many times he tries, Ron keeps messing up his line. Because of this, he gets fired from the job. As he leaves the set, he sees posters for the Anaconda movie that first came out in 1997. At the same time, he listens to Doug's voicemail of how proud he is for getting a job in film. Back when Doug is working in his office, his boss comes over and warns him about the incident with the couple and his stories and asks Doug not to do that again, even though it's his dream to direct a movie. 2 days later, Doug comes home with his wife and is surprised to see his close friends waiting to celebrate his birthday. He is happy to meet his old friend, Steve, who works at a bank, and Cat, who is a divorce lawyer. A little later, Ron also shows up, excited to see Doug after many years. Ron sets up a small screening of a creature movie they made together when they were kids, a movie that Doug directed. They all sit and watch it, seeing their younger selves on screen. In the film, Steve played the monster while Cat and Ron acted as a couple with Ron making himself the hero. In the final scene, Ron says that no one can hurt his friends while he is around before shooting the monster and blowing it up. Watching this old movie makes Doug and everyone else very happy. The next day, Ron takes his friends out to a restaurant. While eating, they talk about how they all loved the original Anaconda movie when they were kids. Ron then says the original movie was based on a Japanese novel and that he once met the writer's wife at a studio. She wanted someone to restart the series, so Ron bought the rights to the story. Everyone is shocked and both Steve and Cat get excited. Ron then asks Doug to direct the new movie and says the rest of them can help produce it. Doug is unsure because they do not have enough money. Ron tells them they can put their money together. Doug loves his family and does not like taking big risks, so he feels torn, but Ron encourages him and promises everything will be fine. When Doug gets home, he sees his son happily watching one of his old homemade movies. His wife tells him he should follow his dream and make a real creature film. Doug is still scared of losing money, but later while editing another boring wedding video, he realizes that this job is not what he wants to do for the rest of his life. So, he starts writing a script with his friends, and together they take out loans to make a low-budget Anaconda movie. They choose to film in Brazil, [music] thinking it will be a fun adventure. They need a snake for the shoot, and Steve finds a man named Carlos who can help. Carlos brings them a big snake and says it is not poisonous, unlike the real anacondas in the jungle that kill their prey by crushing them. Doug then begins planning the dangerous scenes using this harmless snake. At the same time, Anna hides in a nearby restaurant while Mark looks for her. She notices the keys of a drunk man and decides to steal his boat to escape. By chance, Carlos is loading his snake onto the same boat and accidentally breaks the box it was in. Anna shows up and tells the group that she is their driver. They believe her and let her join them. The group then sets off on the boat enjoying the beautiful sights around them. The next day, the group starts filming near a beautiful waterfall with Ron and Cat in front of the camera using a documentary style. Everyone enjoys the work and Doug begins to feel old romantic feelings for Cat again. Later that night, Carlos's snake crawls close to Ron while he is sleeping and Ron wakes up screaming. Carlos says sorry to everyone and promises it will not happen again. The next day, Doug tells Ron to hold the snake for a scene. Ron tries to act, but he gets too scared and throws the snake into the water. The boat's propellers chop the snake to pieces right away. The group feels terrible about what happened. That night, they hold a small funeral for the snake. While they are gathered, one of Mark's men sees them and calls Mark to report Anna's location. But before he can leave, a real anaconda suddenly attacks and eats him. Later, Ron says sorry to Carlos for what happened to the snake. He also talks about how hard his life has been in Hollywood, always getting small roles and never becoming a big actor. Carlos is moved by Ron's honesty and promises to go into the jungle to catch another snake so Ron can finally have a chance to shine. But while Carlos searches the jungle, a real anaconda attacks and kills him. By night, Carlos still has not come back. The group starts to worry, and since Steve is drunk, they all decide to go look for Carlos together. Anna joins them as they walk into the jungle. They soon find a large truck. Suddenly, the anaconda throws Carlos's body onto the truck, shocking everyone. The snake then comes out of the trees, and the group rushes into the truck to escape. The truck won't start, so Doug gets out to fix it just as the snake gets close. They pull Doug back inside at the last moment and drive away with the Anaconda chasing them. Soon after, Mark's men stop them on the road, but Anna explains these men are nothing more than local criminals. She finds a gun and quickly takes them down. Steve films everything, and Doug is amazed at how natural Anna looks on camera. When they reach the boat again, Mark jumps out and attacks, but Anna knocks him out. She then tells the group she can lead them to an airport if they follow her to a nearby island. Wanting to finish the movie no matter what, Doug rewrites the script and makes Anna the main character instead of Ron. He says that movies led by women often win awards. In the new story, Ron and Cat are treasure hunters who get saved by Anna. Ron and Cat feel hurt and left out. That night, Ron tells Cat how sad he feels about his acting career. Cat opens up too, saying that even though she is successful, her life fell apart when her husband cheated on her and left. Ron tells her she deserves a fresh start. The next day, Ron complains to Doug for not filming him and reminds him that he helped Doug escape a life of making boring wedding videos. While they argue, a giant ship sails by with Ice Cube and Jennifer Lopez on board. An assistant director tells them the two stars are filming the official Sony reboot of Anaconda. The group turns to Ron and he finally admits he never owned the rights at all. Doug gets angry, realizing how dangerous their situation is. Ron says that even though he lied, his lie pushed them to chase their dreams. But Doug has had enough and tells Ron to leave. Ron leaves on a small boat, but soon reaches the shore where the Sony film crew was working. He sees the whole set destroyed. Right in front of him, the Anaconda eats the assistant director, and Ron runs back in fear to warn his friends. Meanwhile, Cat and Steve complain to Doug. Doug still wants to finish the movie with Anna as the lead. Suddenly, Anna pulls out a gun and forces everyone to follow her to the island. When they reach the shore, they dig up hidden bags of gold, revealing that Anna is actually a smuggler. Mark shows up and explains he is a police officer who has been trying to protect the jungle's resources. From a distance, Ron shoots and injures Mark to save the others. Anna then kills Mark and turns her gun on Doug and his friends. Before she can do anything else, the anaconda bursts out and drags Anna into the water. The group runs away in terror, but soon gets lost. The snake grabs Doug and pulls him into the jungle. Thinking he is dead, the others walk away in sadness until the anaconda suddenly spits out Doug's bloody body nearby. Steve comes up with a plan to use Doug [music] as bait to distract the snake so they can escape. They agree and place Doug in an open field with other animals around him. As the snake slithers closer, they realize Doug is still alive and yell at him to run. Doug gets up and runs, and a pig that was sleeping on top of him wakes up. The anaconda eats the pig instead, giving Doug just enough time to get away safely. The group runs to the destroyed movie set. The anaconda attacks again, but someone shoots at it and scares it away. It is Ice Cube, the hero from the original Anaconda movie from 1997. He hides the group and explains that the whole set is filled with explosives and cameras, but the snake ruined the control system. He also says that Jennifer Lopez and Eric are missing somewhere in [music] the jungle, and he needs to find them. Before leaving, he gives Ron a pistol for protection. Doug and Ron come up with a plan to kill the snake using the explosives on the set. They find the detonator and start yelling to draw the anaconda toward them. Doug drives a car into the movie set while the snake chases him. At the right moment, Steve and Cat press the button to set off the bombs. The first explosion is not strong enough, and the snake survives. Ron steps forward, raises his gun, and repeats his old line from their childhood movie, "No one can kill my friends while I am here." He shoots a gas line, and the blast that follows finally destroys the Anaconda for good. A year passes and the group wins an award for their movie at the Buffalo Film Festival. Their lives completely change. Ron and Cat decide to get married and Doug films their wedding with shots inspired by the Xenomorph from Alien. Ron also gets a role in the TV show SWAT. One day, Jennifer Lopez visits Doug at his home. She tells him she watched their unofficial Anaconda movie and wants him to direct her new film. Doug is shocked and filled with joy. text: Hey y'all. When I die, just either A throw my naked body into the woods or b lay me at top a mountain. Doesn't have to be the highest mountain. Don't have to be Everest, though that'd be awesome. But just somewhere high. I'd rather my body be reabsorbed into the earth and or consumed by the animals of the world than be cremated, buried, or scattered over the sea. Do not put me anywhere near the sea. Now that that's out of the way, today we're going to be talking about the shrouds. Visionary aur David Croninberg of the fly and scanners returns with the shrouds, a harrowing descent into grief, obsession, and the horror of what we leave behind. Diane Krueger, Vincent Castle, Guy Pierce, and Sandrine Halt star in this unsettling body horror drama. The premise of this one is four years after the death of his beloved wife, Becca, tech mogul KH unveils his latest creation, Grave Tech, a tombstone unlike any other, broadcasting a real-time 3D feed of the corpse's slow decay captured by a re-engineered burial shroud. Bound by grief, KH plans to spend eternity besides Becca. But the past refuses to stay buried. Haunted by relentless visions, he watches Becca return from the dead. Each time more mutilated, more ghostly, dragging with her the shadows of her former lover and doctor, Jerry Eckler. As the line between dream and reality dissolves, The Shrouds attempts to pull KH and the audience into a nightmarish meditation on love, death, and the grotesque beauty of surrendering to rot. The Rotten Tomatoes tomato meter gives it a 74 out of 100, while its popcorn meter scores it at a 57%. Little discrepancy there. Metacritic gives it a 69 out of 100, and Letterbox has it at a 3.1 out of five. My feelings while watching The Shrouds, it started off with a spark of intrigue. The idea of someone being able to watch their loved one decomposed in real time, not in a twisted or perverse way, but in a strangely poignant one, was genuinely compelling. But that's where the momentum stopped. Despite trying out several narrative tricks to keep things moving, the story never really took off. it bogged down into a slow dragging pace, broken up mainly by a few seductive scenes with the stunning and generously showcased Diane Krueger. Meanwhile, Guy Pierce, whom I love, was sadly underused, trapped in a flat one-dimensional role that gave him little to work with, which felt like a major missed opportunity. Beyond that, the film was just boring. And then, just as abruptly as it stumbled along, it ended. two hours passing by as emptily as the love between its characters. Overall, I expected more from David Croninberg. The real value of The Shrouds, it was real rough, confusing, self-indulgently obscure, and a disappointing waste of incredible talent. A tough 2-hour sit. Okay, that's it for me today, folks. Corey and Joey, thanks double time since I forgot to mention y'all last episode. Apologies, but thank you both for being Patreon patron subscribers. All right, everyone. See me next time because I can't see you. Peace. How shall you die your light?

He finds a bag of bombs and throws them out, only for them to blow up inside a garbage truck, and another bomb that he left ends up falling into the sewers and causing an explosion that sends water bursting out. Before the truck crashes into a crowd of people, Sonic quickly dismantles the truck and flees before anyone else is hurt. Sonic returns home to Green Hills where he still lives with the Wachowskis and Ozzie the dog. Maddie reminds Sonic that he agreed to go fishing with Tom. While out on the lake, Tom tells Sonic that he is being too reckless as a hero, and that a real hero has to take responsibility for his actions and look out for the people closest to him. Sonic takes his words to heart. Tom and Maddie prepare to leave for Hawaii because Maddie’s sister Rachel is getting married. Sonic opens a ring portal for them to go through, and he is excited to stay home with Ozzie. Sonic trashes the house while having fun, but he still uses his super-speed to clean everything up. Meanwhile, not far from home, Miles “Tails” Prower emerges from his own portal, as he has been tracking Sonic and is going to warn him of impending danger. Later that night, Sonic is watching TV with Ozzie when he hears something at the door. He finds Robotnik having broken in, returning to Earth through the ring portal. Before Sonic can deliver a whooping to Robotnik, the mad scientist sends Knuckles after Sonic. The echidna uses his super strength to punch Sonic through the walls. Sonic recognizes Knuckles’s species and believes that Knuckles wants his power, but Knuckles is simply out for revenge against Sonic because the rest of his echidna tribe had fallen in their search for Sonic, as well as the knowledge to the location of an item called the Master Emerald. Before Knuckles can kill Sonic, Tails drives a cop car to pick up Sonic and uses his gadgets to drive it. Tails explains to Sonic that ever since the energy surge he caused (in the first movie), he has been tracking Sonic from his home planet and watched as he defeated Robotnik the first time, but he observed Robotnik and Knuckles teaming up, so he came to warn him. Knuckles chases after them, but Sonic and Tails manage to lose him when Tails uses his…tails…like a helicopter to fly himself and Sonic away. Robotnik helps Knuckles back up and offers to form an alliance so that they can find the Master Emerald together and kill Sonic. Agent Stone is working as a barista in his own coffee shop, where he still misses his boss. Once Robotnik contacts him, he shuts down the coffee shop and excitedly celebrates the mad doctor’s return. Stone then unveils his own creations hidden in the shop and uses it to summon a pod from space to bring a horde of Robotnik’s drones down to Earth. Robotnik and Knuckles arrive at the shop and have Stone utilize his tech to help them track Sonic. Sonic and Tails go to the home of Wade as they try to figure out how to get to the Master Emerald before Robotnik and Knuckles. Sonic still has a map given to him by Longclaw, and when he touches the symbol, it activates a hologram message from Longclaw herself. She explains that the Master Emerald is capable of converting thoughts to energy, and it is hidden somewhere on Earth. She ends the message reassuring Sonic of her love for him. Determining that the compass that will help them track the Emerald is in Siberia, Sonic opens a ring portal and convinces Tails to join him on this new quest. In Hawaii, Tom and Maddie meet Rachel’s fiance, Randall. Rachel appears to want to bury the hatchet with Tom, but she quietly warns him she will destroy him if he does anything to ruin the wedding. Tom watches Randall’s buddies and tells Maddie that he wishes Sonic had a friend group like that. In Siberia, Sonic and Tails arrive at a bar. Tails uses his tech to try and translate his words, but he accidentally ends up insulting the barmaid and other patrons. When their disguises are removed, the patrons see them as freaks and try to toss them into a fire until Tails finds a word that calls out for a dance challenge. The lead dancer shows off to a old Siberian folk song, but Sonic changes it up by playing “Uptown Funk” and having Tails join him in a true dance battle, allowing them to win over the patrons when they defeat the lead dancer. Sonic and Tails then rest up for the night, with Tails feeling proud that he has befriended his idol. The next morning, Sonic and Tails fly over to a cave where they have tracked the compass. They see a statue of an owl warrior. Tails says that the owl and echidna tribes were enemies for centuries. The echidnas forged the Chaos Emeralds and fused them to create the Master Emerald, which the owls took away from them for fear that anyone possessing the Master Emerald might use its power to take control over everything. The two use the symbols on the map to get the compass out. Unfortunately, Robotnik and Knuckles arrive and attack. Taking the compass, Sonic snowboards out of the cave while Tails tries to fly out as Robotnik sends his drones after them, and Knuckles chases Sonic down the mountain. Sonic destroys the drones but is knocked over a ledge by Knuckles, causing him to lose his rings. While Sonic hangs on, Knuckles tells his own backstory – he was a child when his father went off with the rest of the echidnas to fight Longclaw, a battle that left no survivors, including Longclaw and Knuckles’s father. It left Knuckles with resentment and a desire to avenge his father and tribe. Sonic tells Knuckles that they both lost everything that day. Tails traps Knuckles, but when Sonic throws him the compass, Robotnik catches it and knocks Tails out. Sonic goes to help his friend, which Knuckles takes note of since Sonic chose his friend over getting the compass. Knuckles and Robotnik escape just as an avalanche occurs. Sonic rides down the mountain while carrying Tails and tries to contact Tom, just as Rachel and Randall are set to be married. Tom goes to answer the phone and sees that Sonic is in danger, so the hedgehog asks Tom to use the ring that he gave him to open a portal and get Sonic out. The problem is, Tom accidentally switched the portal ring with Rachel’s wedding ring. He goes to get the ring before Randall puts it on Rachel’s finger and uses it to open the portal to Siberia, allowing Sonic, Tails, and a gigantic pile of snow to fly out and cover everyone. Just as Sonic tries to explain the situation to Tom and Maddie, it is revealed that Randall and all the wedding guests are agents with a corporation called G U N or (Guardian Units of Nations), led by Commander Walters. They capture Sonic, Tails, and Tom, while Rachel is furious to learn that her whole wedding was a cover-up. Maddie and Rachel get some of Tails’s tech and get past the agents so that Maddie can free Tom and the boys while Rachel goes to confront Randall. He admits that while the wedding was a sham, he truly did end up falling in love with her, and she forgives him as they kiss. Meanwhile, Maddie frees her husband and friends. Just as they go outside, they see a large green beam, as Robotnik and Knuckles have found the island where the compass brought them, and they are closer to finding the temple containing the Master Emerald. Sonic chooses to go after the villains by himself because Tails got hurt and he doesn’t want Tom and Maddie to get hurt either. He runs across the water, but Tails wakes up and tells Tom and Maddie they all need to help Sonic. Sonic makes it to the temple and finds Robotnik and Knuckles. He and Knuckles have a second showdown, with Knuckles punching as hard and fast as he can, but Sonic taps into his own powers to dodge Knuckles’s attacks and lay a beatdown on him. Sonic then tries to tell Knuckles that Robotnik is trying to get the Emerald for himself, and Knuckles finds this to be true when he turns around. Robotnik betrays Knuckles and leaves him to his fate as he absorbs the Emerald and begins to harness the Chaos Energy. The temple begins to be brought down by water, with Knuckles trapped under a pillar. Sonic helps free him, and Knuckles helps Sonic out of the water before he drowns. Although Knuckles is feeling betrayed, Sonic convinces him to join forces so that they can stop Robotnik. They are picked up by Tails, coming in on a plane. Robotnik teleports back to the coffee shop, where Wade has Stone in handcuffs after discovering his shady activity. G U N agents surround the place outside, and Robotnik uses his new powers to dismantle their tanks and other nearby vehicles as he begins to construct his own giant Eggman mecha, which is witnessed by Tom and Maddie. Tails flies himself, Sonic, and Knuckles closer to the mecha. The three join forces to come up with a plan to defeat Robotnik. Knowing that Robotnik’s weakness is Sonic himself, the hedgehog goes to taunt Robotnik while Tails flies Knuckles high enough to attack the robot. Tails opens a hole inside, and Knuckles get in, managing to punch Robotnik hard enough to send the Emerald flying out of him. However, he uses auxiliary energy to keep the mecha running. Outside, Sonic tries to get the Emerald, while Tom and Maddie drive by and save him. Robotnik causes them to crash, and when Sonic grabs the Emerald, it breaks apart into the smaller Emeralds. He tells Tom and Maddie he loves them as they prepare to be crushed by Robotnik, and with this, Sonic absorbs the Emeralds and becomes Super Sonic, a golden, powered-up version that is ten times stronger and more powerful. He puts multiple dents in Robotnik’s suit before knocking it over completely, sending Robotnik falling with it. Sonic then releases the Emeralds so that Knuckles can put it back together as the Master Emerald once again. Sometime later, Tom and Maddie take in Tails and Knuckles, who have now become like Sonic’s brothers. They play baseball until Knuckles punches the ball too hard and sends it flying away. The three friends agree to keep the Master Emerald safe together, and Tom and Maddie take them out for ice cream. During the credits, G U N agents survey the wreckage of the Eggman mecha, and they assume Robotnik is dead, unaware that Stone is in disguise among them trying to find his boss. Another agent tells Walters that G U N has uncovered the coordinates to an experiment hidden for over 50 years. Walters realizes with horror that this is “Project Shadow”. Cut to Shadow the Hedgehog emerging from a pod and appearing to wake up.

text: Hi Everyone, Meta Anime here. Hope you are doing well. Today I am going to tell the story of a film called A Silent Voice. Released in 2016, the film is directed by Naoko Yamada, well-known for the anime series Tamako Market and K-On!. It is also written by Yoshitoki Ōima who is known for the anime series "To Your Eternity". The story is about a boy named Ishida Shouya who bullied a deaf girl named Nishimiya Shouko as a kid. After she is transferred to another school, Ishida is ostracized and bullied by others. With no friends to speak of and no plan for the future, this is the story of his path to redemption. Before we go, this video contains spoilers. So please take this warning for those that haven't watched this movie yet. Without further ado, here's the recap of A Silent Voice!! The film starts with Ishida desperately trying to earn money to be given to his mother. He then went to a bridge trying to commit the unthinkable. But his plan failed after seeing children playing with fireworks at the side of the river. We are then taken back to his elementary school days. Ishida played with his friends energetically and happily. Things were much simpler back then. One day, the class got a new transfer student who is a deaf girl named Nishimiya. At first, all of them tried their best to make sure she is comfortable. All the children seemed eager to talk to her but it was hard because they had to use a book to communicate with her. During the choir lesson, Nishimiya also sang but disrupted the class because she cannot match her tone with the others. The other people also cannot understand what she is saying. Nishimiya then approached a girl named Ueno to ask for help. But Ueno who helped her in the beginning started to get annoyed and avoided her. Seeing how the others in the class started getting uncomfortable with Nishimiya, Ishida started bullying Nishimiya. He started mimicking her speech which made the other student in class ignore Nishimiya. However, one student named Sahara showed a desire to learn sign language when a teacher asked the class to learn it for Nishimiya. Nishimiya and Sahara then got closer. Seeing this, Ueno mocked Sahara and Nishimiya. This ultimately led to Sahara moving to another school. In the afternoon, Ishida wrote bad words about Nishimiya on the blackboard. As Nishimiya came in, he pretended to clean it for her. Nishimiya only smiled and thanked Ishida for it. Despite how mean everyone was to her, Nishimiya would only smile and apologize to them and try to make friends. After finding out that Nishimiya wears hearing aids, Ishida and Ueno would constantly rip them off Nishimiya's ears and threw them away. At the climax of the bullying, Ishida forcibly ripped Nishimiya's hearing aid and made one of her ears bleed. After school, Nishimiya went to si Ishida trying to apologize to him. Annoyed, Ishida threw her notebook away to a pond. The news got to the classroom instructor who told the class that Nishimiya had been bullied and asked the culprit to show him/herself. Although there were many culprits, all his friends singled Ishida out as the sole culprit. At home, Ishida's mother got the news and confronted him about it. His mother then took him to see Nishimiya's family. Ishida's mother went and apologized to Nishimiya's mother for her son's behavior. The two of them had a private conversation in the park. Upon returning, Ishida saw his mother's ear bleed probably due to her earrings being ripped. The next day at school, Ishida realized that he was now an outcast. Now his friends who were together with him bullying Nishimiya are bullying him instead. His hard life a school now starts. One day, his classmates wrote things on his desk but Nishimiya cleaned it out for him. Instead of thanking her, Ishida got angry and told her to stop helping him. They then got into a physical fight. Nishimiya then transferred to another school afterward. People now avoid Ishida as they see him as a guy who bullied a deaf girl. This kept going on until he went to high school. He fell into depression and this wholly ruined his social life. Now the time skipped to the present day. After his failed suicide attempt, Ishida went to see Nishimiya return her old notebook that she used to use to communicate with others. At their first encounter, the panicked Nishimiya ran away from him but Ishida chased her. Ishida then tried to apologize to her for what he did as a kid using sign language that he learned. But as he panicked, he accidentally asked her if she wants to become friends Nishimiya was first very hesitant but eventually decided to give Ishida a chance. The next morning, Ishida's mother confronted him for trying to kill himself. She got really angry and threatened to burn the money Ishida earned so hard to repay his mother. He then apologized to his mother promising not to do it again. At school, Ishida avoided everyone and is afraid to look at anyone's face. We can see by the "X" sign that is present on everyone's face from Ishida's perspective. He is also constantly anxious thinking that everyone is talking about him. After school, a student is asking another student to borrow his bike. Seeing how that other student is troubled by it, Ishida offered his bike instead. Ishida then walks to see Nishimiya. Upon arrival, Nishimiya's little sister named Yuzuru asked Ishida to go by saying that Nishimiya is not there. On the way home, Ishida met a student from before named Nagatsuka. Nagatsuka found his bike and tried to become friends with Ishida After this, Nagatsuka kept asking Ishida to hang out together in various places. Ishida then slowly became more open to Nagatsuka. Ishida kept visiting Nishimiya's place but Yuzuru was always on his way. Seeing this, Nagatsuka stepped up and grabbed Yuzuru which made Nishimiya notice them. Nishimiya and Ishida can finally chat and they were feeding the fish together by the small bridge. Nishimiya also thanked Ishida for returning her book. But the book accidentally fell into the river and Nishimiya jumped to retrieve it. Seeing that, Ishida then immediately jumped into the river. They successfully found the book together. At night, Yuzuru posted the picture of Ishida jumping into the river on the internet. The post reached his classmates and the teachers. This resulted in him getting a suspension. While taking his niece out at the park, Ishida met with the rugged Yuzuru who was sleeping at the park. Ishida then invited Yuzuru to stay at his house for the night. Yuzuru had a fight with her older sister. Yuzuru then tried to go home and Ishida accompanied her. On the way to her house, Yuzuru saw her mother. Her mother then came and slapped Ishida on the face. The grudge from the past still lingers very strongly within her mother. The next day Ishida met with Nishimiya. But this time he introduced Nagatsuka and exchanged contact information with Nishimiya. Ishida found out that Nishimiya was still in contact with Sahara, her friend from elementary school. At school, Ishida asked one of his classmates that was also his friend from elementary school named Kawai about Sahara's address. Nishimiya and Ishida then went together on a train to see Sahara. At the station, Sahara was surprised to see Nishimiya together with Ishida. Sahara and Nishimiya are still close with each other. The next day, when Nishimiya and Ishida were together, Ueno showed up. Ueno tried to tease Nishimiya by taking her hearing aids just like in the past. But this time, Ishida stopped her from doing so. In the morning, Yuzuru was surprised that Nishimiya changed her hairstyle. After school, Nishimiya and Ishida hung out together again. Nishimiya then tried to confess her love to Ishida. But that time Ishida misinterpreted her. The very nervous Nishimiya then got ashamed and ran off. At home, Nishimiya told Yuzuru that she confessed to Ishida but failed. Ishida then asked Kawai about the meaning when a girl changed her hairstyle. But he found no definitive answer. Kawai then introduced one of their classmates named Mashiba who wanted to be friends with Ishida. They then gathered together on the bridge. But Nishimiya never showed up. The next day, they all went together to an amusement park. But Ueno also showed up and went together with them. They all spent the day playing the rides there. Ishida is now getting more open with others. Suddenly, Ueno asked Ishida to take her to have takoyaki. Ishida was shocked to see that the one who served them used to be one of Ishida's friends who bullied him. He is now back to rejecting Ueno. Not enough causing trouble, Ueno asked Nishimiya to go to the Ferris wheel with her. Yuzuru then asked Nishimiya to take her camera with her. The next day, Yuzuru went to Ishida's house to show the recording of the Ferris wheel from the previous day. Yuzuru had turned the recording on before handing the camera to Nishimiya. There, Ueno said mean words to Nishimiya and told her how much she hated her. At school, Mashiba heard that Nishimiya was bullied as a kid by someone. Ishida then went to see Kawai asking her why she told about the past to Mashiba. Feeling that she was attacked, Kawai defended herself instead. She then told Mashiba and Nagatsuka loudly about how Ishida bullied Nishimiya in the past. Even though she also badmouthed her in the past, she never admitted it and even said that she tried to stop him. After school, Ishida went to see Nishimiya. Then Kawai and Ueno came as well. Kawai then apologized to Ishida about the incident. But Ueno and Kawai got into an argument about how they bullied Nishimiya in the past. Ishida then stopped them all and blamed himself. He then asked all of them to go. At home, Nishimiya and Yuzuru's grandmother comforted Yuzuru seeing that she is sad. The next day at the bridge, Ishida saw Yuzuru crying by the river. She then took her home and realized that Nishimiya and Yuzuru's grandmother just passed away. We can see how their mother was really sad about it. Trying to comfort Nishimiya, Ishida took her to various places. He spent days asking Nishimiya and Yuzuru to hang out together with him to comfort them. Yuzuru and Nishimiya then invited Ishida to their house to help bake a cake for their mother's birthday. At first, their mother was unhappy seeing Ishida but Yuzuru managed to calm her down. They then promised to see the fireworks together during an upcoming fireworks festival. During the festival, Yuzuru and her mother went to buy food, leaving Nishimiya and Ishida alone. Nishimiya then excused herself saying that she wanted to go home. Yuzuru then asked Ishida to take her camera at her house. Ishida then got to Nishimiya's house. He was shocked to see that Nishimiya is about to jump from the balcony. Panicked, he ran to Nishimiya and barely managed to catch her. However, in the effort to save Nishimiya, Ishida himself fell from the balcony after Nishimiya was saved. The next day, Yuzuru and her mother went to the hospital to see Ishida. Her mother apologized to Ishida's mother for Nishimiya's act which caused all of this. We then can see Nishimiya being attacked by Ueno for harming Ishida. Nishimiya's mother came to stop Ueno and got into a physical fight with her. Ishida's mother then came to break them up. Seeing Ishida's mother, Nishimiya bowed and apologized to her for the incident. The next day, Nagatsuka saw that Ueno rejected Nishimiya's visit to see Ishida. He then tried to help her but to no avail. While talking to Nagatsuka, Nishimiya blamed herself saying that she destroyed everything that Ishida had built up. She is determined to fix what she had destroyed. She then went to see Kawai and Mashiba so that they can be friends with Ishida again. After that, she went to see Sahara at her house. She also went to see Ueno. Despite constant rejection from Ueno, Nishimiya never gave up. One night, Nishimya had a nightmare that woke her up. She then went to the bridge that Ishida frequently goes to and cried there. At that time, Ishida also woke up and immediately tried to come to the river. They then met each other at the bridge. Nishimiya was glad to see that Ishida had woken up. The next day, Ishida finally returned to his house and met Ueno there. He thanked her for taking care of him at the hospital. At his home, he saw Nishimiya's mother having a haircut with his mother. He then met Yuzuru in his room. She asked him to tutor her as she is falling behind at school. At school, he met Nishimiya and invited her to his school's festival. They walked together but Ishida couldn't stand the constant gaze from the people. In his class, Ishida's classmates were really glad to see him already recovered. But he is still running away from the crowd. But Nagatsuka came to comfort and convinced him to see the others. They then met Kawai and Mashiba who had been waiting for them. Kawai had made him a thousand cranes to wish for his recovery. Ueno then came together with Sahara. Ishida then asked them to walk together with him through the school festival. This film ended with Ishida finally opening his eyes and ears to see her other people. It is marked by the removal of the "X" sign on everyone's face from Ishida's perspective. He saw how the other people were really happy enjoying the festival. He also cried after seeing his family and how he managed to reunite his friends just like how they were. Ishida is finally no longer alone. So that concludes the recap of A Silent Voice. What do you guys think? This film became a favorite among many people with its sad and suffocating plot. We were shown by this film that despite being shown as the bad guy at the beginning of the story, Ishida also suffered a lot from his actions and his road to redemption is not an easy one. I also really like how the antagonist of this story is made acceptable for us to be in their group by the end of the story. Unlike usual films with a simple plot where the antagonist is purely made to be hated by the audience. Ueno was also made to be hated by the audience with her ruthless act toward Nishimiya. But we were also shown how Ueno was the first person who was kind to Nishimiya at school and how she cared for Ishida as she took care of him in the hospital. All the characters in the story also for their redemption by the end of this story which further refined the quality of this story. I personally really like this film as it beautifully encompasses the aspect of love, family, and friends. Unlike most films that only take on one aspect. Please tell us what you think through the comment section. If you like this content, please leave us a like and share them with your friends. Thank you for watching, and till we see you again!

text: Every generation needs its own cult classic about girls, power, and secrets. The 2020s finally have theirs, Forbidden Fruits. But, what happens when the desire to belong turns deadly? That's exactly what this film explores. Set entirely in a bustling Dallas mall, Forbidden Fruits introduces us to Apple, Fig, and Cherry, three employees of the exclusive boutique store Free Eden. They're stylish, magnetic, and completely untouchable. On the surface, they're just the IT girls of the mall, racking up sales, charming shoppers, and living the dream. But, behind the perfectly curated aisles and chic outfits lies a dark secret. By night, Apple, the fiery and enigmatic leader, runs a witchy cult from the basement of the store. Her coven includes Fig, smart and ambitious, and Cherry, bubbly but lonely. Together, they practice spells, drink mystical concoctions, and maintain a strict hierarchy that keeps outsiders in check. But, things take a turn when a new girl enters the picture. Pumpkin, a bright and bold employee from a nearby pretzel stand, catches Fig's eye. She's different, curious, fearless, and unafraid to ask questions. And, in a world where everyone follows Apple's rules without question, that's dangerous. Pumpkin is drawn to the allure of this coven. She's fascinated by their rituals, their power, and their unspoken bond. At first, it seems like she's just trying to fit in, but Pumpkin has her own curiosity, a desire to see what makes Apple's sisterhood tick. And, no one expected that her presence would unravel the carefully constructed world of the Fruits. From the very first scenes, Forbidden Fruits blends humor, horror, and a sense of danger. The mall isn't just a backdrop, it's a playground for power, desire, and deception. Apple's leadership is magnetic but controlling. Fig and Cherry each have their own struggles. Fig secretly dates a mall employee, bending the rules of Apple's strict coven, while Cherry seeks companionship, often clouding the coven's expectations. And just when you think this is all teen drama and witchy fun, Alloway's film shows its teeth. A dark undercurrent of performative sisterhood begins to surface. Not everything is as empowering as it seems. What happens next changes everything. As Pumpkin integrates into the fruits world, we start to see the rules Apple enforces aren't just quirky, they're controlling. Men are only allowed to be contacted via emojis. Sex is forbidden, and loyalty? Absolute. Anyone who challenges the order risks exile or worse. The fruits aren't just playing dress up. They worship icons like Marilyn Monroe using ritual and magic to bind their sisterhood. They chant cryptic lists of words, truffle oil, blood clots, juice press, mixing the absurd with the eerie. Every spell, every ritual reinforces Apple's grip on the group. But Pumpkin isn't naive. She notices the cracks in their perfect world. Fig is conflicted, craving both friendship and independence. Cherry wants love, often at odds with Apple's rules. And Apple herself? She's terrifyingly charismatic, yet deeply flawed. Her need for control is rooted in the trail and a desire to protect the family she's created, even if it means hurting others. The tension escalates when Pumpkin discovers Pickle, the former fourth member of the coven. Pickle's disappearance was never explained, and now clues suggest Apple's leadership may not be as harmless as it seems. text: In 1480 Romania, Prince Vlad lived peacefully with his beloved wife Elizabetha, symbolized by a music box he once gifted her. Their happiness ended when Captain Targal warned of an Ottoman invasion. Vlad left Elizabetha in guarded care and sought the Pope's blessing before leading his army, though he doubted whether endless bloodshed could truly be God's will. His only prayer was for Elizabeth's safety. While she was being escorted, Ottoman archers attacked, forcing her guards to flee with her. On the battlefield, Vlad unleashed fire and steel against the enemy, gaining the upper hand until news arrived that Elizabetha had been ambushed. He rushed to her aid, but in the chaos, his furious strike not only killed her attackers, it fatally wounded Elizabetha, too. Elizabetha gave Vlad a soft smile before dying in his arms, leaving him broken with grief. After the battle, he went to the Pope and cried that God hadn't even given him the chance to say goodbye. In his pain, he begged for Elizabetha to be brought back to life. The Pope told him it was impossible. She was gone and resting in heaven. But Vlad refused to accept it. In anger, he grabbed the Pope, broke a guard's staff, and shouted that if God was real, he could return her. He warned that if she wasn't brought back, his soul would no longer belong to God. Then in rage, he killed the pope with the staff. At that moment, Vlad turned his back on faith forever. As he spread his arms, lightning flashed and the statues of Christ began to cry tears of blood. Four centuries later, in a private clinic, a doctor welcomed a priest. He admitted that the case ahead was so serious, even the Queen of England was disturbed. Together, they walked past chained patients until they reached the basement where a young Italian woman named Maria was imprisoned. She was only 30 and also the fiance of the queen's grandson, Henry. The priest asked her story. The doctor explained it began on her wedding day. She had refused to enter the church and gone into hysteria at the sight of a priest. The strangest part was her birth records, which dated back to 1759. Suspecting something unnatural, the priest examined her teeth and confirmed she was a vampire, the first ever captured alive. At that moment, Maria spoke, begging the doctor not to believe him. To prove it, the priest opened a window. Sunlight burned Maria's skin until it was shut again. Then he raised a cross which burst into flames, making her laugh. Even the doctor realized this was beyond science. The priest promised Maria that if she told the truth, he would try to send her home, and to earn her trust, he gave her a drop of blood. Relieved, she agreed to talk. After examining her further, the priest concluded she wasn't a first generation vampire. He revealed the church had long searched for the very first one, the father of them all. Maria then spoke of her master, a prince who would soon come for her. He was looking for his lost princess, a woman of extraordinary beauty. The priest declared that finding this princess was their real mission, for she would lead them to the vampire. Maria only laughed and mocked them, wishing them luck. Jonathan, a notary, traveled alone on snowy roads when his coachman refused to go further, warning him about wolves. Before leaving, the coachman gave him a cross for protection. Though Jonathan admitted he didn't believe in God. Torch in hand, he continued on foot, uneasy as glowing wolf eyes followed him from the darkness. Soon, a massive castle rose before him. As he crossed the bridge, the gates slammed shut behind, trapping him inside. The giant doors opened by themselves, and once he entered, they closed again. Lightning flashed, revealing a figure on the balcony. Then, suddenly, the same figure stood behind him. The man's pale skin, white hair, and wrinkled face made him look otherworldly. Taking Jonathan's torch, he lit the hall with a brazier. Jonathan introduced himself, and the man welcomed him, remarking on his youth before introducing himself as Vlad II, Prince of Wakia, better known as Dracula. He then invited Jonathan to dine with him in the Grand Hall. Jonathan, starving, ate hungrily while noting that such a massive castle must need many workers. Dracula agreed he had servants, but none visible to guests. When asked why he wasn't eating, Dracula only smiled, saying he would dine later, and with a simple gesture pulled the dishes toward himself. Then at the dining table, a rat appears, and Dracula picks it up with a fork, pours its blood into a glass, and tastes it. Jonathan then revealed the real purpose of his visit. His partner, Jenkins, had arranged for them to buy an old abbey in Paris, intending to turn it into a hospital for the upcoming Universal Exposition. As he laid out the plans, the cross the coachman had given him slipped to the floor. Dracula asked if he was religious, but Jonathan dismissed it as just a protective charm. Dracula tossed it into the fire without hesitation. Later, Dracula led Jonathan to his room, warning him not to leave until morning. When Jonathan asked what danger existed, Dracula explained that old castles carry memories. Memories that can haunt men. Jonathan, still skeptical, said he didn't believe in superstitions. Dracula left him to spend the night alone. Jonathan noticed a torn book in his room just as Dracula played a photograph and vanished into the castle's depths. Elsewhere, the priest met Henry, Maria's fianceé. Henry worried about her health, but the priest assured him she was fine physically, though she carried a strange power beyond human limits. Searching their wedding chamber, the priest uncovered the missing page from Dracula's book showing a photograph of a woman, Elizabetha. Back in the castle, Jonathan wandered the halls and found a lit cellar where a coffin lay. Inside, Vlad rested, warning him not to leave his room. Suddenly, a gargoyle attacked, knocking him unconscious. He awoke chained, guarded by gargoyles. When Jonathan called on God, Vlad silenced him, saying God and the devil were just opposing forces, both uncaring about mankind. Jonathan was then hung upside down so his blood could be drained. Vlad explained he was cursed to wander forever, surviving only on human blood. Cutting Jonathan's neck, he collected it into a vessel. Jonathan weakly asked how such cruelty could exist if God was truly loving. Vlad mocked him, reminding him of his past disbelief. But now Jonathan insisted he believed. Amused, Dracula promised him one last wish. With his final strength, Jonathan asked to hear his story. Moved by Jonathan's request, Vlad ordered the Gargoyles to unchain him and tie him to a chair where he began his story. He revealed that life was a cruel trial, while death was a mercy, one that God had denied him. Once he had been God's loyal servant, but everything changed when his beloved wife, Princess Elizabetha, was taken from him. For four centuries, he had waited for her return. The black plague only deepened his torment, killing millions, especially women who hid in churches, places barred to him. Vlad admitted that to live without love was the worst curse. Many times he had tried to end his life by leaping from castle towers, but even death was refused. In time, numbness replaced sorrow. Realizing he could not find Elizabetha on his own, he devised ways to draw her to him. He spent a century creating a perfume that could capture the souls of flowers. This fragrance bewitched crowds wherever it spread, even reaching the French court at Versailles. There he thought he had found Elizabeth reborn and a girl named Isabelle. But when he realized he was wrong, despair consumed him. He began turning women into his thrs, hoping one of them would be her. Maria was among those bitten. Yet none could fill the emptiness. He even returned to Elizabeth's grave, weeping over her ashes, while his gargoyles piled gold and treasures before him, all meaningless. Jonathan then tried to reach him, reminding Vlad that he too had a fiance waiting for him, a woman he had sworn to marry. For Dracula, this only deepened the tragedy. Jonathan pleaded if he died here, his beloved would be destroyed by grief. Jonathan carried a locket with his fiance's picture. When the gargoyless placed it before Vlad, he froze. The face was identical to Elizabetha. Jonathan said her name was Mina, but Vlad became convinced she was his lost wife reborn. He spared Jonathan's life, ordering the gargoyles to keep him imprisoned and began preparing to reunite with Mina. Letters were sent out through his servants. Meanwhile, the priest showed the doctor Elizabetha's photo, explaining that Dracula had searched for her for four centuries. The doctor noticed she was left-handed, which the priest confirmed. He also revealed from a German book that vampires were God's curse and only repentance, a stake through the heart and beheading could free both them and their victims. At that moment, a young doctor reported seeing a woman who looks just like the photo. She introduced herself as Mina, Maria's friend. Mina explained she had been with Maria since a reception, but after a priest appeared, Maria's behavior had changed. She admitted she was engaged to Jonathan, though the engagement felt rushed, almost like a bad omen. She confessed she loved him, but often felt she belonged to another time. Before leaving, she wrote her address, left-handed, just like Elizabetha. Dracula reached an old abbey disguised as a beggar. The nuns let him in, but when he revealed his true form, one warned that his magic had no power in God's house. Arrogantly, he mocked her by spraying perfume on the crucifix. Soon, the nuns fell under his spell, one even offering herself. Dracula drank their blood, regained strength, and left for his castle. Meanwhile, Jonathan, watching from his cell, feared Dracula would reach Mina first. He made a rope from his clothes to escape, but gargoyless spotted him, pulled him down, and threw him into the snow. He slid to a frozen river. The ice broke under the pursuing gargoyles, drowning them. Injured, but alive, Jonathan survived until dawn. At the same time, Dracula arrived in Paris and entered the hospital where Maria was held. The crowd admired him, except for a young doctor who tried to stop him. Ignoring resistance, Dracula went to Maria's cell, where she called him master. He rewarded her with a young doctor, whose blood she drank to her delight. The next day, the priest discovered the young doctor had become a vampire. He learned Maria hadn't escaped alone. Dracula had helped her. Alarmed, he warned that Mina was in serious danger. At her pension, Mina was startled to see Maria, who claimed her illness had vanished, and the doctors discharged her. Maria gave Mina tickets to a celebration and insisted she join to meet a special friend. At the Grand Hotel, Dracula appeared. Seeing Mina, he was reminded of his late wife, Elizabetha. Introduced by Maria, Dracula praised Mina, and she sensed a strange romantic familiarity. He revealed he was Prince Blood of Wakia, though many called him Dracula. At the fair, Mina tried to involve him in games, but Maria separated them. Dracula appeared in a haunted house to rescue her, later guiding her at a shooting stall. Every gesture made him believe Mina was Elizabetha reborn. Finally, he invited them to his estate. From the balcony, Mina admired the castle-like property, and Dracula learned she loved quiet, rural life, confirming his growing attachment. Dracula took Mina to a room and showed her a 17th century music box that had belonged to his late wife. He admitted he was a widowerower and played the haunting tune which stirred strange familiar visions in Mina. When he called her Elizabetha, she insisted she was not and was soon to be married. Dracula asked her to accept the music box as a gift. Maria suddenly arrived and took Mina away. Later, Dracula escorted her home. Mina thanked him and he confessed he hadn't felt joy in centuries. Inside, Mina was horrified to see Jonathan, injured and half dead, with the priest and doctor. The priest explained Jonathan had barely escaped Dracula's castle and revealed the truth. The man she had spent time with was Count Dracula, the cause of Maria's condition and countless disasters. Mina refused to believe it, insisting Dracula had been kind. The priest warned that Maria had sucked a doctor's blood and escaped. He insisted Mina be examined. Mina denied any wrongdoing had occurred and insisted Dracula had always treated her with respect. The priest explained Dracula used a perfume that could override free will. Terrified, Mina allowed a check and finding no bite marks, locked herself in a room. As Jonathan recovered, Mina sat alone with the music box. Its melody shook her deeply, stirring visions of another life. In the midst of her fear, Dracula appeared, reassuring her that he meant no harm. The land lady knocked, upset about the midnight music. Mina, scared, asked Dracula to leave. Instead, he went to the window as if to die. Mina begged him not to. He said he could disappear forever, but had waited 400 years for this moment. She called him a sorcerer. He admitted he once used perfumes and powers to control people, but never her, and smashed the vial to prove it. Mina noted he survived on human blood. He agreed, but said she was never his victim. She is his love. Dracula revealed his curse. He was no longer human, doomed to live in darkness. Mina asked why he involved her. He said it was grief over losing his wife, Elizabetha. At that moment, blood dripped from Mina's nose. Gently, Dracula touched it, tasted it, and called it incomparable. He confessed that without blood, he was nothing more than a frail, withering old man. Mina trembled, calling him a liar and a deceiver. But he held her hands tenderly and reminded her of her own words. My prince, my king, my life. Her tears stopped. Mina realized she could not live without him. Overcome with passion, she begged him to make her part of his body and soul. Dracula finally gave in. The priest sensed Dracula's presence in Mina's house, but found only his hat. Realizing Dracula had taken her, Jonathan erupted in anger, calling him a demon while the priest urged calm. Meanwhile, Maria returned to her fianceé Henry and tried to bite him. The priest, doctor, and Jonathan intervened. Jonathan, despite his weakness, beheaded Maria with a decorative sword. Her body still clung to the priest until he drove an iron crucifix through her chest and her body turned to ash. Meanwhile, Dracula's loyal servants carried a great coffin back to the castle. Inside was not only Dracula, but Mina, too. In his grand hall, Dracula welcomed her, guiding her through the palace and presenting her before all as Princess Elizabetha. When Mina played the music box, its soft melody filled the castle. Smiling, Dracula told her it was the same tune that had always called out to him. Outside, the police, doctor, priest, Henry, and Jonathan had tracked Dracula's servants to the castle and prepared cannons, fearing Mina's soul was in danger. Inside, Dracula, absorbed in Mina, was interrupted as the walls shook from the cannon fire. Gargoyles attacked the intruders, and Dracula left Mina behind, promising to return. Below, officials found a tomblike furnace and fired at it. But Dracula appeared behind Jonathan, dagger in hand, reminding him that he had once spared his life before slaughtering the men. Henry tried to fight, but Dracula bit his neck, and only the priest remained. The priest explained his mission was to save, not fight. While Dracula said his real battle was with God. The priest revealed Dracula was truly fighting himself, not God, and that humans shed blood for their own pride, not for divine will. He urged Dracula to see this as a chance for redemption, but warned that Mina was not his salvation. She could be his destruction. Mina's terrified scream echoed through the castle, and Dracula rushed to her. Officers stormed the halls, but his gargoyles slowed them while he cut down anyone in his path. Finally, he found Mina hiding. For a moment, he feared he had lost her. Yet, holding her close reminded him that if he died, the curse would die, too. Mina begged him not to end his life, insisting he was her freedom, not her prison. Torn, Dracula reflected on his centuries of grief and prayer for Elizabeth's soul. The priest reminded him that salvation was possible if he saved Mina. Mina pounded on the locked door while Dracula opened his arms to fate. The priest struck, driving the stake into his heart. In that single instant, the centuries of torment were lifted, and Dracula's true form surfaced. An old, fragile man stripped of his power. His body aged within seconds, skin sinking, bones weakening until he crumbled in Mina's arms. She carried him to the altar, sobbing as his body collapsed into dust. From within the castle, children began to emerge, once monstrous gargoyles, now restored to their human selves. Confused and weak, they stumbled into freedom as though reborn. Jonathan rushed to find Mina, but discovered her still clinging to Dracula's ashes. As the dust rose into the air, drawn upward by an unseen power, Jonathan understood what it meant. Mina's fate had diverged from his. With a broken heart, he left her there. The priest, his mission fulfilled, also departed the ruins. Dracula's remains drifted skyward, carried into eternity, and with them ended a love story born in grief, cursed by blood, and sealed in tragedy. So, dear viewers, how did you like this recap? Experts explain that this strong pulse directly damages the brain, and the chances of residents surviving are very slim. However, the female lead, Molly, still heads to this disaster area without hesitation because her husband worked on this island and is now listed among the missing persons. Even if her husband is truly dead, Molly wants to find his body. However, the official operations are baffling. Immediately after the incident, the island is blockaded. Let alone the news media, even the families of the deceased cannot get close. Molly tried everything and eventually gained access to the island as a body recovery volunteer. In fact, many people did the same as her, wanting to take the opportunity to find the whereabouts of missing family members. However, a speech by the leading officer instantly caused an uproar among the volunteers. Some of the deceased showed unexplainable abnormalities. They would come back to life without warning. To calm everyone's emotions, the officer quickly explained that these living dead move slowly and have no aggressiveness, and every street is guarded by armed soldiers. Molly turned pale with fear, but thinking of her missing husband, she gritted her teeth and persevered. After receiving her equipment, Molly followed the large group onto a bus to the quarantine zone to recover bodies. The scene before her was unbearable, with ashes and ruins everywhere. The once prosperous island had turned into a silent graveyard. Volunteers worked in pairs, collecting bodies house to house along the streets. Molly carefully walked through a hall and saw the bodies of a family of three through the curtains. However, death came so suddenly that they didn't even have time to turn off the faucet. Molly's partner couldn't stand the tragedy and turned to quit the volunteer ranks. Molly's second partner is named Jason. This guy looks much more casual. Seeing a corpse not only doesn't make him uncomfortable, but he even strikes up a conversation and jokes casually. Under Jason's influence, Molly gradually adapted to this recovery work. At least when she saw a terrifying corpses, she wouldn't scream in fear. Molly knew very well in her heart that what the volunteers feared most was not the tragic state of the corpses, but seeing a familiar face in the pile of bodies. Looking at the wedding photo on the wall, Molly recalled the happy moments with her husband. She originally wanted to go directly to the south where he worked to find him, but the military soldier said the fires there had not yet been extinguished and it was still under absolute blockade. Molly could only wait anxiously while collecting bodies. One day, she and her partner Jason broke into a shop when sudden shouts came from outside. A volunteer rushed into the street and lit a signal flare. It turned out they had discovered a living dead person. After the soldiers arrived upon hearing the news, several gunshots rang out. Molly's heart tightened, and she rushed into the nearest warehouse. Shining her flashlight down, there were actually bloodstains on the ground. She saw a figure standing behind a shelf. Jason calmly lit the signal flare, and before long, several gunshots rang in their ears. Molly felt a strange sense of loss. She always felt that these living dead could still be considered human and shouldn't be ruthlessly strangled like this. The military's cold attitude made Molly's desire to find her husband even more urgent. However, this place is located at the northernmost tip of the island, very far from where her husband worked. She opened her eyes silently and finally stood up without warning. Molly heard a movement and raised her flashlight, seeing the purple-haired woman moving her mouth, her teeth making a clicking grinding sound. The two hearts sank, and they immediately pushed the motorcycle out of the repair shop. The living dead person just now had a fierce look, very different from the dull faces of those guys before. Even though many abandoned vehicles were piled in the middle of the road, with their flexible mobility, they got closer and closer to the southern quarantine zone. The woman suppressed the fear in her heart and stepped on the gas to quickly flee the scene. The next day, Molly woke up in the driver's seat. The road ahead was blocked by obstacles. Photos of the owner's family of four were pasted on the wall. They must have met with misfortune. Unknowingly, it was late at night and strange noises suddenly sounded outside. She tiptoed out of the RV only to see an extremely terrifying scene. A living dead person was digging a pit with effort. Sensing Molly's approach, she did not launch an attack, but silently hugged the bodies of her family members into the pit. Molly recognized the other party as the owner of the RV and couldn't help but step forward to help. Until the end, the mutated car owner actively jumped into the pit. She glanced at Molly not far away. The latter understood and sent car owner on her final journey, burying her with the bodies of her family. By noon the next day, Molly finally arrived at the hotel where her husband lived. Her mood became inexplicably heavy. Having walked all the way without encountering almost any survivors, Molly had already prepared herself mentally that her husband had likely met with misfortune. Slowly reaching the end of the corridor, she finally found her husband's room and pushed open the door with a heavy heart. Sure enough, a body was lying by the bed. Molly suppressed her grief and silently sat cross-legged in front of her husband. Tears were still swirling in her eyes, only to find her husband's finger was empty. Both of their wedding rings were placed on the sink counter in the bathroom. There was also a beauty's work badge on the table. Molly instantly recalled their last meeting. She had wanted to follow her husband to live on this island before, but was ruthlessly rejected by him. It turned out he had already fallen in love with another woman. Now Molly didn't know whether to be sorrowful or happy. Having traveled thousands of miles through hardships and dangers, she came just to find this scumbag. Suddenly footsteps came from behind. It was actually the partner Jason who had escaped before. This man had been worried about Molly and actually ran over to join her. She walked into her husband's room again, took off the wedding ring on her hand, which was a complete farewell to this marriage and a reconciliation with her past self. Finally, with Jason's help, she lifted her husband's body onto a yacht, letting him run toward freedom forever along the direction of the water flow. After handling everything, Molly and Jason drove back to the northern base. On the road, they encountered a blond living dead. She recognized at a glance that this was soldier Logan's wife. Only her abdomen was no longer bulging. Molly seemed to realize something and ran to a ruin following the other's gaze. A healthy newborn baby was actually lying here. The two stared with wide eyes in surprise. Even if the world's original order collapses, love and guardianship can still cross life and death, and hope grows in despair. text: The story follows a lonely gravedigger whose profession has left her smelling like death, literally and hopeless about finding love. That changes when she meets the poet at his sister's funeral. Instead of being repulsed by her odor, he finds it irresistible and boom, we have romance. The plot is insanely fun and fully committed to its absurd premise. It's funny in ways very few films dare to be, and the comedic timing is relentless. text: A Writer's Odyssey arrives as a preordained international blockbuster. Chinese cinema has had a phenomenal year. With American and European cinemas largely closed due to the pandemic, 2020 marked the first time that the highest-grossing films at the global box office were not Hollywood exports. Guan Hu's patriotic The 800 was the biggest film of the year, with the comedy anthology My People, My Homeland placing third. A Writer's Odyssey is in prime position to continue that trend. Adapted from Shuang Xuetao's short story, it opened in the lucrative Lunar New Year's slot and occurred in a simultaneous international rollout to drive in theaters in the United States. The film is co-written and directed by Lu Yang, whose previous efforts include the two Brotherhood of Blades movies, so it has clear blockbuster pedigree. A Writer's Odyssey is an ambitious movie, containing enough plot to sustain three or four smaller films. It opens on Guan Ning, a man desperately searching for his daughter who was kidnapped years ago. When his attempt to disrupt a child trafficking ring goes wrong, he finds himself aligned with a high-profile billionaire named Tu Ling. Ling is convinced that a series of recent health complications are tied to a fantasy novel being written by a young man named Kong Wen Lu. Kong Wen is writing a fantasy epic in which he has cast himself as a noble warrior against the brutal tyrant Lord Red Mane. Ling is convinced that his fate is tied to that of Lord Red Mane and that when Kong Wen finishes the book, he'll kill Red Mane and in doing so will also kill Ling. Naturally, Ling is less than thrilled with this possibility, so hires Guan Ning to kill the young writer on the promise of reuniting the man with his long-lost daughter. This is all in the opening 20 minutes of a film and so gives a flavor of how much is going on, with the film constantly cutting between the real world and the fantasy novel, paralleling the events in the two timelines literally and thematically. This is without even getting into the film's revelation that it exists in a world where people have superpowers, and that Guan Ning has been chosen as the assassin in large part because he can throw rocks, well, really well. There's also a sentient and sassy suit of armor, presumably because Venom did really well at the Chinese box office. But that's a whole other discussion. It's enough perhaps to describe A Writer's Odyssey as Old Boy meets Lord of the Rings by way of adaptation, but with none of those threads given any room to breathe. There's a lot crammed into A Writer's Odyssey, and the film creaks under the strain. The movie suffers from incredible tonal whiplash, pivoting sharply from child trafficking to fan fiction and back again. There are a lot of big ideas here, with the movie touching on everything from corporate control of speech to the suffering of writers to the question of whether imagination is a communal resource. In fact, I can't help but feel that this movie about a tech and logistic billionaire obsessed with controlling a Lord of the Rings-style fantasy is a subtweet of Jeff Bezos, even if I'm not entirely sure how or why. But you know what? It kind of works if you can go with it. A Writer's Odyssey requires suspension bridges of disbelief, but it's repulsive and dynamic. Lu Yang leans heavily on techniques like cranking and zooming, giving the movie a decidedly old-fashioned action aesthetic despite all the CGI. Production design, whether practical or computer-generated, is highly saturated, lending the movie the feeling of a live-action cartoon that helps some of the logic go down a bit easier. A Writer's Odyssey is chaotic and disjointed, but if you can get on its wavelength, it's also good stupid fun. A Writer's Odyssey is available to watch in selected theaters and drive-ins now.

text: इस कहानी के शुरू में हम कैरी गन से मिलते हैं उसके पापा काफी ज्यादा रिच थे पर कैरी गन काफी ज्यादा बिगड़ी हुई थी और इसी वजह से जब उनकी मौत होती है वो उसके लिए कुछ भी नहीं छोड़ते वो अपनी सारी वसीयत को डोनेट कर देते हैं और उसके लिए छोड़ते हैं एक पुरानी सी हवेली अब ये सब सुनकर कैगन को काफी गुस्सा आता है वो कहती है पापा की ऐसी हिम्मत कैसे हुई वो पॉल से कहती है कि मुझे ये हवेली नहीं चाहिए और वो सारे पेपर्स को आग में फेंक देती है पर इसी बीच उन पेपर्स पर एक मैसेज आता है उसमें लिखा था कि हवेली में सोना छुप हुआ है ये जल्दी से उन पेपर्स को बचा लेते हैं अब यह जानकर कैगन को काफी अच्छा लगता है वो कहती है मैं जानती थी पापा ऐसे नहीं जा सकते और देर रात को ये दोनों उस हवेली पर जाते हैं ये हवेली काफी ज्यादा पुरानी थी उसमें लाइट का कोई सोर्स भी नहीं था इसी बीच इस हवेली से आवाजें आने लगती हैं इन दोनों को समझ ही नहीं आता कि ये कैसी आवाजें हैं इसी बीच इनके सामने एक भूत आता है वो इनसे बातें करने की कोशिश करता है पर ये दोनों उसे देखकर डर जाते हैं इसी बीच वहां तीन और भूत आते हैं ये सीधा वहां वहां से भाग ही जाते हैं पर क्योंकि इस हवेली में खजाना था ये दोनों इतने जल्दी हार नहीं मानते इसके अगले ही दिन ये काफी सारे लोगों को बुलाते हैं जो दावा करते थे कि वो भूत भगा सकते हैं पर कोई भी ऐसा कर नहीं पाता इसलिए कैगन डिसाइड करती है कि वो इस हवेली को तोड़ देगी व वैसा भी नहीं हो पाता ये सब लोग भूत को देखकर डर जाते हैं दरअसल इस भूत का नाम कैस्पर था और ये काफी समय से अकेला था इस हवेली में तीन और भूतों के साथ रहता था तभी वो देखता है कि जेम्स नामक एक साइंटिस्ट भूतों से बात करने का दावा करता है दरअसल उसकी वाइफ मर गई थी और वो उससे बात करना चाहता था इसलिए काफी समय से वो भूतों से कांटेक्ट करने की कोशिश कर रहा था इसी बीच उसकी बेटी कैट को टीवी पर दिखाया जाता है और कैस्पर को वो पहली ही नजर में काफी ज्यादा अच्छी लगती है वो सोचता है कि कितना अच्छा होगा अगर कैट उसके सामने आ जाए इसलिए वो कैरी गन के घर पर जाता है और वो टीवी को उसके सामने ले आता है दरअसल वो चाहता था कि कैरीगण जेम्स को देख सके और जैसे ही कैगन उसको देखती है उसे रिलाइज होता है कि शायद जेम्स उन भूतों को भगा सके इसलिए वो जल्दी से जेम्स को कॉल करती है और जेम्स को इस हवेली में बुला लेती है इसके बाद जेम्स कैट के साथ शिफ्ट हो रहा था कैट को ये सब पसंद नहीं था वो अपने पापा से कहती है इतने सालों से आप मॉम से बात करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं पर इसी वजह से भुगतना मुझे पड़ रहा है बार-बार ऐसे शिफ्ट करने की वजह से मेरे कोई भी दोस्त नहीं है उसके पापा उसे कहते हैं ये लास्ट बार है अगर इस बार तुम्हारी मॉम नहीं मिली तो मैं फिर से ऐसा नहीं करूंगा हम यहीं पर सेटल हो जाएंगे इस शहर में आ जाते हैं और इनको रहने के लिए उस हवेली में जगह दी गई थी इस हवेली की हालत काफी ज्यादा खराब होती है इसी बीच कैगन जेम्स से मिलने आती है उसको सब बताती है और कुछ पैसे और फूल देकर उसका स्वागत करती है वो कहती है जितना भी समय लेना है ले लो पर यहां से भूतों को जाना होगा इसके बाद जेम्स अपनी बेटी के साथ उस हवेली के अंदर आता है उनके आने की वजह से कैस्पर काफी एक्साइटेड था जेम्स जल्दी से हवेली की लाइट्स को फिक्स करता है और कैट उसे कहती है कि मैं अपने लिए कोई भी रूम ले रही हूं इसके बाद वो सारे रूम्स देखती है और फाइनली उसे एक रूम अच्छा लगता है है वो डिसाइड करती है कि वो इसी में रहेगी वो अपना सामान छोड़कर आराम कर रही थी इसी बीच कैस पर डिसाइड कर रहा था कि उसे कैट के सामने कैसे जाना चाहिए उसे बस कैट से दोस्ती करनी थी ये दोनों बस सेटल हो रहे थे इसी बीच कैस्पर कैट के सामने आने की कोशिश करता है पर कैट उसे जैसे ही देखती है वो बेहोश हो जाती है कैस्पर उसे जगाने की कोशिश करता है पर कैस्पर को देखकर वो काफी ज्यादा डर जाती है उसकी आवाज सुनकर जेम्स उसके पास आते हैं वो अपने पापा को सब बताती है वो कहती इतने सालों से मैं आपका मजाक उड़ा ही थी कि भूत नहीं होते पर मुझे ऐसा नहीं लगता जेम्स कहता है ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं है पर उसकी मुलाकात भी कैस्पर से होती है यह देखकर उससे भी काफी ज्यादा डर लगता है वो कैट को लेकर बाहर की ओर जाता है और उसे सेफ जगह पर बंद कर देता है इसी बीच कैस्पर की तीनों अंकल्स उसके सामने आते हैं उसे काफी ज्यादा तंग करते हैं और डिसाइड करते हैं कि वो जेम्स को और उसकी बेटी को इस हवेली से भगा देंगे जेम्स काफी ज्यादा डरा हुआ था और इन तीनों को देखते ही उसके होश उड़ जाते हैं उसे समझ नहीं आता कि ये कैसे हो सकता है व अभी तक सिर्फ रिसर्च कर रहा था उसने भूतों को कभी देखा नहीं था पर
