That is until Grace comes to and forces the car off the road. She gets out, and who does she run into but Daniel? Unfortunately, in spite of that earlier realization, Daniel gives her up for dear old dad. Alex is still working on those handcuffs when Becky comes in to chat. She likes Grace, but they have to protect the family. You know how it is. Becky wants to know why Alex left in the first place, and you know what? It was a good sacrifice. Alex says he chooses Grace. Becky doesn't believe him. Now it's time for the family to prepare. Becky tells Emily's boys about their very special friend, Mr. LeBail. Charity checks out the fit of her sacrificial cloak. Aunt Helene does Aunt Helene things, and Fitch works on being his very own best hype man. >> Don't be Fitch, don't be a [ __ ] Look at this [ __ ] >> Grace comes to, gagged and tied to the table, being watched over by taxidermy. Tony's chanting. They're wearing hoods. They're drinking from a sacrificial cup. It's all very devil's cult, and we almost get that hail Satan that every devil's cult sacrifice needs. But, it's cut short when everyone starts coughing up blood. Turns out Daniel is a decent guy after all, and he poisons the sacrificial cup with a nip of hydrochloric acid so he could free Grace and Alex. >> I googled it. They'll get weird for a week, but they'll be fine. >> But, Charity isn't about to let her husband ruin her fancy life. So, she shoots him in the neck. Grace wrestles the gun away, but it's out of bullets. So, she hits Charity with it instead and knocks her out. She does the same thing with Tony and a lantern. She's very good at found object combat. And when she drops this found object, it sets the curtains on fire. Daniel is dying. Grace is trying to get out. Becky is done with all of this and shoots an arrow at Grace. She misses, they fight, and Alex gets to witness what growing up in foster care can do to toughen a girl up. He tries to hug her, but she pulls away. They apologize for two wildly different things, because it's at that point that Alex shows his true colors. >> You're hurting me. >> SHE'S IN HERE! >> IT'S TIME FOR AUNT HELENE TO TAKE CHARGE. There are minutes to go before sunrise. She gives Alex the knife and they all start chanting, and we finally get >> HAIL SATAN! >> HAIL SATAN! >> BUT, GRACE FREES herself just enough so Alex hits the shoulder instead of her heart. There's commotion. The sun rises. Everyone drops like vampires, and nothing happens. The family is starting to freak out. What are they supposed to do now that they've just spent the night trying to kill their newest member? But, Aunt Helene is in it to win it, and she grabs a battle axe. Before she can kill Grace, though, she explodes. Then the gramophone starts up again with the hide-and-seek song, and the rest of them explode, too, one by one. Even those bratty little kids. Alex tries to apologize, but Grace asks for a divorce. He explodes, too. Mr. LaBelle gets a quick cameo. Grace grabs a cigarette case she was admiring earlier, and she waits for the police to arrive while the family mansion burns down. So, where does that leave things? Unfortunately for Grace, Mr. LaBelle's influence extends far beyond the La Domas family. And now, the council, a group of world running elites, are ready to put her and her sister in a new game. No rest for the wicked or for heroines. But hey, masks are back. She just wanted a cigarette.

The director refuses to break immersion with cheap jump scares or unnecessary action spikes and instead doubles down on atmosphere, texture, and rhythm. Shock composition becomes the most direct tool for storytelling. Rarely are characters framed in the center of the image with clarity and openness. एक्सपीरियंस वाला है। बाकी शिप्स के अलावा वह काफी समझदार है। इनमें सिबेस्टियन काफी खास है क्योंकि वह इन सब से काफी बड़ा है और दूसरी बात यह भी है कि उसे झुंड में रहना पसंद नहीं है। वह सारा दिन झुंड से अलग रहता है। ऐसा भी हो सकता है कि उसे अकेलापन पसंद होगा। इन महारानी का नाम है लिली और वह काफी होशियार है। जॉर्ज उसे काफी स्मार्ट मानता है क्योंकि बिना कुछ बताए वह जॉर्ज की सारी बातें समझ जाती है। तो इसी तरीके से जॉर्ज ने अलग-अलग शिप्स के नाम रखे हैं। तो मैंने आपको उन लोगों का नाम बता दिया है जो इस कहानी में काफी काम आने वाले हैं। सुबह होने के बाद सबसे पहले वह इन सारे शिप्स को खाना खिलाता है। इसके बाद वह इन सारे शिप्स का ऊन भी काटता है। इनके एंटरटेनमेंट के लिए फुल जुगाड़ कर रखा है। नीले रंग की एक दवाई है जिसे वो अपने हाथों से एक बीमार शिप को खिलाता है। इस तरह से तो कोई किसी इंसान को भी नहीं खिलाता होगा। रात को सोने से पहले इन सारे शिप्स को एक साथ बैठा करके वो इन्हें कहानियां भी सुनाता है। ज्यादातर वो इन लोगों को डिटेक्टिव वाले कहानियां सुनाता है जिसमें मर्डर, सस्पेंस और मिस्ट्री होता है। जॉर्ज को ऐसा लगता है कि वह बस टाइम पास के लिए इन सारे शिप्स को कहानियां सुनाता है क्योंकि वह जानवर है और जानवर क्या ही कहानी सुनेंगे। लेकिन ऐसा बिल्कुल नहीं है मेरे भाई। यहां हमें मालूम चलता है कि यह सारी शिप आपस में बात करती हैं। जैसे कि लिली कहती है कि मैंने दो चैप्टर पहले ही खूनी के बारे में पता कर लिया था। उस चैप्टर में जो हस्बैंड की पत्नी है ना उसी ने ही खून किया है। जिस पर मैपल कहता है उसकी मौसम में बरसात आता है ना बिल्कुल वैसा ही। लेकिन यहां पर हम एक छोटे से शिप के बच्चे को देखते हैं जो कि विंटर में पैदा हो गया था। इसीलिए सारे शिप उसे विंटर लैंप कहते हैं और विंटर में पैदा होने की वजह से अभी 2 दिन पहले जॉर्ज ने लिखा था। वसीयतनामे पर सबसे पहले वह 300 एकड़ जमीन की बात करता है। जिस जमीन को उसने इस समय केलेले को किराए पर दे रखा है। वह उस जमीन को पीटर के नाम पर करने के लिए बोलता है। इसके बाद वह जिस जगह पर रहता है, वह भी 300 एकड़ की जमीन है। इसे वह अपनी बेटी रेबिका के नाम पर कर देता है। उसके अंदर रेबिका को कुछ सामान मिलता है। उसकी वैन मिलती है जिसमें वह रहता है और अब पूरे शिप्स की देखभाल वही करने वाली है। लेकिन एक चीज और था जिसे सुनकर के सबके होश उड़ जाते हैं। जॉर्ज ने एक मनी बैंक का जिक्र किया था जिसमें टोटल $30 मिलियन थे। इतनी रकम बहुत ज्यादा होती है। किसी को उम्मीद नहीं थी कि जॉर्ज के पास इतने सारे पैसे हैं और अब यह सारे पैसे रेबिका को मिलने वाले थे। यह लोग पूछते भी हैं कि आखिर उसके पास इतने सारे पैसे आए कहां से? तब लीडिया बताती है कि आज से 2 साल पहले जॉर्ज ने शिप के इलाज के लिए एक दवाई बनाई थी। यहां उसी दवाई की बात हो रही थी जिसे जॉर्ज अपने बीमार शिप को खिला रहा था। उस शिप को ओफ की बीमारी हुई थी। उस दवाई को बेच के जॉर्ज को इतने सारे पैसे मिले थे। इधर जो मैपल था वह जैसे तैसे करके खुद को उस लकड़ी से आजाद कर लेता है। लेकिन तभी वह पीछे रखे एक सामान से टकरा जाता है। जिससे वह सारा सामान नीचे गिर जाता है। सामान गिरने की आवाज सुनकर के सभी लोग काफी डर जाते हैं। मैपल के मुंह पर एक बेडशीट गिर पड़ती है जिसकी वजह से उसका मुंह ढक जाता है। वह भागते हुए होटल के अंदर आ जाता है और सामानों को तोड़फोड़ करने लगता है। इस दौरान जब वो गलती से किताबों को नीचे गिराता है तो तभी टीम जॉर्ज के लेटर को देख लेता है जो कि बेथ ने यहां पर छुपा कर रखा था। हालांकि बेथ जल्दी से उस लेटर को उठा करके छुपा लेती है और उस शिप को बाहर भगाने के लिए बोलती है। जैसे तैसे करके केब उस शिप को काबू करता है और फिर वह टीम से कहता है कि हमें बहुत जल्द इनके लिए शेफर्ड ढूंढना होगा। वरना यह ऐसे ही टाउन में भटकती रहेंगी। वैसे वह काला वाला बहुत जंगली है। जॉर्ज उसे कार्निवाल से लेकर आया था। यहां लिली भी केलव की बातें सुन लेती है। इसके बाद मैथ्यू जाकर के टिम से मिलता है और उसे बताता है कि जिस रात जॉर्ज का मर्डर हुआ उस रात उसने जॉर्ज के मैदान में किसी को देखा था। कोई था जो टॉर्च जला करके वहां से बाहर निकल रहा था। मैथ्यू कहता है कि हम साथ मिलकर के इस गु्थी को सुलझा सकते हैं। मैं तुम्हारे लिए यह केस सॉल्व कर दूंगा। बदले में मुझे एक तड़कता भड़कता न्यूज़ मिल जाएगा। जिसके बाद टीम उसके साथ काम करने के लिए तैयार हो जाता है। वैसे इसी समय आप लोग वीडियो को पॉज करके कमेंट करके बताओ कि आखिर कातिल कौन हो सकता है? इतना ध्यान देना कि आप वीडियो को जिस मिनट पर रोक करके कमेंट करोगे वो मिनट कमेंट बॉक्स में मेंशन हो जाएगा। तो फटाफट सभी लोग तुक्का मारो। बताओ कातिल कौन है? इधर लिली अपने दोस्तों के पास आकर के उन सबको बताती है कि यह केस काफी उलझता जा रहा है। टीम इस केस को सही तरीके से सॉल्व नहीं कर पा रहा है। इसे सॉल्व करने के लिए हमें उसकी हेल्प करनी होगी। जॉर्ज हमें जिस किताब को पढ़ाता था, वह किताब हमें उसे देनी होगी। उस किताब को पढ़ के वह इस केस को सॉल्व कर सकता है। उसी समय इन लोगों को मैदान में रेबिका दिखाई देती है जो कि टॉर्च जला करके कुछ ढूंढ रही होती है। जब उसे वह चीज नहीं मिलती है तो वह मायूस होकर के बैठ जाती है। फिर उसी समय उसके पास वो विंटर लैंप आता है जिसे वह उठा के उसके साथ में खेलने लगती है। खैर इधर लेली सभी लोगों को जॉर्ज के वैन के पास लेकर जाती है। इनमें से एक शिप को उस किताब के बारे में काफी अच्छे से पता था। तो वह सिर्फ अंदर जाती है और उसी किताब को लेकर के बाहर आती है। इसके बाद यह लोग इस किताब को ले जाकर के जॉर्ज के दरवाजे के सामने रख देते हैं। वापस आकर के लिली जाकर के सिबेस्टियन से मिलती है और उससे पूछती है कि यह कार्निवाल क्या होता है? वैसे तो सिबेस्टियन का मूड काफी अपसेट था। वह कुछ बताना नहीं चाहता था लेकिन फिर भी वह लिली को बताता है। वह लिली को बताता है कि कार्निवाल वह जगह है जहां लोग तमाशा देखने के लिए पैसे देते हैं। मुझे हर दिन एक कुत्ते से लड़ने के लिए उसमें छोड़ा जाता था। मुझे तब तक उस कुत्ते से लड़ना पड़ता था जब तक मैं घायल नहीं हो जाता। फिर पता नहीं कहां से वहां पर एक दिन जोर्ज आ गया। वह मुझे वहां से खरीद करके अपने झुंड के पास ले आया। जिसके बाद लिली उससे पूछती भी है कि आखिर तुम्हारा झुंड कहां पर है। तुम अपने झुंड को छोड़ के अलग क्यों हो गए? यह सुनकर के सिबेस्टियन उसकी तरफ एक पल के लिए देखता है। जिससे लिली समझ जाती है कि वह भी एक विंटर लैंप है। इसीलिए उसे भी उसके झुंड से अलग कर दिया गया था। किताब को पढ़ने के बाद टिम को इतना तो पता चल जाता है कि उसे केस को किस तरीके से सॉल्व करना है। पहले तो वह यह पता लगाता है कि बेरी का पेड़ किन लोगों के आसपास है। दूसरा तो वह यह पता लगाता है कि आखिर जॉर्ज को मारने का मकसद क्या हो सकता है। अब किसी और का मकसद का तो पता नहीं लेकिन रेबिका के पास मकसद है क्योंकि उसे ढेर सारे पैसे मिलने वाले थे और हो सकता है कि उसे डर हो कि यह पैसे उसके भाई को ना मिल जाए। सबसे पहले टीम हेम के पास जाता है और उससे पूछताछ करता है। वैसे तो हैम के पास कुछ खास वजह तो था नहीं। वो बस इतना कहता है कि मैं एक बूचर हूं। मैं मीट वगैरह काटता हूं जो कि जॉर्ज को बिल्कुल पसंद नहीं था। इसीलिए वह मुझसे नफरत करता था। इसके बाद यह लोग बेथ के पास जाते हैं। टीम उससे पूछता है कि तुम्हारे पास जॉर्ज का लेटर कैसे आया? बेथ झूठ बोलती है। गलती से वह मेरे होटल पर आ गया था। मुझे मिला तो मैंने उसे रख लिया। इसके बाद वह कैलेब के पास जाता है। कैललेब के पास बहुत बड़ी वजह थी, लेकिन वह उस वजह का जिक्र नहीं करता। वह झूठ बोलता है। फिलहाल वह वजह हमें आगे पता चल ही जाएगा। अभी के लिए कैलब इतना बोलता है कि जॉर्ज की नजर में मैं बुरा था। इसके बाद यह दोनों फादर के पास जाते हैं। टीम उससे पूछता है कि जिस दिन उसकी मौत हुई उसी दिन उसने तुम्हें ढेर सारा डोनेशन क्यों दिया? फादर बताता है कि आए दिन वह मेरे पास आता था क्योंकि उसे अपने बच्चों की तलाश थी। लेकिन मैं उसे कुछ बता नहीं सकता था क्योंकि यह हमारे नियमों के खिलाफ था। अगर मैं बताता तो मुझे फादर के पद से हटा दिया जाता। लेकिन फिर भी वह इसके बदले में हमें पैसे देता था। मैंने उन पैसों का गलत इस्तेमाल नहीं किया है बल्कि उन पैसों को चर्च के कंस्ट्रक्शन में लगा दिया है। इसके बाद यह लोग रेबिका के पास जाते हैं। जहां टीम उससे पूछता है कि जिस दिन तुम्हारे पिता की मौत हुई तुम इसी जगह पर थे। तो फिर तुमने हमसे झूठ क्यों बोला? जिस पर रेबिका बताती है कि हां मैं इस जगह पर थी लेकिन इस टाउन में नहीं थी। उस दिन मैंने एयरपोर्ट पर होटल बुक किया था और मैं वहीं पर रुकी हुई थी। यह केस काफी पेचीदा होते जा रहा था। लिली को एहसास हो रहा था कि जॉर्ज को रेबिका ने ही मारा है क्योंकि रेबिका ने अब तक काफी झूठ बोला है। उसकी आंखों में झूठ साफ दिख रहा था। तभी यहां पर विंटर लैंप आता है और वह इन सब से कहता है कि इसमें रेबिका की कोई गलती नहीं है। रेबिका से जॉर्ज की खुशबू आती है। यह बात सुनकर के लिली को कुछ याद आता है। दरअसल पिछली रात को क्लाउड ने भी यही बात बोली थी। आखिर क्लाउड को कैसे पता कि रेबिका में से जॉर्ज की खुशबू आती है। जिसका मतलब साफ था कि क्लाउड कुछ तो छुपा रही है। लिली उससे पूछती भी है कि आखिर बात क्या है? इसके बाद क्लाउड इन लोगों को लेकर के एक कड़े के पास जाता है। दरअसल यह जो कड़ा है ना यह रेबिका का है। क्लाउड बताती है कि जिस रात जॉर्ज की मौत हुई रेबिका यहां पर आई थी। उस रात जब भूख की वजह से मेरी आंख खुली तब मैंने रेबिका को देखा। उस समय रेबिका ने मुझे देखा और मुझे अपने हाथों से सहलाया। उसी समय उसका कड़ा नीचे गिर गया। शायद रेबिका इसी चीज को ढूंढने के लिए वह रात में आई थी। इसके बाद हमें टीम को दिखाया जाता है। मैपल उसके टोपी को लेकर के भागता है। वह टीम को अपने पीछे भगाते हुए मैदान तक ले आता है। यहां जब वह अपनी टोपी उठाता है, तभी उसे वह कड़ा दिखाई देता है। उसे देखते ही वह समझ जाता है कि यह तो रेबिका का है। इस एक चीज की वजह से रेबिका बहुत ही बुरी तरीके से फंस जाती है। यह चीज रेबिका का ही था। यह बात साबित होते ही टीम उसके कमरे की तलाशी लेता है और इस दौरान टीम को उसका जूता मिलता है। जब वह जूते को चेक करता है तब उसमें उसे बेरीज लगी हुई दिखाई देती हैं। अब इसके आगे कुछ बोलने या कहने की बात ही नहीं थी। इससे साबित हो चुका था कि रेबिका ने ही जॉर्ज को मारा है। इसके बाद टीम उसे स्टेशन लेकर के जाता है जहां वह रेबिका से पूछताछ करता है। वह पूछता है कि आखिरी बार जॉर्ज से मिलकर के उसने क्या किया? तब रेबिका बताती है कि उन्होंने मुझे मिलने के लिए बुलाया था। उस रात मैं उनके पास गई थी। यह बात बिल्कुल सच है। लेकिन अगर यह बात मैं तुम्हें बताती तो मैं उल्टा फंस जाती क्योंकि पूरा शक मुझ पर ही आता। मैंने अपने डैड को नहीं मारा है। हमने साथ में बैठकर के काफी समय तक बातें की। उन्होंने मुझे अपने सारे शिप्स के बारे में बताया। वह चाहते थे कि मैं उनके शिप्स को संभालूं। मेरा यकीन करो मैंने उनकी हत्या नहीं की है। लेकिन टीम उसकी बात नहीं मानता है। वह उसे जेल में बंद कर देता है। टीम उसे बताता है कि कल तुम्हें कोर्ट ले जाएंगे। जहां जॉर्ज की हत्या में तुम्हारे ऊपर मुकदमा चलेगा। इसके बाद टीम लीडिया से मिलता है और उसे बताता है कि रेबिका ने ही मर्डर किया है। इन लोगों को पहले से ही डाउट था कि पैसों के चक्कर में रेबिका ने ऐसा किया होगा। फिलहाल लीडिया बताती है कि मेरे पास पीटर का कॉल आया था। उन्होंने मुझसे कहा है कि वह अपनी पूरी जमीन और सभी शिप्स को केलेले को बेचने वाले हैं। कल दोपहर में सब कुछ होगा तो अगर तुम आना चाहो तो आ सकते हो। यहां पर लिली भी थी जो छुप करके इनकी बातें सुन रही थी। वह वापस जाकर के मैपल को बताती है कि अब हम सब केलेले के साथ में रहेंगे क्योंकि कल वह हमारे झुंड को खरीदने वाला है। केस सॉल्व हो चुका है। रेबिका ने ही मर्डर किया था। उसे जेल में बंद कर दिया गया है। कल उसे कोर्ट ले जाया जाएगा। उसी समय मैपल कहता है क्यों ना हम एक बार चढ़ के केप के झुंड से मिल आएं। वह यहां से ज्यादा दूर नहीं है। पास में ही है और वैसे भी अब हमें साथ में ही रहना है। लिली उसकी बात मान करके झुंड से मिलने के लिए जाने लगती है। वहां पहुंच करके इन्हें चारों तरफ खाली मैदान दिखाई देता है। तभी अचानक से इनके पीछे से ढेर सारी शिप्स आ जाती हैं। इन सभी का मुंह काफी अजीब तरीके से था। लिली इन्हें बताती है कि अब हम भी तुम्हारे झुंड के हिस्सा होने वाले हैं। केले हमारे झुंड को खरीदने वाला है। लेकिन तभी एक शिप सामने आता है और लिली से कहता है कि यहां से भाग जाओ। उसी समय इन सबको एक अजीब आवाज सुनाई देती है। अगले ही पल सारे शिप यहां से गायब हो जाते हैं। इसके बाद लिली और मैपल भी यहां से निकलने लगते हैं। लेकिन तभी लिली को एक रोशनी दिखाई देता है और वहां पर जाने के बाद इन्हें मालूम चलता है कि यह लोग केलेलेब के फार्म पर पहुंच गए हैं। फार्म के अंदर जाने के बाद इन्हें कुछ दिखाई देता है जिसे देखकर के इनके होश उड़ जाते हैं। इन्हें मालूम चलता है कि केलेब हेम के साथ मिला हुआ है। हेम के जरिए वह शिप्स को कटवाता है। उसी समय यहां पर केलेले के कुत्ते आ जाते हैं जो इनका पीछा करने लगते हैं। लिली इन कुत्तों से ज्यादा स्पीड में नहीं भाग पाती। एक कुत्ता उस पर हमला करने वाला था लेकिन तभी यहां पर सेबेस्टियन आ जाता है जो लिली को बचा लेता है। उसने पहले भी कुत्तों से फाइट किया था। इसीलिए वह बड़े ही आराम से इन कुत्तों से फाइट करके इन्हें यहां से भगा देता है। लेकिन दिक्कत की बात यह थी कि इन कुत्तों से फाइट करने की वजह से वह भी काफी जख्मी हो गया था। इस वक्त वह आखिरी सांसे गिन रहा था। लिली उसे कहती भी है कि आखिर तुमने अपनी जान जोखिम में क्यों डाली? सिबेस्टियन कहता है कि तुम भी हमारे झुंड के हिस्सा हो। लिली उसे आखिरी बार गले से लगाती है। उसी समय यहां पर एक कार आ जाती है। इसीलिए लिली और मैपल यहां से भाग जाते हैं। यह दोनों जल्दी से भाग करके अपने झुंड के पास जाते हैं और अपने झुंड को लेकर के यहां से निकलने लगते हैं। लेकिन जब रोड क्रॉस करने की बारी आती है तो सभी शिप रुक जाती हैं। वह यहां से बाहर निकलने के लिए मना कर देती हैं। तभी लिली इन लोगों को बताती है कि कल हमें केलेप खरीदने वाला है और अभी हम उसके फार्म पर से आ रहे हैं। वह हेम के साथ मिला हुआ है जो मीट काटता है। अगर हम आज यहां से नहीं निकले तो हमारी भी फील्डिंग सेट हो जाएगी। लेकिन पता नहीं क्यों सब के सब लिली की बातों को ज्यादा सीरियस नहीं लेते। वो यह कहती हैं कि केलव हमसे बहुत प्यार करता है। वह हमें नुकसान नहीं पहुंचाएगा। इन्हें लगा कि यह सारी बातें झूठी हैं। इसीलिए यह सभी लोग उन सारी बातों को एक पल में भुला देते हैं। किसी को कुछ भी याद नहीं था कि आखिर लिली ने क्या बोला बल्कि सभी लोग वापस लौट करके फार्म पर चले जाते हैं। लिली काफी मायूस हो जाती है क्योंकि वह अपने लोगों को बचाना चाहती लेकिन कोई उसकी बात समझने को तैयार ही नहीं था। मैपल कहता है कि कोई बात नहीं तुमने कोशिश तो किया। हम सब बेवकूफ हैं। इसलिए हमारे साथ यही होना चाहिए। फिलहाल इस समय लिली को समझ में नहीं आ रहा था कि आखिर वह क्या करें। इसीलिए वह जॉर्ज के वैन के पास जाकर के बैठ जाती है और वह जॉर्ज को याद करने लगती है। उसी समय यहां पर जॉर्ज आता है। यह एक प्रकार से इमेजिनेशन था। वो लिली को गाइड करने के लिए आया था। लिली उसे बताती है कि उसे कुछ समझ में नहीं आ रहा है कि आखिर कातिल कौन है। हम सभी ने तो सस्पेक्ट को ही कातिल मान बैठे हैं। जिस पर जॉर्ज कहता है कि यही तो हम सबसे बड़ी गलती करते हैं। हम सस्पेक्ट को ही कातिल मान बैठते हैं क्योंकि सस्पेक्ट को फंसाना काफी आसान हो जाता है। कातिल ने भी सस्पेक्ट का फायदा उठाया है। उसे पता था कि रेबिका मुझसे मिलने के लिए आने वाली है। कातिल ने उसी चीज का फायदा उठाया है। इसके बाद जॉर्ज उसे अपने दोनों हाथ दिखाता है। एक ब्लू था और दूसरा वाला ग्रीन था। ब्लू समझ में आता है लेकिन ग्रीन क्यों? बस यहीं से लिली के दिमाग की बत्ती जल जाती है। वह अच्छे से समझ जाती है कि आखिर कातिल कौन है। अब वह यह बात रेबिका को बताना चाहती थी, साबित करना चाहती थी जिसके लिए इन्हें स्टेशन के अंदर जाना होगा। लिली जा नहीं सकती क्योंकि वह साइज में बड़ी है। उसी समय यहां पर विंटर लैंप आता है जो इनसे कहता है कि मैं तुम्हारी हेल्प कर सकता हूं। वैसे भी मैं छोटा हूं और कहीं पर भी जा सकता हूं। इसके बाद वह सबसे पहले येलो पेंट में अपना एक हाथ डालता है और फिर दूसरा वाला हाथ ब्लू पेंट में डालता है। इतना करने के बाद लिली उसे लेकर के स्टेशन पर जाती है। जहां पर एक छोटी सी खिड़की के जरिए विंटर लैंप अंदर चला जाता है। अंदर जाने के बाद सबसे पहले वह कुछ फोटो वगैरह लेता है। इस समय ध्यान देना कि लिली उसे गाइड कर रही होती है। फोटो को जमीन पर रख करके वह कुछ लाइन खींचता है। रेबेका को बिल्कुल समझ में नहीं आता कि आखिर यह सब चल क्या रहा है। विंटर लैंप अपना काम करके यहां से चला जाता है। सुबह में जब टीम स्टेशन में आता है तब वह उन सारी चीजों को देखता है। तब रेबिका उसे बताती है कि एक छोटा सा शिप अंदर आया था। उसी ने ही यह सब कुछ किया है। एक बड़ा सा शिप भी था जो उसे गाइड कर रहा था। टीम को लगा कि रेबिका बकवास कर रही है। उसे उसकी बातों पर यकीन नहीं होता। रेबेका का फोटो रख के उस पर ब्लू लाइन था और वह ब्लू लाइन जाकर के जॉर्ज के फोटो से मिला हुआ था। इसी में एक ऑल लाइन था। उस पर येलो रंग गिराया गया था। येलो रंग की वजह से वह ग्रीन हो गया था। फिलहाल एक पल के लिए टीम को भी समझ में नहीं आता है कि आखिर यह सब क्या है। जब वह इसे साफ करने लगता है तो कलर उसके हाथों में भी लग जाता है। अब इसके बाद वह रेबका को लेकर के बाहर जाता है और पुलिस वालों के हवाले कर देता है क्योंकि यह लोग रेबिका को कोर्ट ले जाने वाले थे। टीम के साइन करने के बाद जब यह लोग रेबिका को लेकर के यहां से जाने लगते हैं, तभी टीम को यह शिप दिखाई देती हैं। यहीं पर वह उस छोटे वाले शिप को भी देखता है जिसके पैरों में रंग लगा हुआ था। अब इन्हीं कलर्स की वजह से धीरे-धीरे टीम को भी समझ में आ जाता है कि आखिर सीन क्या चल रहा है। तभी वह पुलिस वालों को रोकता है और उनसे कहता है कि रेबिका ने खून नहीं किया है बल्कि कातिल कोई और है और वह रेबिका को फंसाने की पूरी कोशिश कर रहा है। उसे अच्छे से पता था कि रेबिका अपने डैड से मिलने के लिए आने वाली है और उसी चीज का उसने फायदा उठाया। यह बात साफ है कि जॉर्ज ने दो लेटर लिखा था। एक रेबिका के लिए और एक अपने बेटे पीटर के लिए। लेकिन जब पीटर को मालूम चला कि रेबिका को $30 मिलियन मिलने वाले हैं तो उससे यह देखा नहीं गया और लेटर के जरिए पीटर को पता चल जाता है कि रेबिका अपने डैड से जाकर के मिलने वाली है। पीटर ने इसी चीज का फायदा उठाया और शुरू से ही अपना नाम बदल करके पीटर हमारे बीच में ही था और वह कोई और नहीं बल्कि मैथ्यू है। हालांकि मैथ्यू कहता भी है कि यह तुम कैसी बातें कर रहे हो? मैं यहां पर सिर्फ रिपोर्टिंग करने आया हूं। जिस पर टिम कहता है कि मुझे सब समझ में आ गया है। तुमने यहां से वापस लौट कर जाने का नाटक किया। जानबूझ करके अपने कार का एक्सीडेंट भी किया ताकि लोगों को तुम पर शक ना हो। उस रात जब जॉर्ज वैन में अकेला था तब तुम उससे मिलने के लिए गए। मौका देख के तुमने उसके ड्रिंक में जहर मिलाया। उसे पीने के कुछ समय के बाद जॉर्ज का हाल बेहाल हो गया। उसी समय तुमने एक नया वसीहतनामा लिखा और उसे टेबल पर रख दिया। लेकिन जब तुम वहां से वापस निकलने लगे तब जॉर्ज ने तुम पर हमला किया। तुम दोनों के बीच में फाइट हुई और वह तुम्हें आराम से हरा सकता था। लेकिन जॉर्ज पर जहर का असर होने की वजह से तुम जीत गए। जिस दिन वसीहतनामा पढ़ा जाने वाला था उस दिन भी तुम वहीं पर थे। लेकिन text: [Music] The Phoenician Scheme is an intriguing nor thriller set in the morally ambiguous world of international arms dealing that takes viewers on a complex journey of redemption, family secrets, and highstakes business manipulation. Released in 2025, this film combines elements of a classic con movie with deeper themes of familial reconciliation and moral awakening. At its core, the story follows Anatol Za Corda, a notorious arms dealer fighting for survival after an assassination attempt while trying to salvage both his business empire and his broken relationship with his daughter. Let's dive into this captivating tale that spans continents, encompasses multiple double crosses, and ultimately delivers a surprising conclusion about the true meaning of family and redemption. The film opens with a hearttoppping sequence as Cordon narrowly escapes an assassination attempt in 1950. As he lies unconscious, hovering between life and death, the audience is transported to a dreamlike afterlife where Ca faces a divine court judging his worthiness to enter heaven. This surreal scene sets the tone for the moral examination that will unfold throughout the film. When Corder regains consciousness, he's confronted with the reality that the assassins will eventually succeed unless he makes drastic changes to his life. This near-death experience becomes the catalyst for his attempt to reconnect with his only daughter, Sister Lisel, a Catholic novice who has chosen a life entirely opposed to her father's world of weapons and warfare. The father-daughter relationship between Corda and Lisel forms the emotional backbone of the film. Their arangement runs deep. Cortis sent Lisil to a convent when she was only 5 years old, effectively abandoning her to be raised by nuns rather than providing her with a father's love and guidance. Even more damaging to their relationship is the persistent rumor that Corda murdered Lisel's mother, an accusation he vehemently denies throughout much of the film. When Corda approaches Lisel with the surprising request that she leave the church and take over his business empire, the tension between them becomes palpable. Their interactions are filled with unresolved pain, distrust, and the complicated love that can exist even in the most fractured family relationships. Meanwhile, governments worldwide have grown weary of Corda's unethical business practices and are conspiring to bring him down. Enter Excalibur, a government agent working with international powers to orchestrate Corda's financial demise. The opportunity arises when Corda stakes his entire fortune on a monumentally risky infrastructure project in Phoenicia, a venture that relies on slave labor and shady financing. Excalibur's plan is both simple and devastating. Drive up the price of building materials to bankrupt COA. This economic sabotage forms the backdrop against which the personal drama unfolds. With Corda growing increasingly desperate as his financial situation deteriorates with his financial empire hanging in the balance, Corda embarks on a whirlwind tour to secure additional funding from his investors, bringing along both Lisil and his Norwegian administrative assistant, Bujorn. Bujorn is introduced as an entomologist by training. His knowledge of insects an interesting counterpoint to the human insects Corda deals with in the business world. The chemistry between Bujornne and Lisel is subtle but grows throughout the film as they share their mutual distaste for Cord's methods while simultaneously being drawn into his web of deceit. Cord's meetings with his investors showcase his manipulative brilliance and moral bankruptcy. He employs a different underhanded tactic with each investor. deception with the Californians Leland and Reagan, blackmail with French nightclub owner Marseilles Bob, and outright threats of a suicide bombing with East Coast businessman Marty. Each encounter reveals another layer of Cord's ruthlessness, further straining his already tenuous relationship with Lisel, who watches in horror as her father operates without any apparent moral compass. Despite the investors justified outrage, Ca manages to slither out of each confrontation with partial commitments. Though they agree to cover only half of the budget shortfall he desperately needs. The film takes a dramatic turn when Cortis steps in front of a bullet mint for Marseilles Bob, returning him to the afterlife where he encounters Lisel's mother. This supernatural interlude delivers the first major revelation. Corda is not Lisel's biological father. This shocking truth forces Corda to confront the emptiness of his relationship with both his wife and Lisel. He realizes that all he had to offer his family was money, not love or genuine connection. This epiphany becomes the first step in his eventual transformation. Later, during a heated confrontation with Marty, Cord's guilt overwhelms him, leading to a devastating confession. He knew Lisel's mother was having an affair with his aranged half-brother, Nubar. In a cruel act of revenge, Corda fabricated a story that she was also involved with New Bar's assistant, which drove Newar to murder her in a jealous rage. Most shocking of all, Corda admits that he still conducts business with Newar, who has invested in the Phoenician scheme. This confession marks the Nadier of Corda's moral character in Lisil's eyes, but she agrees to continue helping him with the ulterior motive of bringing new to justice for her mother's murder. In a desperate move to avoid seeking Newar's help, Corda proposes marriage to his cousin Hilda, an Ays to the Corda armament's fortune. While she accepts his proposal, she refuses to increase her investment in his faltering Phoenician venture. Just when things couldn't get worse, saboturs destroy Cord's plane during their flight home. The wreckage investigation reveals another shocking twist. Bejorn is actually a spy working for Excalibur's international consortium. However, in a testament to the film's exploration of how love can transform even the most calculated plans, Bjornne agrees to switch sides because he has fallen in love with Lisel. As the trio makes their way home following the plane crash, Corda opens up to Lisel about their family's multigenerational dysfunction. This moment of vulnerability, rather than bringing them closer, only disturbs Lisel further. She resolves to abandon any connection to the family business and return to the church. In a bittersweet irony, when they finally make it back, Lisel's mother superior dismisses her from the order, explaining with gentle wisdom that not everyone is destined for religious life, suggesting that Lisel's path lies elsewhere. The film builds to its climax as Cord's investors gather at the Desert Oasis Palace Hotel for a presentation of the Phoenician scheme. It's here that Corda, Lisel, and Bjorn finally confront Nubar, who delivers the final devastating blow by announcing he's withdrawing his entire investment. In the ensuing confrontation, Nubar reveals that he, too, is not Lisel's biological father and confesses that he has been behind the assassination attempts on Corda all along. His motivation is disturbingly simple. Life is a game of who could lick whom. The half brothers engage in a brutal brawl with Corda emerging victorious despite his age and recent injuries. The film's resolution marks a surprising moral transformation for Corda. Having confronted the emptiness of his life and the damage caused by his unscrupulous business practices. He converts to Catholicism, commits to paying his workers fairly, and invests his entire fortune into completing the finish scheme, not for profit, but because finishing a worthy project will give his life meaning. This decision bankrupts him financially, but enriches him spiritually, finally earning him Lisel's respect and acceptance as her father, regardless of biology. The final scenes of the Phoenician scheme offer a touching epilogue to this tale of moral redemption. Corda and Lisel settle into a simpler life running a small beastro. A far cry from the international arms dealing and highstakes scheming that defined Corda's former existence. Hilda breaks off her engagement with Corda, but in a gesture of unexpected generosity, gives the ring to Bejorn, who promptly proposes to Lisel. Her acceptance symbolizes the beginning of a new, healthier family line free from the corrupting influence of weapons and war. The film closes with Lisel and Corda playing cards together. A simple activity that represents the normal family relationship they never had but have finally found. The Phoenician scheme masterfully weaves together themes of redemption, the corrosive effects of wealth and power, the complicated nature of family bonds, and the possibility of moral transformation even after a lifetime of wrongdoing. Cord's journey from a moral arms dealer to a man seeking meaning beyond money offers a compelling character arc. While the mysteries surrounding Lisel's parentage and the various betrayals keep viewers engaged throughout, the film ultimately suggests that family is defined not by blood, but by love and commitment, and that it's never too late to choose a better path, even for someone as seemingly irredeemable as Anatol Jada Corda.

text: The story begins with a small mouse named Petty... Petty loves adventures, and her hero is the brave Jessie... Petty tells us the story of Jessie, who was a legendary hero... Jessie led a team of brave warriors who were all very loyal to him... One day, Jessie and his team set out to find a sacred stone given by the gods... This stone had the power to protect the entire city from any trouble... On this journey, Jessie and his group faced many great challenges... They faced storms and monsters but never gave up until they finally found the stone... He brought the stone back to his city... Peace spread throughout the city as soon as he arrived... The stone's power changed the hearts of all the people... Everyone lived together in harmony, and Jessie became the city's hero... Our main character, Petty, was deeply inspired by Jessie's story... She also wanted to go on adventures and do something great for her city... Petty lives with a cat named Sam, who cares for her like a father... In return, Petty also takes very good care of him... Many other mice lived in the city and stole from the market to survive... These mice also attended school to learn and study together... Petty is now at school with one of her friends... Their teacher tells the class the story of Jessie's bravery... Petty interrupts the teacher to tell the story to the children herself... She had researched Jessie so much that she knew more than the teacher... Petty tells everyone that she will go on a world adventure one day... But instead of praising her, everyone began to laugh... They mocked her, asking how a tiny mouse could go on an adventure... Petty gets very angry at everyone's mean attitude... She stands by the sea and decides to start her adventure today... As she prepares to board a ship, Sam arrives to find her... While trying to get onto the boat, she accidentally falls into the sea... Petty cannot swim, so Sam jumps in immediately to save her... Back at home, Sam explains that her plan is very dangerous... He tells her that she is not ready for such a journey... Petty refuses to listen, and then her friend arrives... They are invited to a ceremony where Jessie will give a speech today... We learn that Petty buys a lottery ticket every single week... The lucky winner gets to go on a tour around the world... Unfortunately, she has never won the prize before... The scene shifts to the start of the grand ceremony... A massive statue of the god Zeus is unveiled to the public... Jessie is there to speak, but he has become very old and weak... During the event, the lottery winner is about to be announced... Sam discovers that Petty has finally won the lottery... However, Sam is terrified of her going on the trip... To stop her from leaving, he quickly swallows the winning ticket... He does this so Petty never finds out that she actually won... The scene shifts to a high view of the sky above... Zeus is very pleased with the people for building the statue... He loves the beautiful monument they have made in his honor... But his brother Poseidon, the god of the sea, is very jealous... Poseidon feels the city belongs to him because it is near the sea... He believes he is the one who protected them from storms... He claims that only he kept their city from being destroyed... He thinks they should have built a statue for him instead of Zeus... Angry and ignored, Poseidon leaves the area in a rage... Later, the citizens gather at the shore to watch a growing storm... Poseidon suddenly emerges from the waves to confront the people... Furious about the Zeus statue, he threatens to destroy the city... But Zeus's magical stone protects the city from his power... Poseidon reaches down and steals the stone from the city... Without the stone, the city is now open to total destruction... He creates a massive storm and gives them only seven days to act... He warns that the sea will soon swallow the entire city... He demands that they build a statue for him immediately... If the statue is not built in seven days, the city will be lost... The statue must also hold a massive, shining trident... If they fail, Poseidon will wipe the city off the map... Every citizen in the city is now filled with worry... They wonder where to find the jewels to make the trident shine... Petty gets an idea and brings a secret map to her friends... She says the map leads to an island full of diamonds and jewels... These jewels are perfect for making Poseidon's trident... Petty wants to go there, but Sam thinks it is too dangerous... A bird warns them that the path to the island is deadly... Meanwhile, the elderly Jessie prepares for his final mission... He tells the people he will find the jewels on that island... He orders the people to build the statue while he is gone... He encourages everyone to work together with all their strength... Jessie's original team has passed away, and he is now all alone... That is when Petty arrives to offer him a clever solution... Petty knows a magical way to bring the dead back to life... She uses an ancient Egyptian stone to perform the ritual... The magic revives all the members of Jessie's former team... However, the spell did not work exactly as they hoped... The team members are now just walking, talking skeletons... They have no brains and very little strength of their own... The skeletons are unable to think or make decisions... Jessie trusts them anyway and sets sail for the distant island... Petty joins the quest, and Sam comes along to keep her safe... Zeus is unhappy that they are building a statue for his brother... He creates obstacles on the sea to stop Petty and Jessie... He only stops when his wife tells him to leave them alone... Suddenly, a baby sea monster grabs hold of their ship... The skeleton crew is unable to fight off the giant creature... Their weak attacks only make the baby monster more angry... Petty uses Sam the cat to calm the monster down somehow... The calmed monster finally lets go and swims away... Sam vomits up the lottery ticket he had hidden from Petty... Petty realizes Sam lied to her and becomes very upset with him... They soon discover that their ship is in very poor condition... They decide to stop at a nearby city to buy a new boat... Petty continues to ignore Sam because she is still so mad... She tells Sam she never wants to see or live with him again... She orders him to leave the ship and stop following her... The journey continues as they get closer to the island... They finally reach the island under the cover of night... Suddenly, a giant robot guardian begins to attack the ship... Jessie is fast asleep and unaware of the robot's attack... Petty bravely steers the ship into a narrow sea cave... This move saves the boat and the crew from the robot... They exit the cave and step onto the jewel-filled island... They immediately find piles of sparkling jewels and gold... Sam meets other mice who warn him the island is deadly... Fearing for Petty's life, Sam rushes to the island to save her... Meanwhile, Jessie and Petty run into a group of Cyclopes... These one-eyed monsters are very large and dangerous... The Cyclopes capture the team and plan to cook them... Petty hides and prepares a plan to save her friends... Sam reaches the island with the help of a friendly dolphin... As Sam looks for Petty, he is captured by two large cats... Some local mice think Sam is there to hurt them... Sam breaks free and tells the mice he is a friend... He explains he is looking for a small mouse named Petty... The mice believe him but don't know where Petty is... They take Sam to meet their leader for more help... Sam learns the Cyclopes have captured Petty and the crew... Sam rushes to the Cyclopes' den to rescue his daughter... The Cyclopes have locked Jessie and the crew in a cage... The monsters are busy boiling a giant pot of soup... Petty and her bird friend arrive to help the prisoners... They notice a massive hoard of gold and jewels nearby... But the specific blue stone they need is nowhere to be found... They realize the legendary blue stone was never on the island... The whole story was a trap set by the Cyclopes... They spread rumors of treasure to lure people to the island... They wait for travelers to arrive so they can eat them... Petty feels terrible for leading everyone into a trap... Things get worse as a new monster appears... A giant, two-headed snake arrives to attack them... Petty and the bird fight the multi-headed snake bravely... They realize that fighting the snake is almost impossible... They fear they will not survive this battle... The snake is a magical and powerful creature... Every time a head is cut, two more grow in its place... Just as all hope is lost, Sam finally arrives... Sam saves Petty and the bird from the snake's attack... The Cyclopes hear the noise and discover Sam as well... They capture Sam, but then a sunrise alarm goes off... The Cyclopes must hide because the sun is coming up... Being afraid of sunlight, the monsters flee to their caves... The monsters are hidden, but the crew is still captured... Petty's bird friend blames her for getting them into this... She feels responsible for the danger they are all in... She feels deep regret for her reckless decisions... She realizes that Sam was only trying to protect her... He lied about the lottery to keep her safe at home... She decides to risk everything to save Sam from the cage... She sneaks into the dark caves of the sleeping Cyclopes... She finds Sam's cage and quickly picks the lock... Sam is finally free, thanks to Petty's bravery... Sam and Petty hug and forgive each other for the past... Back in the city, the people work on the giant statue... The citizens are exhausted from working day and night... They are ready to give up and stop working... Petty's mouse friends show great courage and help out... They bring water to the thirsty workers to keep them going... The water refreshes the workers and gives them new energy... Everyone returns to work to finish the great statue... Humans and animals work together to save the city... Meanwhile, Jessie remains quiet in the Cyclopes' cage... She thinks of a way for her skeleton crew to escape... She breaks the skeletons apart so they can slip out... She throws the pieces of her crew out of the bars... Outside the cage, the skeletons put themselves together... The skeleton crew is finally free to help Jessie... Jessie herself is still stuck inside the locked cage... She tells her team to save themselves and leave... But the team is loyal and refuses to leave without her... They stay behind to figure out how to unlock the cage... Petty thinks of a new plan to get everyone home... She decides to forge a giant trident from the gold... Now they just have to escape the island with the trident... They must dodge the robot and the giant snake again... Bert and the mice go out to disable the giant robot... The local scorpions decide to help the mice fight back... They bravely charge toward the multi-headed snake... They keep the snake busy as its heads grow back... Eventually, the snake is trapped by its own many heads... The scorpions used their wits to trap the monster... They made the snake's strength its own downfall... The Cyclopes are asleep because the sun is high... Petty and the crew use the time to melt the gold... They work fast to build the statue's trident... Finally, they finish forging the beautiful trident... Night falls just as they finish their hard work... The monsters wake up and find the crew escaping... The Cyclopes rush out to stop the intruders... They realize the treasure is being taken away... They try to block the path to the sea cave... But the skeleton crew uses their parts to trip them up... The monsters cannot catch the agile mice... They carry Jessie out of the cave while still in her cage... Bert and the rats jump into the giant robot... They take control of it and make it fight for them... They use the robot to chase the Cyclopes away... The team rushes toward the boat with the heavy trident... The monsters are still chasing them across the beach... The scorpions and cats help protect Petty and the team... But the Cyclopes are much larger and stronger... Bert arrives in the giant robot to save the day... He uses the robot's power to stop the monsters... He manages to push the Cyclopes into the sea... The team has finally defeated the island's monsters... The monsters flee into the woods to escape the robot... Only the angry Cyclops leader remains to fight them... They load the trident onto the boat to leave... The leader roars in anger and attacks one last time... He tries to smash the trident before they escape... He charges at the boat as it starts to pull away... But then, the first light of the sun hits the beach... Petty uses a mirror to reflect the light onto him... The sunlight turns the monster into a giant stone tree... Jessie is safely brought onto the boat with the trident... They all cheer for Petty's quick thinking and bravery... They admire the beautiful trident they made together... All the dangers of the island are finally behind them... They set sail to return home and save their city... Poseidon emerges from the sea, waiting for his statue... He is counting down the final minutes of the deadline... If they fail, he will destroy the city with a flood... The people are terrified as the water starts to rise... Zeus watches from above and sees their hard work... He decides to help them reach the city in time... He uses his magic to push the boat faster... The boat reaches the city just before the deadline ends... They arrive to find the statue is completely finished... Poseidon is very impressed by the beautiful golden trident... He takes the trident and places it in the statue's hand... He is pleased with the respect the citizens showed him... He stops the storm and makes the city peaceful again... Petty finally completed her dream of a grand adventure... Everyone lives happily, and the city is safe once more...

text: I need a new driver. >> Plant a seed for combat. >> The film kicks off with Sunny Hayes, a once celebrated Formula 1 prodigy who's now living like a drifter, racing wherever he can find a seat. At the 24 hours of Daytona, he straps in under Chip Hart's banner and shows he hasn't lost a shred of skill. His driving lights up the track, carrying Chip's team to victory. When the dust settles, Sunny quietly packs up his van, ready to disappear down the road again. Chip approaches, eager to lock him into a permanent spot on the team. But Sunny isn't interested. For him, this was always a one-off. He thanks Chip for the chance, then drives away. While Sunny is in a laundromat mapping out his next race in Baja, an old ghost from his past walks in. Ruben Cervantes, a former teammate from the Lotus days and now the desperate owner of the Apex GP Formula 1 team. His team is on the brink of collapse and he needs a miracle. Reuben lays it out. They need at least one Grand Prix win to survive and he wants Sunny to be the one to deliver it paired with their rookie driver. He hands Sunny a first class ticket to London and dangles the promise of glory. At first, Sunny isn't biting. He's long past chasing glory. But when it comes down to loyalty, he can't turn his back on Reuben. Against his instincts, Sunny agrees. He arrives at the Silverstone Circuit in London to meet the rest of the team. Kate McKenna, the technical director, Casper Smolinsky, the team principal, Dodge Da, the chief mechanic, and their Golden Boy rookie, Joshua Pierce. It doesn't take long to learn just how desperate things are. Seven drivers have already refused a seat before Sunny. He straps into a car loaded with modern F1 tech, a far cry from the machines he once dominated. He appears to fall behind the qualifications, pushes the car's limits, and wrecks it. But where others would see failure, Sunny sees answers. Even in the wreckage, he's already pointing out exactly where the car is weak. Casper watches this display and despite the chaos knows he's found the driver he needs. Sunonny Hayes is officially part of Apex GP. Meanwhile, Joshua is getting a reality check from his cousin and manager, Cash. They've got nine races to make Joshua look irresistible to other teams. And that means every race, every sponsor event, every stage photo op counts. Later, Joshua confides in his mother, Bernardet. He admits the pressure. If Apex GP doesn't win at least one race, his seat could vanish. Still, he brushes off Sunny, dismissing him as nothing more than a washed up relic. Apex GP makes it official. Sunny Hayes is their second driver. The commentators pounce on the announcement, reminding the world that Sunny hasn't been anywhere near Formula 1 in over three decades. Once a rising star for Lotus, his career was cut short by a brutal crash at the Spanish Grand Prix. Joshua rolls in with Cash and Bernardet for a press conference, only to be greeted by a giant poster of himself and Sunny side by side. Bernardet takes one look and smirks that Sunny doesn't even look that old. She even calls him handsome. At the press conference, Joshua can't resist taking another jab, mocking Sunny's age in front of the cameras. But the attention quickly shifts when a reporter corners Sunny with questions about his past, gambling problems, three failed marriages, the whole tabloid summary. Before it spirals further, the session is abruptly shut down. As race day approaches, Reuben brings Sunny face to face with Peter Baining, a key investor, keeping Apex GP afloat. The introductions are polite, but the pressure is clear. Expectations are skyhigh. When it's time to line up on the grid, Sunny's car suddenly refuses to start. To the crowd, it looks like the old man doesn't even know how to switch the car into star mode. But once he finally fires up the engine and joins the pack, something feels off. Kate watches closely and realizes Sunny did it on purpose. By holding back, he set himself up with a clean stretch of track and tires warm to perfection. When the lights go out, he won't just be keeping up. He'll be in the perfect position to strike. Once the British Grand Prix is underway, things start looking good for Apex GP until lap 20. A slow pit stop costs the team precious time, dropping both cars far behind the leaders. Frustration boils over when Sunny ignores team orders to let Joshua overtake him. Instead of cooperating, the two collide on track, leaving their cars battered and their team fuming. Back in the pit, Joshua explodes at a crew member named Jod. But Sunny steps in, shutting down the outburst and backing her up. Casper isn't impressed. He warns Sunny that if he's going to be on this team, he needs to follow orders. No exceptions. Later, Jod finds Sunny cooling off in one of his ice baths. She thanks him for standing up for her, but makes it clear she doesn't need rescuing. That moment is cut short when Reuben storms in, furious over the on track stunt and the wreck cars. Sunny tells Reuben the real problem is Joshua, cocky, reckless, and convinced he knows better. Still, Sunny shifts gears, asking about Kate and whether she's married. Reuben shuts that down fast, warning Sunny not to get any ideas. Later, Sunny seeks out Kate while she's working on upgrades for the car. Without much preamble, he throws out an invitation, grab a beer, talk shop, and more importantly, build him a machine designed for combat. In Sunny's eyes, he needs a way to chase through the dirty air, get closer to the other cars, and battle them in the turns. He doesn't care for safety, and Kate is outraged. To her, Sunny's not a strategist. He's a hotthead who races like a lone wolf, not a teammate. She cuts him off, making it clear she won't be taking cues from him. If he wants her to listen, he'll have to prove he can actually finish a race. With that, she walks away. Both Joshua and Sunny throw themselves into training. Joshua studies Sunny's every move, digging up footage of the crash that ended his F1 career decades ago. By the time the Hungarian Grand Prix rolls around, strategy is everything. In the team meeting, three options are laid out. Plan A, switch from medium to hard tires, one pit stop. Plan B requires two pit stops, changing from medium to hard and back to medium tires. And plan C, soft tires, the riskiest choice since they were down fast. Nobody want plan C except Sunny. First lap is a disaster and Sunny's tire is punctured. When he comes for his pit stop, he flat out refuses to take the hard tires. He wants softs. Casper argues this is a one-stop race, that every other driver is running hard, but Sunny won't budge. By forcing crashes and exploiting the safety car rules, he creates delays that throw the field off balance. While the rest of drivers are caught in the chaos, Joshua steadily climbs forward, taking advantage of every opening Sunny creates. With only four laps to go, Joshua's tires finally give out, and he has no choice but to pit. to cover him. Sunny keeps up the disruption, running off track, leaving debris, and triggering another safety car. The move buys Joshua just enough time to get fresh tires, stay inside the top 10, and finish strong. For Apex GP, it marks their first big breakthrough. After the race, Kate begins to see something in Sunny. His recklessness has an edge of strategy, and for the first time, she considers the potential in his approach. She starts drawing up plans for the car he asked for. At the Italian Grand Prix, Apex GP is running strong until Sunny's tires completely give out, shredding across the track and forcing a safety car to slow the field. Joshua, meanwhile, stays out without pitting and he climbs up to fourth place. Then the rain hits. While most switch to wet tires, Joshua holds his ground on slicks. It's dangerous, but it catapults him into second place. Sunny gets fresh tires and rejoins the race right behind Max Versstappen. He positions himself to hold Versstappen back, playing the team game to give Joshua a shot. But Joshua ignores his advice to wait for the right moment to overtake. He lunges for the overtake during a turn hits a curb and the car launches, flipping over the barrier before bursting into flames. In the chaos, Sunny dives in and drags Joshua out of the wreckage, pulling him clear before the fire consumes everything. In the hospital, Bernardet sits at Joshua's bedside. He's bandaged but alive. Outside, the rest of the team waits in tense silence for any kind of update. When Bernardet finally steps out, she tells them Joshua is stable and resting. Reuben starts to apologize only for Bernardet to cut him off and call Sunny forward. She chews him out for what happened to Joshua, believing it was his advice that caused the accident. While Joshua heals, Sunny is left to carry the team's public face, but the press doesn't let up. Every interview circles back to Joshua's accident, grilling Sunny on whether Joshua blames him. Eventually, Reuben steps in, addressing the media directly. Joshua is recovering and their reserve driver Marcus will take a seat for the next three races. At the Dutch Grand Prix, Kate unveils her latest creation, a combat upgrade that lets Sunny cut through dirty air with barely a dent in performance. In the team meeting, she presses for their elusive plan C. Sunny seizes the moment, reminding everyone that if every person in the room can make one critical contribution, that can mean the difference between first and last place. He brands plan C as for combat, and soon the whole team is chanting it like a battlecry. On the track, Sunny proves the upgrade works. He muscles his way through the field, holding his own. Sunny crosses the line in ninth place. Hardly headline grabbing for most, but for Apex GP, it feels like a triumph. Then comes the Japanese Grand Prix, and the commentators can't help but take notice. Apex GP has found its strength with a new upgrade, and Sunny is shaving time on the corners. He finishes in seventh place, the team's best result yet. Off the track though, Joshua is stewing, training harder, getting angrier, and letting resentment eat at him while Cash keeps pouring gasoline in the fire, suggesting that maybe Sunny is a sabotur. At the Mexico Grand Prix, Sunny storms to a fifth place finish, his best result yet. For the team, it's a milestone worth celebrating. By the time they reach Belgium, Sunny has the entire team running laps alongside him, building unity and momentum. From the bleachers, Joshua watches, simmering with resentment. Joshua makes his return for the Belgian Grand Prix, but something in him has shifted. He's bitter and fueled by anger. The crowd chants for Apex and for Sunny, and every cheer feels like a dagger. When the lights go out, Joshua's grudge takes control. In a reckless move, he deliberately shoves Sunny off the track. Joshua limps to a ninth place finish, satisfied in the sabotage, while Sunny is left seething. After the race, he corners Joshua and slams him against a wall, telling him exactly how stupid he is for cutting his own chances in half. Their feud grows too loud to ignore. And before the Las Vegas Strip Grand Prix, Kate pulls a trick of her own. She lures Sunny and Joshua into what looks like a couple's therapy poker game at a club. The rules are simple. Whoever wins takes the coveted number one driver spot for the race. If Kate wins, she decides. Between hands, Sunny levels with Joshua, telling him he's a fantastic driver, but he lacks patience. Joshua returns that Sunny can't listen to anyone. In the end, Joshua wins, securing preferred treatment for the race and walking out with cash. But Sunny shows Kate that he actually let Joshua win. Later that night, they go back to her place and sleep together. On the balcony afterward, Sunny opens up. He tells her that after his crash, he lost everything. But the loss that cut the deepest was his love for racing. That's why he started driving again. He tells her that there is this moment sometimes while racing where his heartbeat slows, everything goes quiet and he sees everything and no one can touch him and he's chasing that moment every time he is in the car. Their moment is cut short when Reuben shows up with bad news. Someone has filed an anonymous complaint about the materials Kate used for Sunny's car. The FIA steps in and demands the upgrades be stripped off for testing. The team is crippled before the race even starts. Frustration fills the pit, but no one takes it harder than Sunny. During the race, his anger takes the wheel. He pushes too hard, fighting Perez head-to-head, and it ends in disaster. The crash sends Sunny straight to the hospital. Reuben lashes out, furious that Sunny never admitted how serious his injuries from the Spanish Grand Prix really were, and dismisses him from the team out of concern. He tells him bluntly that neither of them are drivers anymore. To Reuben, they're just two broke, sentimental fools clinging to a past that's already gone. Joshua overhears every word, and something inside him shifts. Back at the simulator, he replays Sunny's words in his head. Wait for the straight, the straight into turn one. But Joshua's biggest difficulty has always been patience. He pushes too early again and again, crashing every time until finally he nails it. He conquers the same move that once destroyed him. Later, Sunny is leaving a hospital where he is approached by Apex board member Peter Banning, who has actually been the one planning to sell the team all along. Peter wants to get rid of Reuben and sell Apex GP. And he gives Sunny an offer to be part of his team moving forward. Peter wants to run the team, keep Sunny for strategy. Sunny realizes he was also the one that forged the documents, complaining about the team's upgrades. Sunny plays it like he is considering, but that conversation changes everything. Then it's race day in Abuhabi, the final showdown of the season. Joshua opens up to his mother about his injuries, admitting the blame isn't on Sunny, but on himself. He promises her he'll be more careful from now on. In the pit, the team looks battered and beaten down. But Joshua isn't ready to give in. He pulls out his running socks, rallying everyone for the team run. Meanwhile, Peter arrives with the other shareholders, ready to watch the chaos unfold. As the team runs, Sunny appears. Back in the pit, he slams Reuben with a legal waiver, stripping the team of liability if he races. Then, he rips up his final paycheck, reminding everyone he's still part of this team. And this time, he won't be stuck in a junk car. The ship box is gone. The combat upgrade is back. Kate confirms what they suspected. The FIA uncovered forged documents from someone in Apex GP. But Reuben still won't let Sunny race. Sunny insists he's ready to drive, no matter the risk. Even if it costs him everything, he'd make that choice a thousand times over. Reuben eventually gives in. Peter watches in disbelief as Sunny steps onto the grid. Sunny's response to his last minute offer is a middle finger emoji. The message is clear. The race begins. Joshua gets a strong start and moves up to P9 while Sunny is in P16. By lap 11, Red Bull, Mercedes, and Ferrari are leading with Apex GP holding the middle positions. Sunny takes contact from another car and pits for fresh tires, setting up his usual strategy. Joshua follows plan C, staying out as long as possible on his first set. By lap 25, every other driver has pitted. Joshua briefly takes the lead in P1 while Sunny works his way back from P15. Joshua's worn tires eventually give way and Versappen and both overtake him. He finally pits, but Sunny blocks the Ferrari as it exits, clearing the way for Joshua to rejoin safely. Both Apex cars are now inside the top 10. At lap 38, Joshua is in P3 and Sunny in P4. Sunny tells him this is their chance. Hamilton andlair are in the pits and if Joshua doesn't stop, he can take the lead again. Joshua stays out and find himself back in P1. By lap 54, Joshua has stretched his stint as far as possible, but his tires are finished. Hamilton overtakes him, followed bylair. Joshua falls back to P3 with Sunny close behind in P4. Their tires are worn out, and with the front runners now on fresh rubber, there is no realistic way forward. There's no hope. But then, George Russell begins to challenge Sunny for position, forcing Sunny into a defensive battle. In the chaos, there is a collision. Sunny spins and crashes into the fence, leaving debris scattered across the track. The stewards have no choice but to raise the red flag. Sunny must get his car back on his circuit and drive it to the pit lane to continue, and he manages to do just that. The red flag turns out to be a major advantage for Apex GP. Every team has 10 minutes in the pit lane to repair what they can. Both cars are fitted with fresh soft tires for the restart, giving them a performance edge for the next three laps. Apex GP has an additional advantage. Because they didn't qualify in the top 10, they have new soft tires while the rest will have to use their used ones. This gives Sunny and Joshua extra speed and a chance to make up ground on the leaders. The cars line up again for the restart. Sunny and Joshua start in P3 and P4 with Hamilton in P1 for Mercedes andlair in P2 for Ferrari. Sunny instructs Joshua to follow his lead. The two work as a team. Sunny acts as a decoy, forcing to defend while Joshua slips past. Next, it's Hamilton's turn. Sunny and Joshua attack together, but one will have to yield for the other to win. Sunny makes the call. He sacrifices his chance at victory to give Joshua the lead. Joshua moves into P1, but the battle is intense. In the end, Hamilton and Joshua collide, leaving the door open, and Sunny finds himself in the lead. The moment Sunny has chased his whole life, the one he described to Kate, arrives. His heartbeat slows, the world sharpens into perfect clarity, and everything becomes silent around him. He is untouchable. Sunny pushes the car to its limit, flying through the final lap and crosses the finish line first. The crowd erupts. Apex GP has won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. The victory saves the team from being sold and the team erupts in tears and celebration. At the podium ceremony, Reuben and Sunny yell together, declaring that today they can finally call themselves the best in the world. Joshua receives an offer to race for Mercedes, but he chooses to stay with Apex GP, content with where he belongs. After the Abu Dhabi victory, Sunny makes the decision to retire from Formula 1. Before he leaves, he and Kate share a quiet moment, promising to see each other again. Joshua catches up to Sunny before he departs. The two part on good terms. Sunny tells Joshua that it's his team now, and Joshua replies that it has always been his team. They laugh. Later, Sunny heads to Mexico to compete in the Baja 1000 Pro Bono. When the race coordinators say that there's not a lot of money involved, Sunny tells them it's not about the money for him. The end. Thanks for watching. Don't forget to like and subscribe. By chapter 8, all of these ways of drawing near have been explained, [music] but so far, no one has been able to draw near to God. So, next in the [music] narrative, Aaron and his sons offer sacrifices and are consecrated to serve as priests at God's table. Then, [music] Moses and Aaron go into the tent and God's glory appears. On this day, the high priest makes sacrifices and purification and travels all the way into the center [music] of the tent, into the most holy place, where he enters God's presence, makes atonement, and then turns around and walks back out [music] to the people. The literary structure of Leviticus follows this pattern. The book begins by walking through sacrificial meals, then [music] the consecration of the priests, and ritual purity. At the center, the Day of Atonement. [music] Then, the rest of the book mirrors the first half as we walk back out through a section on ritual purity, then qualifications for the priests, then ritual feasts.
