इतना कहने के साथ ही वह वहां से निकल जाता है। फिर हमें एक रात का सीन दिखाया जाता है जहां पर कटप्पा देवसेना के सामने आता है और कहता है महारानी जी आप क्यों यहां पर इतनी जिल्लत की जिंदगी जी रही हैं। मैं चाहूं तो आपको अब भी अपनी तलवार से इन बेड़ियों का नाश करके अपने साथ लेकर जा सकता हूं। आप मुझे बस एक बार बोल कर तो देखिए। जहां गुस्से में देवसेना उसकी ओर देखती है और कहती है, इन लकड़ियों की झुलसती आग में मैं भल्लाल देव को जलता देखना चाहती हूं। मैं चाहती हूं कि वह इतना चिल्लाए, इतना चिल्लाए कि इस पूरे महल की हर दीवार दहल जाए। उसकी मौत पर ही मेरा इंतकाम खत्म होगा। मीनवाइल हम अवंतिका को देख पाते हैं जो कि अपनी एक साथी के साथ अपने खेमे से निकलकर देवसेना के पास पहुंचने की कोशिश करती है। मगर चुपके से शिवा उसका ध्यान बटाते हुए उसके हाथ पर एक टैटू बना देता है। ऐसा शिवा ने दूसरी बार किया था। इस बार तो अवंतिका को गुस्सा आ जाता है और वह यह ठान लेती है कि वह अपने काम से पहले तो उस शिवा को पकड़ेगी जो बार-बार आकर उसके हाथों पर यूं ही टैटू बना जाता है। और फाइनली काफी दिनों की कोशिश के बाद में अवंतिका शिवा को ढूंढ ही लेती है। जहां पर शिवा उससे अपने प्यार का इज़हार करता है और कहता है कि मैं नीचे गांव से तुम्हारे पास उस जल पर्वत पर चढ़कर आया हूं। मगर अवंतिका को उसकी बात पर विश्वास नहीं होता और वह कहती है कि वह नीचे का गांव यहां से करीब कि.मी. दूर है। वहां से कोई यहां तक आ ही नहीं सकता। लाख कोशिशों के बावजूद भी अवंतिका उसकी कोई बात नहीं मानती और उसके ऊपर वार पर वार करते जाती है। लेकिन चालाक शिवा उसके सारे वारों से बच जाता है। कभी उसे बाहों में लेता है तो कभी लेटाता है। कभी उसके कपड़े चेंज करता है तो कभी आंखों में काजल लगाता है और देखते ही देखते एक सैनिक जैसी दिखने वाली अवंतिका को एक सुंदर प्यारी लड़की में बदल देता है और कांच में उसे उसकी परछाई दिखाता है और बताता है कि देखो तुम कितनी सुंदर दिखती हो। अवंतिका की जिंदगी में आज तक उसे ऐसा कभी एहसास किसी ने नहीं दिलाया था। उसने अपनी जिंदगी में बस सिर्फ जंग लड़ी थी। मगर पहली बार उसे एक सुंदर लड़की होने का एहसास होता है और इसी के चलते यह दोनों फिजिकली अटैच हो जाते हैं। जिसके बाद अगले दिन शिवा की आंख खुलने से पहले ही अवंतिका अपने काम की ओर निकल जाती है। मगर रास्ते में बल्लालदेव के सैनिक उसे पकड़ लेते हैं और उसे खूब पीटते हैं। अवंतिका जोर से चिल्लाती है और तभी वहां पर शिवा पहुंच जाता है और एक-एक करके सभी को धूल चढ़ा देता है। लेकिन देखते ही देखते सैनिकों की तादाद वहां पर ज्यादा पहुंच जाती है। उन सभी से बचने के लिए शिवा पासी की एक पेड़ की चाल का सहारा लेता है और उन सैनिकों से अपने आप और अवंतिका की जान बचाकर वहां से भाग जाता है। मीनवाइल हम माहम्मती साम्राज्य को देख पाते हैं जहां पर इस वक्त भल्लाल देव की सोने से एक काफी बड़ी मूर्ति बनाई जा रही होती है और आज था उसका फाइनल डे जहां पर उस मूर्ति का उद्घाटन पूरे गांव के लोगों के सामने होने वाला था। लेकिन वह मूर्ति इतनी भारी थी कि उसको सीधा खड़ा करने के लिए गांव के सारे लोग अपनी पूरी ताकत लगा देते हैं और साथ ही इसे मनोरंजक बनाने के लिए यहां पर काफी सारी क्लासिकल डांसर्स भी आती है और ढेर सारे पंडित भल्लालदेव के शुभ अवसर पर भगवान से प्रार्थना कर रहे होते हैं। लेकिन तभी गलती से एक इंसान से वो रस्सी छूट जाती है और वह बड़ी भारी मूर्ति वापस जमीन पर गिरने वाली होती है। लेकिन तभी वहां पर शिवा पहुंच जाता है और अपनी पूरी ताकत के साथ उस रस्सी को खींचना स्टार्ट करता है। एक जोर की हवा चलती है और तभी उसके मुंह से उसका मांस कट जाता है तो उसे देखकर हर कोई वहां पर चलाने लगता है। बाहुबली बाहुबली बाहुबली यह देखकर वहां के सभी लोगों में जोश आ जाता है और हर कोई एक ही सुर में बस बाहुबली बोलने लगता है। हालांकि वहां पर सोने की प्रतिमा तो भल्लाल देव की लग चुकी थी। मगर माहेश्मती के साम्राज्य में उन लोगों के दिलों में जिसकी मूर्ति क्रिएट हुई थी वो था बाहुबली। सीन शिफ्ट होता है रात में जहां पर भल्लालदेव अपने सभी सैनिकों को अपने सामने बुलाकर पूछता है कि आखिर सुबह मैदान में बाहुबली किसने बोलना स्टार्ट करा? मगर सैनिक कहते हैं कि नहीं हमें इसके बारे में कुछ नहीं पता। उन सभी सैनिकों में शिवा भी शामिल था क्योंकि उसे अवंतिका से प्यार हो चुका था और अवंतिका की जब उन सैनिकों ने पिटाई करी तो उसके टांग में जख्म लग गया और अब जो काम अवंतिका को दिया गया था उसे खुद करने के लिए शिवा ने महेश्मती साम्राज्य में आकर भल्लाल देव को ही चुनौती दे डाली। जहां पर उसके सारे सैनिक उसे पकड़ने में लग जाते हैं और तभी शिवा अपनी चालाकी और तेजी के साथ में देवसेना को वहां से छुड़ाकर घोड़े पर बैठकर वहां से भागने लगता है। बल लालदेव अपने खास सैनिक कटप्पा को बोलता है कि जाकर उसे रोक और देवसेना को वापस मेरे पास लेकर आओ। इसीलिए कटप्पा भी उसे मारने के लिए आगे भागता है। जहां एक तरफ तो शिवा उन सभी सैनिकों से बचकर भाग रहा होता है। वहीं पर भल्लालदेव का छोटा भाई भी उसका पीछा कर रहा होता है। आगे से कुछ सैनिक आकर उसका रास्ता रोक लेते हैं। और तब शिवा अपनी तलवार से उन सभी का सामना करना स्टार्ट करता है। जहां पर कटप्पा उसे अपनी आंखों से देख रहा होता है। लेकिन उस वक्त बारिश आ रही थी और कीचड़ से उसका पूरा मुंह सना हुआ था। तभी भल्लालदेव का छोटा भाई वहां पर आकर पहुंचता है और उसे मारने लगता है। लेकिन तभी शिवा उसकी गर्दन उड़ा देता है। यह देख कटप्पा को गुस्सा आता है और वह उसे जान से मारने के लिए आगे बढ़ता है। लेकिन तभी बरसात का पानी जब शिवा के मुंह पर गिरता है तो उसकी पूरी मिट्टी शक्ल से उतर जाती है और तब कटप्पा उसे देखकर कहता है बाहुबली और उसके सामने नतमस्तक हो जाता है और वहां मौजूद हर सैनिक शिवा को देखकर घुटने टेक देता है और उसके नाम के जयकारे लगाने लगता है। जहां पर नेक्स्ट डे मॉर्निंग में शिवा को बचाने के लिए जयवर्मा की टीम भी पहुंच चुकी होती है और साथ ही जल पर्वत को पार करके शिवा की मां सांगा अपनी पूरी टीम के साथ भी पहुंच चुकी होती है। तो आखिर शिवा कहता है कि आप लोग मेरे सामने झुके क्यों? उसके पीछे का रीजन क्या है? मुझे सब कुछ सच-सच बताओ। तो कटप्पा बोलना स्टार्ट करता है आज से कई साल पहले तुम्हारे दादाजी महेंद्र बाहुबली को दो बेटे हुए। अमेंद्र बाहुबली और विजालदेव। लेकिन एक जंग में बाहुबली मारे गए और साथ ही तुम्हारी मां भी तुम्हें जन्म देते के साथ ही मर गई। लेकिन तभी तुम्हारी चाची ने तुम्हें संभाला जिसका नाम था शिवगामी और इस वक्त पूरे माहिष्मती के अंदर सिर्फ शिवगामी का ही राज था क्योंकि उसका वचन ही उसका शासन था। उसने खुद के बेटे भल्लालदेव के साथ-साथ तुम्हारी भी परवरिश करी। दोनों को ही सेम कलाएं सिखाई गई। दोनों को ही सेम विद्याएं दी गई। जहां एक तरफ तो तुम्हारे पिता बाहुबली काफी तेज और चालाक थे। वहीं दूसरी ओर भल्लाल देव काफी ज्यादा ताकतवर था। और अब शिवगामी को चुनना था कि आखिर इस माहेश्वती का असली सिंहासन कौन संभालेगा। लेकिन तभी उन्हीं के राज्य का एक गद्दार जाकर कालकेय को यह सारी इंफॉर्मेशन दे देता है कि कुछ ही टाइम के अंदर यहां पर महिष्मती का राज्य अभिषेक होगा और इस राज्य पर कब्जा करना आसान होगा। लेकिन इसे मारने के लिए बाहुबली और भल्लाल देव पहुंचते हैं। हालांकि यहां पर भल्लाल देव उसे जान से मारने की कोशिश करता है और रस्सी को छोड़ देता है। मगर बाहुबली का गुड लक अच्छा था कि वो रस्सी आकर एक चट्टान में अटक जाती है और वह उस गद्दार से सारी इंफॉर्मेशन निकलवा लेते हैं। जहां पर इन सभी को पता चलता है कि अब इनका सामना कालके से होने वाला है जिसके पास काफी बड़ी टीम है और वह जंग लड़कर माहिष्मती को अपना बनाने के लिए यहां पर आने वाला है। तो शिवगामी कहती है कि यही असली परीक्षा होगी इन दोनों की। जो भी कालकेय को मारकर इस जंग को खत्म करेगा वही होगा महेश्वती सिंहासन का असली वारिस। जिसके बाद अगले दिन इस जंग की शुरुआत एक भैंस की बलि को देकर होती है। मगर बाहुबली इस बात से खफा था और वह कहता है कि अगर बलि देनी है तो किसी मासूम जानवर की क्यों दे? इसके लिए तो मेरा उमड़ता रक्त ही काफी है। वेल इस जंग के शुरू होने से पहले शिवगामी और साथी कालकेय के बीच में एक स्मॉल कन्वर्सेशन होती है। जहां पर शिवगामी उसे और उसकी टीम को यहां से चले जाने के बारे में कहती है। मगर कालकेय कहता है कि जब मैं और मेरे लोग तुम्हारे दोनों बेटों को जान से मार देंगे तो मैं आकर तुझे अपनी दुल्हन बनाऊंगा और तेरे मेरे संयोग से जो बेटा पैदा होगा उसे इस माहिष्मती का राजा बना देना। यह सुन शिवगामी का गुस्सा और भड़क जाता है और वह अपने दोनों बेटों से कहती है कि चाहे इसकी आंखें निकल जाए, चाहे इसके हाथ कट जाए, चाहे इसके पैर कट जाए, चाहे चील कौवे इसकी आंतें खा जाए मगर यह जिंदा रहना चाहिए। और इसके बाद शुरू होती है इस कहानी की वन ऑफ द बेस्ट फाइट जहां पर सारे कालके के मजबूत और बड़े योद्धा आकर इनके राज्य पर एक जोरदार प्रहार कर देते हैं। मगर इनकी सीना भी कुछ कम नहीं थी। यह भी एक बड़े से लाल कपड़े को तेल में लपेट कर इनके ऊपर फेंकते हैं और जलते आंख के गोले उसमें डाल देते हैं। जिससे कि उनके काफी सारे सैनिक वहीं पर धराशाई हो जाते हैं। मगर उनके सैनिक तो रुकने का नाम नहीं ले रहे थे और देखते ही देखते उनकी तादाद बढ़ना चालू हो जाती है। तब यहां पर बाहुबली और भल्लालदेव दोनों ही सोचते हैं कि हमें खुद जंग में उतर कर उन सभी की पेलम पट्टी करनी पड़ेगी। जहां एक तरफ तो भल्लाल देव एक स्पिनर को लेकर उन सभी के बीच में पहुंच जाता है और हर एक को मारता मारता आगे बढ़ रहा होता है। वहीं पर घोड़े पर बैठकर बाहुबली अपने दोनों भालों से एक-एक की चटनी बना रहा होता है। वेल यहां पर कालकेई की टीम एक चाल खेलती है और गांव के ही कुछ ही लोगों को बंदी बनाकर इनके राज्य की टीम को रोकने की कोशिश करती है। मगर भल्लालदेव बिना कुछ सोचे समझे कालकेई के सैनिकों को तो काटता ही काटता है मगर उसमें गांव के लोग भी मारे जाते हैं। मगर बाहुबली ऐसा नहीं करता। और उसके हाथ में बैटमैन जैसी थोड़ी सी छोटी रस्सियां थी जिसे वो फेंक कर उन गांव वालों को नीचे बिठा देता है और उनके सैनिक को काट कर फेंक देता है। इसी बीच काल के खुद जंग में उतरता है जहां पर उसका सामना करने के लिए बाहुबली आता है। इन दोनों के बीच में बहुत ही खतरनाक फाइट होती है। जहां पर खुद बाहुबली अपने हाथ में एक लॉयन फेस लेकर उसे मारने लगता है। वेल, यह सीन मुझे काफी हद तक गॉड ऑफ वार गेम के जैसा लगा। आप लोग क्या सोचते हैं? मुझे प्लीज कमेंट सेक्शन में जरूर बताइएगा। बाहुबली उसकी पीठ-पीट कर हालत पतली कर देता है। उसे अपनी मां की वह बात याद आती है कि चाहे इसकी आंखें निकल जाए, चाहे इसके हाथ कट जाए, चाहे इसके पैर कट जाए, चाहे तो चील कौवे इसके पेट से इसकी आंतें निकाल कर खा जाए, मगर मुझे यह जिंदा चाहिए और वह खींच कर कालकेय को अपनी मां शिवगामी के कदमों में लेकर आ रहा होता है। लेकिन तभी इसी बीच भल्लालदेव का एक्सटेंडेड घोटा आकर उसके सर पर लगता है और कालके वहीं पर जान से मारा जाता है। वेल, इस जंग के शुरू होने से पहले इन दोनों बेटों के ही बीच में यह शर्त रखी गई थी कि जो भी कालकेय को जान से मारेगा वही माह्मती का होने वाला राजा कहलाएगा। जिसे देव भल्लालदेव का बाप बिजालदेव काफी खुश होता है और उसे फाइनली लगने लगता है कि मुजपाहिच का बेटा अब इस माहिष्मती सिंहासन का राजा बनेगा। जहां पर अब बाहुबली भी यह कसम खाता है। अमेंद्र बाहुबली यानी मैं राजमाता शिवगामी देवी को साक्षी मानकर यह शपथ लेता हूं कि मुझे अगर प्राण भी त्यागने पड़े तो संकोच नहीं करूंगा और पूरी दिलेरी से अपने राजा का हर काम पूरा करूंगा। लेकिन प्रजा नहीं चाहती थी। प्रजा तो चाहती थी कि बाहुबली माहेश्वती के सिंहासन पर बैठे। तभी वहां पर शिवगामी उन सभी के बीच बोल पड़ती है कि भल्लालदेव राजा नहीं बनेगा। राजा बनने का असली हक बाहुबली को है। क्योंकि पहली चीज तो उसने किसी मासूम की जान नहीं ली बल्कि जंग में खुद के खून की बलि दी। गांव के मासूम लोगों को मरने नहीं दिया बल्कि उनकी जान बचाई और यही रीजन है कि मैं महिष्मती का अगला राजा बाहुबली को चुनती हूं। यह सुनकर तो पूरी प्रजा खुश हो जाती है। हर किसी में एक उल्लास की लहर दौड़ जाती है। वहीं पर सीन शिफ्ट होता है प्रेजेंट टाइम में। जहां पर शिवा कटप्पा से पूछता है कि आखिर बाहुबली है कहां पर? तो कटप्पा कहते हैं कि वह तो जान से मारे गए। तो शिवा पूछता है कि आखिर उन्हें जान से मारा किसने? तो कटप्पा कहता है कि उनकी जान और किसी ने नहीं। मेरे इन्हीं निर्दय हाथों ने ली। मैंने ही बाहुबली को जान से मारा। और इसी तगड़े सस्पेंस के साथ में यह शानदार कहानी यहीं पर खत्म होती है। वेल, आपको यह वीडियो कैसा लगा? प्लीज मुझे लाइक और कमेंट करके जरूर बताइएगा। इसके बाद में मैं इसका नेक्स्ट पार्ट जल्दी आप लोगों के लिए लेकर आऊंगा। सो तब तक के लिए कीप वाचिंग, स्टे सेफ। तब तक के लिए मिलते हैं अगले वीडियो में। गलत किया देवसेना। औरत पर हाथ डालने वाले की उंगलियां नहीं काटते। काटते हैं उसका गला। यस। सो हेलो एवरीवन हितेश हियर। टुडे वी गना टॉक अबाउट द मूवी कॉल्ड बाहुबली टू द कंक्लूजन। वेल आई होप कि आपने इसका फर्स्ट पार्ट जरूर देखा होगा और अगर नहीं भी देखा होगा तो ए यूजुअल उस वीडियो का लिंक आपको इस वीडियो के डिस्क्रिप्शन में मिल जाएगा। आप वहां से भी जाकर उस वीडियो को चेक आउट कर सकते हैं। बिकॉज़ अगर आपने इसका फर्स्ट पार्ट नहीं देखा तो इसकी सेकंड स्टोरी को समझने में आपको थोड़े बहुत इशूज़ आ सकते हैं। और जब मूवी में इतना दम है तो क्यों ना उसके दमदार डायलॉग्स और साथ ही उसकी स्टोरी लाइन को बेहतरीन तरीके से आपको दिखाया जाए। सो नाउ विदाउट वेस्टिंग टाइम चलिए आते हैं इस कहानी की मेन स्टोरी लाइन की तरफ जिसकी शुरुआत इस मूवी के फर्स्ट पार्ट के एंडिंग सीन के साथ होती है। जहां पर हमने देखा था कि किस तरीके से बल्ला देव और बाहुबली ने कालके को मौत के घाट उतार दिया था। साथ ही प्रजा और शिवगामी के फाइनल डिसीजन से आमेंद्र बाहुबली को माहष्मती सिंहासन मिल जाता है। तभी राक्षस दहन उत्सव आ गया जो कि 26 सालों में सिर्फ एक बार आता था। राज्य की खुशहाली के लिए यह प्रथा थी कि रानी इस उत्सव को मनाने के लिए राज्य से 30 कोस दूर जंगल में नंगे पांव सर पर अग्निकुंड रखकर अकाल राक्षस का दहन करें और जब तक संकल्प पूर्ण ना हो पांव रुकने नहीं चाहिए। ऐसा इस प्रथा का नियम था। महारानी को आता देख पूरे गांव वाले उनके स्वागत के लिए उनके जयकारे लगाने लगते हैं। वहां पर दो बड़े-बड़े हाथी भी मौजूद थे। मगर गांव के लोगों का शोर सुनकर वो दोनों हाथी में से एक हाथी बेकाबू हो जाता है और वहां पर काफी सारी तबाही मचाने लगता है। मगर प्रथा का नियम था कि पैर रुकने नहीं चाहिए। इसलिए शिवगामी अपने पैरों को बिना रोके अग्निकुंड को सिर पर लिए राक्षस दहन के लिए आगे प्रस्थान कर जाती है। कटप्पा उन्हें समझाने की कोशिश करते हैं। मगर महारानी को यह पूजा खत्म करनी थी। और तभी हम देख पाते हैं कि वही बड़ा सा हाथी शिवगामी की तरफ आगे बढ़ता है उन्हें जान से मारने के लिए। यह देख गांव की प्रजा परेशान हो जाती है कि आखिर अब होगा तो क्या होगा। बट तभी एंट्री होती है आेंद्र बाहुबली की जो कि एक बड़े महान रथ को लेकर उस हाथी से टकरा देता है और उसका गुस्सा शांत करने के लिए उसके सर पर हल्दी डाल देता है। वेल, दिस वास अ लेजेंड्री मोमेंट इन दिस मूवी। आपको यह सीन कैसा लगा? प्लीज मुझे कमेंट में जरूर बताइएगा। जिसके बाद बारी आती है माहिष्मती सिंहासन के राजा के राज्य अभिषेक की। जहां पर पूरा गांव उन्हें दुआएं देने के लिए पहुंचता है। मगर इस साम्राज्य के नए राजा को देखकर भल्लाल देव और उसके पिता बिजला देव बिल्कुल भी खुश नहीं थे। क्योंकि वह तो यह चाहते थे कि इस राज्य का असली राजा मेरा बेटा बने। वेल इसके फर्स्ट पार्ट में मुझसे एक छोटी सी गलती हो गई थी जहां पर मैंने कहा था कि भल्लाल देव का भाई मारा जाता है। तो उसको मैं करेक्ट कर देता हूं। वो था भल्लाल देव का बेटा क्योंकि उसकी शादी हो चुकी थी इस पार्ट में जो कि हालांकि दिखाई नहीं गई। वेल कमिंग बैक टू द मेन स्टोरी। दूर-दूर के राज्यों से शिवगामी के पास में उनके सुपुत्र यानी कि आंद्र बाहुबली के लिए शादी के रिश्ते आते हैं। तभी शिवगामी अपने बेटे आमेंद्र बाहुबली को बुलाती है और कहती है कि बेटा तुम्हें देश आटन के लिए निकलना चाहिए। देश आटन इट मींस कि देश में किसी को क्या तकलीफ है, किसी को क्या चाहिए? तो राजा को उसकी परवाह होनी चाहिए। एंड दैट इज द रीज़न यहां पर शिवगामी बाहुबली को देश आटन पर भेज देती है। मगर राज दरबारी कहते हैं कि अभी तक राज्याभिषेक पूरा नहीं हुआ। उससे पहले राजा जी का देश यह तो बिल्कुल सही बात नहीं है। उन पर कोई भी हमला कर सकता है। यह सोचकर शिवगामी कटप्पा को यह जिम्मेदारी देती है कि आज से हर वक्त हर क्षण हर दिन तुम बाहू के साथ रहोगे उसका साया बनकर। जिसके बाद तो यह दोनों ही अपने देशन के लिए निकल जाते हैं और रास्ते में मिलने वाले हर जरूरतमंद की मदद भी करते हैं। वहीं पर हम इस कहानी की लीड हीरोइन यानी कि देवसेना को भी देख पाते हैं जो कि इस वक्त अपनी यंग एज में होती है। यह कुंतला के राजा की बेटी होती है जो कि अपने बॉडीगार्ड कुमार वर्मा के साथ मंदिर में पूजा करने के लिए आई होती है। लेकिन तभी कुछ गुंडे उन पर हमला करते हैं और उनका पैसा चुराने की कोशिश करते हैं। लेकिन देश सेना तो अकेले ही सबको पीटकर उनकी हालत पतली कर देती है। वेल बाहुबली चाहता था उनकी हेल्प करना मगर इतनी दिलेर और सैन्य कला की माहिर योद्धा को देखकर वह अपने पैर पीछे हटा लेता है। हालांकि उस समय वह गुंडे तो वहां से चले जाते हैं। मगर बाहुबली को शक होता है कि वो लोग हमसे ज्यादा दूर नहीं होंगे तो क्यों ना कटप्पा उन सभी को धूल चटाई जाए। जिसके बाद तो हमें एक बहुत ही खतरनाक फाइटिंग सीन दिखाया जाता है जिसमें कटप्पा और साथ ही बाहुबली दोनों मिलकर उन नक्सलवादियों की ऐसी की तैसी करके रख देते हैं। हालांकि बाहुबली उनसे लड़ तो रहा था मगर उसका ध्यान उन पर नहीं बल्कि उस सौंदर्यशाली लड़की पर था जिसकी नजर थोड़ी देर पहले उससे मिली थी। वो तो मानो उसके ख्यालों में खो चुका था। पर जब वापस से यह दोनों कुंथला की रानी के सामने आते हैं तो वह उन्हें देखकर डांटने लगती है और कहती है कि औरतों के पीछे क्या छुप रहे हो? मर्द जैसे हट्टे-कट्टे हो उन लोगों से लड़ाई क्यों नहीं करी तुमने? तो कटप्पा कहते हैं कि यह मेरा भांजा है। यह दिमाग से थोड़ा पैदल है। लेकिन अगर आप लोगों का सहारा मिलेगा तो यह कुछ सीख जाएगा। क्यों ना आप लोग हमें काम दे दें। आप जो बोलेंगे हम वो करेंगे। तो देवसेना कुमार वर्मा को बुलाकर कहती है कि हालांकि कद काठी में तो यह सही लग रहे हैं। तुम इन्हें अपने डिपार्टमेंट में रख लो और कोई छोटा-मोटा काम दे देना। अगर तलवार चलाना सीख जाए तो कम से कम द्वारपाल तो बन ही जाएगा। तो कुमार वर्मा कहते हैं कि इसे तलवार चलाना मैं सिखाऊंगा। जिसके बाद इन दोनों को ही कुंथला राज्य में लेकर आया जाता है। जहां पर कुमार वर्मा आेंद्र बाहुबली जिसे वह एक मंदबुद्धि समझ रहा था। उसे तलवार चलाने की प्रैक्टिस करवा रहा होता है। देवसेना यह सब कुछ देख रही थी। वेल पहले तो बाहुबली मंदबुद्धि होने का नाटक करता है। लेकिन जैसे उसकी नजर फिरती है तो सिर्फ एक बार में एक बड़े से लकड़े के फट्टे के आधे-आधे टुकड़े कर देता है। और रात को बस उसी के ख्यालों में खोया रहता है। तो कटप्पा उससे पूछते हैं कि आखिर बाहुबली किन ख्यालों में खोए हो? जरा हमें भी तो बताओ। तो उनसे कहता है कि आप वह दो परिंदों को देख रहे हैं। किस तरीके से एक ही डाल पर बैठे हैं। तो कटप्पा कहता है कि आय हाय क्यों ना मेरे पास आजा उन्हें मस्त नींबू मिर्ची में निचोड़ के खाऊं। हाय स्वाद जन्नत जहां पर बाहुबली अपना सर पटकता है और कहता है बुड्ढे से कुछ नहीं होगा। जिसके बाद आता है ट्रेनिंग राउंड टू। वेल यहां पर गांव वालों से देवसेना को पता चलता है कि उनके खेतों में कुछ सूअर हैं जो कि उनकी फसलों को नुकसान पहुंचा रहे हैं। तो देवसेना अकेले उनका शिकार करने के लिए धनुष बाण लेकर खेतों में पहुंच जाती है। मगर कुमार वर्मा भी उनसे पीछे का रहने वाले थे। इसीलिए वह बाहुबली के साथ सूअरों के शिकार पर निकल जाते हैं। मगर यहां पर भी ट्विस्ट देवसेना के सूअर पर तीर लगने से पहले बाहुबली के तीर उन सूअरों को लग जाते हैं। और वह ऐसा शो कर रहा था कि मानो कुमार वर्मा ने उन सूअरों को मार गिराया। मगर यह सारी चालाकियां देवसेना को समझ आ जाती है कि इनके पीछे कुमार वर्मा नहीं बल्कि यह मंदबुद्धि है। तो वह उसे बुलाती है और कहती है कि तुम नाटक कर रहे हो क्या मेरे सामने? तुम्हारे इन मजबूत हाथों को देखकर तो लगता है कि इन्होंने जंगे लड़ी हैं। अभी पता चल जाएगा दूध का दूध और पानी का पानी हो जाएगा। जरा इस सांड को खोलकर इसके सामने भेज दो। वेल बाहुबली चाहता तो सांड को 2 मिनट में पटक कर धराशाई कर सकता था। मगर वह अपनी सच्चाई देवसेना के सामने इस वक्त लाना नहीं चाहता था। इसलिए मंदबुद्धि का नाटक करते हुए उससे जोरदार की टक्कर खा जाता है। जहां पर कट्टप्पा उन्हें कहता है कि यह आपने क्या किया? इस मंदबुद्धि को इतने बड़े बैल के सामने भिड़वा दिया। जरा कुछ तो सोचो। अगर इसे कुछ हो जाता तो मैं इसकी मां को क्या जवाब देता? जिसके बाद इसे देवसेना की खास दासियों से एकदम स्पेशल ट्रीटमेंट मिलना स्टार्ट हो जाता है। वेल यह सारी बातें दूर माहेश्मती साम्राज्य में भल्लाल देव तक पहुंच जाती है कि इस वक्त बाहुबली कुंथला राज्य में देवसेना को पटाने के अलग-अलग हथकंडे आजमा रहा है। इसलिए यहां पर वह एक चाल खेलता है और अपनी मां को कहता है कि मुझे यह लड़की काफी पसंद है। मेरे दिल में इसका चलचित्र बन चुका है। तो शिवगामी उसे आश्वासन देती है कि तुम्हारी शादी होगी तो सिर्फ इसी लड़की से होगी। जिसके बाद तो वह अपने सैनिकों के साथ हजारों किलो सोना, अशरफियां और बेशकीमती आभूषण उनके राज्य में भिजवाकर शादी का प्रस्ताव रखती है। मगर जो शख्स वह संदेशा उनके राजा को सुनाता है तो यह सुनकर देवसेना को फील होता है कि यह तो हमें नीचा दिखाने की कोशिश कर रहा है। मानो कि शादी का प्रस्ताव नहीं यह गहने देकर मुझे खरीदने के लिए आए हो। इस वजह से देवसेना शिवगामी के बेटे के साथ शादी का रिश्ता ठुकरा देती है। वेल शी डोंट नो अबाउट दैट कि उसके पास में बाहुबली का नहीं बल्कि भल्लालदेव का रिश्ता आया था। मगर दूर खड़ा बाहुबली यह देखकर सोच रहा था कि उसकी मां ने उसके लिए यही लड़की चुनी है। जब यह संदेश आकर शिवगामी को मिलता है कि देवसेना ने उनका यह निमंत्रण ठुकरा दिया तो इस बात से उनको काफी ज्यादा बुरा लगता है कि आखिर कोई लड़की मेरे बेटे भल्लाल देव का रिश्ता कैसे ठुकरा सकती है। उसे तो मेरे सामने बंदी बनाकर लेकर आना चाहिए। तो वह कबूतर पर एक चिट लगाकर अपने बेटे बाहुबली को यह संदेशा भिजवाती है कि तुम इस वक्त कुंथला में ही हो और कुंथला के राजा की बेटी देवसेना जिसने मेरा अपमान किया उसे पकड़ कर बंदी बनाकर यहां मेरे सामने लेकर आओ। मीनवाइल कुंतला राज्य पर उन्हीं नक्सलवादियों की एक और बड़ी टीम आकर हमला कर देती है। और यहां के लोगों को खतरे में आता देख बाहुबली अपनी एक्चुअल आइडेंटिटी में आकर उन सभी को मारना स्टार्ट कर देता है। वहीं कुमार वर्मा जो कि डरपोक फट्टू किस्म का इंसान जो कि लड़कियों के पीछे जाकर छुप चुका होता है। वह लड़ने के लिए बाहर ही नहीं आ रहा होता है। मगर इस वक्त बाहुबली को लोगों की जरूरत थी। इसलिए वह उसके अंदर जोश भरता है और कहता है कि हर योद्धा को एक मौका मिलता है अपने आप को साबित करने का। जहां पर वह सभी को यह बता देता है कि वह कुछ कर सकता है। वह मौका आज है कुमार वर्मा। दिखा दो इन सभी को कि तुम्हारे अंदर कितनी ताकत है। जिससे मोटिवेट होकर तो कुमार वर्मा उन सब की चटनी बना देता है। वहीं देवसेना भी किसी से कम नहीं थी और वह अपने तीरधनुष लेकर उन सभी को मारना स्टार्ट कर देती है। और तभी एंट्री होती है वहां पर रामेंद्र बाहुबली की जो कि एक नहीं दो नहीं बल्कि तीन-तीन तीरों के साथ उन सभी को धराशाई कर रहा था। इस कला को देखकर तो देवसेना भी अक्की बक्की रह चुकी थी और तभी वह उसके पास आकर उसे कहता है मणिबंदम बहिर्मुखम और उसके बाद तो यह दोनों मिलकर अपने तीन-तीन तीरों के साथ में सामने से आते हुए सारे नक्सलवादियों को फक्सलवादी बना देते हैं। इतनी दिलेरी और इतनी तेजी देखकर तो देवसेना मानो उसके प्यार में पागल हो चुकी थी। मगर दुश्मन तो खत्म होने का नाम ही नहीं ले रहे थे। इसी वजह से बाहुबली एक चाल खेलता है और सामने के बांध को तोड़ देता है जिससे कि वहां का पानी पूरे कुंथला राज्य में आ जाता है और जो बड़ी भारी टीम इनके ऊपर हमला करने वाली थी वह पानी में बह जाती है। ऐसी बेहतरीन तकनीक को देखकर वह सभी शॉक हो जाते हैं कि आखिर यह इंसान है कौन? और जब खच के गुस्से में एक जलता लकड़ा उसके सीने पर मारा जाता है तो उनके सामने आता है आम आेंद्र बाहुबली जो कि था माहिष्मती साम्राज्य का होने वाला राजा। तब जाकर देवसेना को पता चलता है कि जिसका रिश्ता मेरे लिए आया था वह और कोई नहीं बल्कि बाहुबली था। मगर उसी वक्त बाहुबली को उसकी मां के द्वारा भेजा गया संदेश प्राप्त होता है जिसमें लिखा था कि कुंथला के राजा की बेटी को मेरे पास बंदी बनाकर लाया जाए। हालांकि यहां पर बाहुबली उससे प्यार तो करता था मगर मां के आदेश की अवेलना भी नहीं कर सकता था। इसीलिए वह उसको बंदी बनाकर अपने साथ महिष्मती साम्राज्य ले जाता है। और अब जैसा कि पूरे राज्य में उस बांध के टूट जाने की वजह से पानी भर चुका होता है तो यह एक नाव में बैठकर माहिष्मती के लिए निकलते हैं। और जब शिवगामी के सामने बाहुबली देवसेना को पकड़ कर लेकर आता है तो शिवगामी पूछती है कि तुम्हें रिश्ता क्यों नहीं पसंद? आखिर क्या कमी है मेरे बेटे में? तो देवसेना कहती है कि हां मुझे बाहुबली पसंद है। तो शिवगामी कहती है कि नहीं बाहु नहीं मैंने तुम्हारे लिए भल्लाल देव को चुना है। जिस पर तो देवसेना काफी ज्यादा गुस्सा हो जाती है और कहती है कि मैंने तो अपना पति बाहुबली को मान लिया है। मैं उसके अलावा और किसी के बारे में सोच भी नहीं सकती। जहां पर कुछ सवाल जवाब बाहुबली के साथ में भी होते हैं तो वह भी कहता है कि मां मैं दिल से देवसेना को अपना बना चुका हूं। अगर मैंने आपसे भी वादा किया था इसे बंदी बनाकर लाने का तो देवसेना से भी वादा किया था उसे अपनी धर्मपत्नी बनाने का। जिस बात पर तो शिवगामी को और ज्यादा गुस्सा आ जाता है और वह गुस्से में आकर यह निर्णय लेती है कि आज से माहिष्मती सिंहासन का असली राजा बाहुबली नहीं बल्कि भल्लालदेव होगा और साथ ही आज से बाहुबली को बनाया जाता है भल्लालदेव का सेनापति जिसके बाद पूरे राज्य के सामने बाहुबली यह शपथ लेता है कि आेंद्र बाहुबली यानी मैं मेरी मां शिवकामी को साक्षी मानकर यह वादा करता हूं कि अगर राजा की जान बचाने के लिए अगर मुझे अपने प्राण भी त्यागने पड़े तो संकोच नहीं करूंगा और तभी से भल्लाल देव महष्मति गति का राजा बन जाता है। जिसके बाद समय आगे बीतता जाता है और एक वक्त ऐसा आता है जब मंदिर में पूजा करने के लिए देवसेना को खुद गांव वालों के साथ में लाइन में लगना पड़ता text: In a tall apartment building in New York, a young girl named Aurora is terrified to go to sleep because she believes a monster is hiding under her bed. When Aurora screams, her parents rush into her room. She desperately warns them not to touch the floor, insisting that if they do, the monster will eat them. Her parents reassure her that there is nothing in her room and eventually leave. Unable to sleep, Aurora decides to sleep outside her bedroom. She cautiously peaks back inside and spots a bunny made out of dust. Closing her eyes, she makes a wish and suddenly a glowing firefly appears. Curious, Aurora follows it through her apartment building until it leads her to one of the mailboxes. Then once she catches sight of the mailbox's owner, she begins to follow him. The man exits the elevator, and Aurora does as well. She realizes that the man is her neighbor. Later that night, Aurora secretly follows the neighbor through a narrow alleyway. Sensing someone nearby, he suddenly turns and Aurora quickly hides. She continues trailing him all the way to Chinatown where a lively festival is underway. Along the way, Aurora finds a mask and puts it on. From the rooftop of a nearby building, she watches as the neighbor engages in a brutal fight with a dragon. After an intense battle, the neighbor defeats the creature. Aurora follows him back to their apartment building. After the neighbor enters his apartment, Aurora returns to her own where her parents scold her for leaving without permission. The neighbor quietly watches the confrontation from his doorstep. Minutes later, Aurora's parents try to calm her once again, assuring her that there is no monster in her bedroom. Her mother gently tells her to stop sucking her thumb. Then they say good night to Aurora, but Aurora responds by saying, "Goodbye, Mom and Dad." Soon after they leave, Aurora hears a creaking sound beneath the floorboards, followed by her parents' screams. The next morning, Aurora wakes up to a silent apartment. Careful not to touch the floor, she uses an ottoman to move across the floors while calling out for her parents. There is no response. Night eventually falls and Aurora returns to her bedroom again, using the ottoman to avoid the floor. She jumps onto a shelf, but a grape falls to the floor. She manages to climb onto her bed, only to accidentally drop her shoe. A low growl echoes from beneath the floorboards. Horrified, Aurora watches as the creature grabs the grape, then violently spits it out, smashing a lamp. She throws her blanket over the opening, but it is quickly sucked inside. The creature then shakes her bed violently, throwing it from side to side and trapping her. Suddenly, it stops and retreats. Aurora wakes up the next morning believing it was all a nightmare until she notices the broken lamp. Later, Aurora goes to church. As people pass around the donation plate, she waits until it reaches her. Then, she grabs it and runs back toward her apartment. An hour later, the neighbor checks his mailbox and finds several letters. One of them is signed by someone named A. He returns to his apartment and reads the letter. Learning that the writer is trying to hire him as a hitman, he pulls out a stack of cash and begins counting it. A knock interrupts him. When he opens the door, he finds the girl from the opposite apartment standing there. She asks if the money is enough. He goes back inside and resumes counting the cash. He asks for her name. Aurora, she replies, then asks for his name in return. He refuses to answer. After counting the cash, he says it amounts to roughly $300 and asks where she got the money. Aurora replies that she stole it from the church and asks if it is enough to kill the monster. Confused, the neighbor asks how she knows he kills monsters. Aurora explains that she saw him slay the dragon in Chinatown. He asks her to explain further, and she describes watching him slit the dragon's belly. The neighbor dismisses her story, telling her she imagined it and insisting that monsters do not exist. Aurora, however, firmly disagrees. He then asks Aurora if she told her parents that he kills monsters. Aurora quietly replies that the monster ate her parents. The neighbor then asks Aurora to show him where the monster is. Aurora leads him to her apartment. Along the way, he asks what she was doing while her parents were being eaten. Aurora replies that she was hiding under her blanket. She takes him into her parents' bedroom. The neighbor looks around and points out that there should be blood if monsters ate her parents, but Aurora explains that the monster doesn't leave anything behind. It eats people whole. As he continues looking around, the neighbor notices a bullet casing on the floor and pockets it. Then, seeing the long claw marks etched across the furniture, the neighbor remains doubtful and asks Aurora how her parents could have died so violently without anyone hearing them. Aurora replies, "It eats everything, including their screams." He suggests that she should go to the police, but Aurora says she doesn't know how to explain her situation to them. With a weary sigh, the neighbor tells her that he never killed any monsters or anyone. He asks why a monster would want to kill her family in the first place. Because they walked on the floor, Aurora answers calmly. The neighbor tells her that the monsters he knows do not kill people simply for walking on the floor. He then tells Aurora that she should leave. Later, the neighbor meets with his handler, Leverne, who manages his work as a professional hitman for hire. He shows her a photo of Aurora's parents and asks if she recognizes them. He explains that they were his neighbors and that they were professionally disappeared. Not a single drop of blood left behind. He adds that their daughter thinks they were eaten by a monster. Leverne raises an eyebrow and asks, "So, you're looking for a monster?" The neighbor replies that the monster was actually looking for him and broke into the wrong apartment. When Aurora's parents saw it, they were killed. Since the girl didn't see its face, the monster let her live. Leverne says she'll look into it, but admits she's more concerned that the girl has seen his face. The neighbor firmly responds that he will not kill the little girl. She's already in danger because of him. Leverne simply nods. Nightfalls. The neighbor hears the elevator ding and immediately realizes what is happening. He breaks into Aurora's apartment, warning her that the monster is coming and tells her to hide inside the closet. He then waits for the assassins Leverne has sent to kill the girl. Though he drops his knife, he manages to fight one of the assassins. After a brutal struggle, he takes the attacker down, but loses consciousness in the process. Meanwhile, Aurora hears her bedroom window creek open. Another assassin fires at the bed, then spots her hiding in the closet. Aurora braces herself for death. Then she hears a deep growl and the sounds of the monster devouring the assassin. Eventually, the neighbor regains consciousness and rushes to Aurora's bedroom. He asks if she is all right. She nods. He then asks if anyone else was in her room. She nods again. The neighbor assumes the second assassin must have escaped through the fire escape, but Aurora simply tells him that she was eaten by the monster. Confused, the neighbor asks where the monster is now since he's standing on the floor and it hasn't killed him. Aurora whispers, "It's eating now." The neighbor checks the hallway outside and then looks under Aurora's bed. Finding no sign of the creature, he pulls suitcases from the closet and drags the dead body into the bathroom. As he prepares to dismember it, Aurora startles him by asking what he is doing. He explains that he is draining the body's fluids so that cutting it into pieces will be less messy. She asks why he needs to do that. He replies that he has to get rid of the body. Aurora suggests leaving it in her room so the monster can take care of it, but the neighbor shakes his head. When she asks if she can watch, he firmly says no. When he is done, he asks Aurora if she wants to help wrap the pieces. She agrees. Curious, Aurora asks who the dead man was. The neighbor tells her that he was a killer. She asks if the killer came to kill the monster, but the neighbor, having had enough, bluntly tells her that her parents were killed, not eaten by a monster. Aurora then asks the neighbor if someone cut her parents into pieces as well. He shakes his head and explains that there was no monster in Chinatown. Those were men. He tells her that a monster didn't kill her parents. They were killed by men who were trying to kill him. Aurora tells him to stop making up stories to make her feel better, insisting that her parents were eaten by a monster. Suddenly, there is a knock at the door. The neighbor opens it to find a woman who introduces herself as Brenda from child care services. She says they have an appointment. The neighbor replies that it is not a good time and comments on how difficult parenting can be. Brenda nods and adds that it is especially hard when you are a foster parent. Regaining his composure, the neighbor improvises and says, "Yes, we are the first family to come into her life since what happened." Brenda corrects him. "You are the third family." Unsure how to respond, the neighbor coughs, says he is feeling unwell, and promises to reschedule. Once she leaves, the neighbor realizes the woman is clearly not a social worker. At the same time, Brenda tells her partner that the man is definitely not Aurora's foster father. The neighbor asks Aurora if this really was her third family. She nods, explaining that the monster ate all her previous families. He asks where the monster came from. I wished for it, Aurora says. On a shooting star, just like I wished for you to kill it. Curious, the neighbor asks her why she would wish for her parents to be eaten by a monster. Aurora explains that her birth parents were not kind to her, though she later regretted wishing them gone. The neighbor asks if all of her parents were unkind. Aurora replies, "Some of them were confused." He asks why the monster would eat the nice ones. Aurora explains that the monster is trying to eat her because she is wicked and does not deserve a family. The neighbor gently reassures her. He tells her he has seen truly wicked people and she is not one of them. He then asks where the monster is now. Aurora looks around and explains that the monster sleeps under her bed during the day and only comes out at night. She begs him to help her. When he asks if she ever wished for the monster to go away, Aurora says she did, but it didn't work. The neighbor then asks where she would go if the monster were killed and whether anyone would miss her if she disappeared. Aurora answers no, explaining that everyone who might have cared for her was eaten. She then asks him whether anyone would miss him if he were gone. The neighbor remains silent. Aurora softly adds that she would miss him. That evening, the neighbor meets Leverne at a restaurant carrying two suitcases. He explains that one contains the body of an assassin and the other holds the little girl. Leverne assumes that the assassin killed the girl and that the neighbor killed the assassin. The neighbor nods. Leverne tells him she sent two assassins, but the neighbor replies that he only encountered one who tried to attack him. Leverne insists she did not send them to kill him and asks if he did anything to provoke them. He admits he may have thrown a first punch. Leverne nods, saying she was only trying to help him by eliminating the witness. He thanks her. Leverne then reveals that she looked into Aurora's parents and discovered they were foster parents, something the neighbor already knew. He asks about Aurora's biological parents. Leverne explains that they abandoned her when she was young and urges him to see the pattern, suggesting that Aurora herself is the monster. She also warns him to be careful since the men he took down in Chinatown were part of a Chinese syndicate and now they want revenge. At that moment, Aurora approaches the neighbor. He scolds her for leaving the apartment. Aurora tells him she didn't think he was going to come back. Leverne invites Aurora to sit beside her, but Aurora chooses to sit next to the neighbor instead. She asks him, "You were going to leave me, weren't you?" He replies that he never promised to stay. Aurora points out that she hired him and he took her money. Leverne cuts in sharply, telling Aurora that in some cultures, children are not considered people and ordering her to be quiet. Then she tells the neighbor that it's probably his unresolved childhood trauma causing him to play savior to this little girl. Leverne looks at Aurora and asks what she meant by hiring him. The neighbor steps in, explaining that Aurora hired him to kill the monster under her bed and that her biological parents were eaten by it as well. Leverne dismisses the story as nonsense. Aurora insists that the girl who crawled in through her window was eaten, too. The neighbor clarifies that it was the second assassin. Leverne warns Aurora that if she wants to live, she should leave this place immediately or she will be killed. Later, the neighbor takes Aurora to a restaurant in Chinatown. From a distance, a man watches them closely. Aurora asks the neighbor to be her father. He refuses, pointing out that none of her previous fathers are alive. He tells her that they don't truly know each other and that what she thinks she wants from him isn't real. It's simply what her mind is convincing her to believe. He explains that he once believed his mother was beautiful even though she wasn't. That was just what his mind chose to see. Just then, the man who has been watching them approaches their table. He asks the neighbor if the girl is his daughter. The neighbor answers no. At the same moment, Aurora says yes. The man calmly warns the neighbor that even if she has a daughter, it will not change what is about to happen. They leave the restaurant, but the man and his henchmen follow closely behind. Later, Brenda visits Aurora's apartment at the neighbor's request. He apologizes for refusing her appointment earlier that morning. Aurora immediately warns Brenda not to touch the floor, but the neighbor tells Brenda to ignore her, explaining that Aurora believes a monster ate her entire family. He then closes the door. Aurora retreats to her bedroom and crawls beneath the special blanket the neighbor made for her. Meanwhile, the neighbor warns Brenda that they are all going to die. He explains that Aurora's family didn't simply disappear without a trace. He admits that he is actually Aurora's neighbor, not her guardian, as he had claimed. He says he lied because he panicked when Brenda rang the doorbell after Aurora told him about a monster eating her parents. He tells Brenda that Aurora truly believes there is a monster, but he doesn't think she's lying. He believes she may be delusional. He urges Brenda to call someone for help, warning her that the monster Aurora described has followed her home. Brenda contacts her associate and tells him to get the team inside. The doorbell rings. The neighbor opens the door to find Leverne standing there. She scolds him and tells him to leave, pointing out that half a dozen men downstairs are waiting to kill him. He calmly tells her not to worry, revealing that the FBI is inside the apartment calling in reinforcements and that he is simply a concerned neighbor from 5B. Leverne laughs at him. He insists that he has carefully planned this, framing the Chinese crime syndicate as suspects in the murders of Aurora's families so he can finally escape them. Leverne argues that the little girl still has to die. He gently kisses her hand and returns to the apartment. He tells Brenda that the visitor was just a worried neighbor. Brenda then admits she is with the FBI and has been investigating the disappearance of Aurora's families for some time. The neighbor pretends to be surprised. Brenda then explains that one strange clue was found at Aurora's birth parents' home. An open bottle of thumb sucking deterrent on her nightstand. Someone had been applying it to Aurora's fingers before they vanished along with the applicator brush. The brush was later found under the floorboard beneath Aurora's bed. The neighbors suggest that perhaps the monster spit the brush out since it was a deterrent after all. Suddenly, they hear gunshots. They rush into Aurora's room where she screams at them to get off the floor. They obey immediately. The neighbor tells her to stay in her room. They move toward the front door as armed members of the Chinese gang burst in, firing wildly. Brenda is hit and collapses. The neighbor drags her to safety. He realizes that Brenda's gun has run out of bullets, so he searches her for a spare magazine and is shocked to discover that she is still alive. Outside, the men push further into the apartment. In the bathroom, the neighbor hears a deep growl beneath the floor. He steps off the floor and urgently tells Brenda to do the same. As the gang members approach Aurora's bedroom, they are confronted by the monster itself. The men open fire in panic. Amid the chaos, the neighbor rummages through a drawer and finds the thumb sucking deterrent, quickly pocketing it. Moments later, one of the attackers is violently thrown into the bathroom. Brenda finishes him off. The remaining men, now fully aware of the monster, try to avoid touching the floor by clinging to the walls. Despite this, one of them drops his weapon and tries to retrieve it, only to be instantly dragged beneath the floor and eaten. Back in the bathroom, the neighbor and Brenda shove the dead body out into the hallway where it is immediately consumed by the monster. At that moment, FBI agents storm the apartment and order everyone to get down on the floor. The survivors desperately explain that they can't, but the agents refuse to listen. As the FBI moves toward the bathroom, Brenda identifies the neighbor as the concerned neighbor. Minutes later, the agents step back into the hallway. Brenda urgently warns them to get off the floor, insisting that something is inside it. Then one by one, they are all devoured. Amid the chaos, the neighbor manages to survive and calls out to Aurora, telling her to get ready because they are going to escape through the fire escape. But before he can reach her bed, the monster pulls him under the floor. The next morning, Aurora wakes up to find the neighbor crawling back out of the floorboards, saved by the thumb sucking deterrent. At that moment, Leverne enters the apartment, intending to kill Aurora. The neighbor urgently tells her, "Mom, get off the floor." Leverne snaps at him, furious, telling him not to call her that. Moments later, she too is dragged under and eaten by the monster. The neighbor and Aurora prepare to leave, but the monster blocks their path. It becomes clear that the creature never truly wanted to eat Aurora. The neighbor realizes the truth and tells her that the monster belongs to her. She wished for it and now she must live with it. Aurora nods in understanding. Together they leave the apartment, the monster following silently behind them, lingering in the shadows.

text: "Choose life, choose a job, choose a career." These words are burned into pop culture history. But what if I told you that Trainspotting isn't actually about drugs at all? That beneath its gritty surface lies one of cinema's most sophisticated coming-of-age stories. Let me explain, because we're about to decode the hidden meaning that most viewers missed in Danny Boyle's film. The year is 1996. Danny Boyle releases a film that shocks audiences with its raw portrayal of Edinburgh's drug scene. But here's the thing: while everyone was focusing on the heroin, they missed the real story hiding in plain sight. Let's start with that mysterious title. "Trainspotting" isn't just a random word. In Britain, it refers to hobbyists who obsessively track passing trains. Does that sound familiar? Just like our characters, trapped in their own obsessive behavior, watching life pass them by. But here's where it gets interesting: Strip away the shock value and what you're left with is a classic coming-of-age story. Think of "Catcher in the Rye" but with a Scottish accent and better music. Through Ewan McGregor's Mark Renton, we witness something universal: The struggle of growing up in a world where both rebellion and conformity feel equally toxic. His journey from addict to adult isn't just about kicking heroin - it's about finding his own path in life. The genius of Boyle's direction shows in the details. Early in the film, we see a hollowed Renton staring into a mirror. By the end, we see a transformed man. But Boyle doesn't let us off easy. The film weaves in three devastating moments that ground its stylish energy. First, Baby Dawn's death. Second, Tommy's tragic descent. And third, Renton's nightmarish withdrawal. These aren't just shock tactics - they're crucial reminders of what's really at stake. Now about that ending: when Renton betrays his friends and takes off with the money, something unexpected happens - we actually cheer him on. Why? Because we've watched these toxic friendships hold him back. Except for Spud. Notice how Renton leaves money for the only friend who never tried to drag him down. When that famous "Choose Life" speech returns at the end, it hits differently. What starts as bitter mockery becomes something else entirely - a genuine manifesto for living. But here's the real revelation: the film is telling us that true maturity isn't about blindly rejecting society or mindlessly conforming to it. It's about finding your own path while accepting the responsibilities that come with it. Trainspotting transcended its modest budget to become a defining film of the 1990s. But more than that, it captured something timeless: the universal struggle of figuring out who you want to be in a world that's trying to decide for you. So next time someone tells you Trainspotting is just a movie about drugs, you can tell them they've missed the point entirely. text: The film opens with the Wang family happily singing karaoke in a mirror until they disappear. Cut ahead to the present day inside the hectic home of the Wang family. Evelyn and her husband Waymond are putting together documents for an audit, preparing a big birthday party for Evelyn’s formerly estranged father Gong Gong (who temporarily disowned Evelyn for marrying Waymond and moving to the US), and running a struggling laundromat they own. Evelyn is too busy to talk to Waymond (who has secretly drafted up divorce papers) and angrily rips googly eyes off wherever she finds them stuck to places in the laundromat (put there by her family as a joke that Evelyn doesn’t appreciate). Their rebellious daughter Joy arrives with her girlfriend Becky. Evelyn and Joy have a strained relationship and they argue about Joy’s tattoos and whether she should come out to Gong Gong as he is elderly and curmudgeonly. Joy thinks her mom is using Gong Gong as an excuse and that Evelyn herself is really uncomfortable with her daughter’s sexuality. Gong Gong walks into the room where Evelyn introduces Becky as Joy’s “very good friend.” Gong Gong critiques Joy for her lack of Chinese language skills, and Evelyn tells Joy she’s getting too fat (Becky says Evelyn’s critiques are her way of expressing love). Everyone is too busy to notice Waymond seemingly being possessed and performing martial arts for a brief few minutes. Waymond, Evelyn, and Gong Gong go to the IRS offices the next day to meet with their auditor. While in the elevator on the way to the appointment, Waymond is again possessed. He explains that he is a Waymond from another universe or lets call him as alt-Waymond, who has inhabited her husband on this Earth, and says the multiverse is in danger. He writes a note to her with instructions to read when out of the elevator, before leaving Waymond’s body. Title Card: PART 1 – EVERYTHING The family meets with their auditor, a woman named Deirdre. Deirdre says that the family’s actions could be construed as fraud. As the meeting continues, Evelyn reads the note written by alt-Waymond. It tells her to switch her shoes, put in an earpiece and then imagine teleporting to a janitor’s closet. She does so and ends up in another one of her bodies in another universe, along with the alt-Waymond. The connection is tenuous as Evelyn keeps cutting between her conversation with Deirdre (who is threatening to repossess their laundromat) and alt-Waymond. Alt-Waymond explains he’s from a universe called the “Alphaverse.” There, they were able to master multiversal teleportation using a mapping program that tracks branch universes. In addition to teleporting into the body of an alt-universe version of themselves, they can also learn the skills and knowledge of any alt-universe person they inhabit. In order to teleport, the traveller must do something out of the ordinary (thus, why Evelyn had to switch her shoes) to harmonize themselves with an alt-universe bodies. He says an evil multidimensional traveler named Jobu Tupaki intends to bring chaos to the multiverse, and that Evelyn is the only one with enough innate goodness to stop Jobu. He notes that Jobu has been going through the multiverse killing versions of Evelyn, but thinks this Evelyn is the chosen one. At that moment, an alternate version of Deirdre appears and murders the bodies alt-Waymond and Evelyn are inhabiting – sending them both back to their original bodies. Evelyn awakens to Deirdre agreeing to give them until that night to provide more documentation for their audit. Evelyn, still shocked by her experience in the alternate realm, punches Dierdre (and she also finds the divorce papers Waymond had drawn up). Deirdre calls security, forcing alt-Waymond to inhabit Waymond’s body and beat them up with his martial arts skills. This activity draws Jobu’s notice. It’s revealed that Jobu is none other than Joy from the Alphaverse. Alt- Waymond explains that in the Alphaverse, Evelyn pushed Joy too far in exploring the multiverse to the point where she is able to travel the multiverse at will, experience all realities simultaneously, and alter reality. The criticism and multiversal awareness drove Joy mad, leaving her with the belief that nothing is important given the infinite possibilities out there and the brevity of life. She developed a weapon that alt-Waymond believes will destroy the universe. He hopes Evelyn can stop this. Alt-Deirdre inhabits Deirdre’s body (with sumo wrestler abilities) and attacks. Alt-Waymond instructs Evelyn how to tap into a universe where she is a martial arts master (by declaring her genuine love for Deirdre). Evelyn is unable to do this so alt-Waymond abandons her thinking he made a mistake that she was the chosen one. However, Evelyn is eventually able to travel and tap into her martial arts alternate’s skills. With her fighting prowess, Evelyn defeats alt-Deirdre, but is then arrested along with Waymond. However, the police are attacked by Jobu (now inhabiting Joy) and killed in gruesomely cartoonish ways (i.e., exploding into confetti). A terrified Evelyn tries to tap into a power to fight Jobu, but in her panic accesses the skills from a world where everyone there evolved to have hot dog fingers. They are only saved when Jobu takes a special interest in this Evelyn, sharing some of her experiences with her and showing Evelyn a glimpse of her endgame. Suddenly, Alphaverse’s Gong Gong (in Gong Gong’s body) ambushes Jobu. Jobu decides to journey to the Alphaverse to confront them there. Alt-Waymond returns to Waymond’s body (realizing he was right about Evelyn) and argues with alt-Gong Gong about what they should do. Alt-Gong Gong wants to have Joy killed while Jobu is distracted because that will block Jobu’s ability to enter this universe (and he’s done this in other universes). Alt-Waymond opposes this, believing Evelyn can save everyone. Ultimately, Evelyn sides with alt-Waymond and alt-Gong Gong calls in people from the Alphaverse to kill the trio – believing they have all been infected by Jobu (and worried that if Evelyn joins Jobu, Jobu will surely succeed). In order to defeat them, Evelyn ends up drawing experiences from her doubles in various universes where she’s a martial artist, singer, hibachi grill cook (also revealed to be a universe where one of her co-workers has a raccoon called “raccacouille” under his chef’s hat to help him cook in a parody of Ratatouille), a maid, and sign spinner. Combining all these abilities allows her to be a formidable fighter. She defeats alt-Gong Gong’s minions, including in an excellent fight involving butt plugs (small role for Jenny Slate as one of the minions). Meanwhile Jobu kills alt-Waymond in his body. Jobu returns and Evelyn prepares to fight her. But the strain of combining too many alternate skills at once (and spending too much time in bodies of other Evelyns) causes Evelyn to die from the stress. Jobu seems disappointed, and Waymond is devastated… Part 2: Everywhere Evelyn’s consciousness travels across the multiverse, experiencing the various lives she took skills and knowledge from (including in the hot dog finger universe, she is in a romantic relationship with Deirdre and everyone does things with their feet). We also learn in a universe where Evelyn decides not to get involved and just goes home to do her taxes that Waymond doesn’t really want a divorce, but wanted to do something to force Evelyn to discuss their growing apart. Eventually, Evelyn is able to channel her spirit back into her dead body and resurrect herself. She runs back to her home where she confronts Joy and forces Jobu to emerge. Evelyn tries to fight Jobu, but Jobu uses her immense powers to overwhelm Evelyn (transporting her to worlds where they are in prison, where they are pinatas, and even where they are animated). Jobu then brings Evelyn to her base. There, she reveals her device is an “Everything Bagel,” i.e., a bagel-shaped object upon which Joy has affixed everything in the universe. By looking into it, the viewer can experience all reality at once. She forces Evelyn to look and Evelyn begins to believe that nothing in life matters as humans are so insignificant. The pair are only able to take solace in a universe where life never emerged and they are sentient boulders. After coming to agree with Jobu that there is no purpose to life, Evelyn begins destroying her relationships in the various universes she is connected to (even calling animal control on raccacouille). In her home universe, she signs Waymond’s divorce papers, refuses to turn in her taxes causing Deirdre to come with the police to possess the laundromat, and smashes the windows of the laundromat. Jobu explains that by going through the center of the bagel, it will end her existence on all planes (ending the pain she feels due to the pointlessness of the multiverse). She asks Evelyn to come with her and Evelyn agrees. However, before she does so, Evelyn hears Waymond’s voice and teleports to the universe where she is a martial artist and she and Waymond didn’t marry. Waymond explains that he believes Evelyn didn’t marry him because she misconstrued his generosity as weakness. Instead, however, he says that being a loving person is how he finds meaning in the universe. This Waymond notes that he’d rather have lived a good life with Evelyn “running a laundromat” than the successful life alone that he lived. Touched by his words, Evelyn begins to see the good moments in each of her multiversal lives. This is capped by returning to her universe, where she watches Waymond talk Deirdre into reversing her decision to seize their laundromat using kindness. She realizes that he was right – strength and meaning comes from true love. Despite Jobu’s efforts to have Evelyn go through the bagel with her, Evelyn refuses. An irate Jobu teleports the bagel and goons from her homebase to Evelyn’s primary universe where it begins destroying everything. Waymond gets Eleanor, to forego violence and googly eye to herself as a symbol of her promise. Alt-Gong Gong and the Alphaverse forces show up to kill Jobu, Using her powers, Evelyn reads the deepest regrets of the combatants and fixes them, causing each opposing soldier to stop their attack. She also fixes the problems she caused with her other selves throughout the multiverse (i.e., making up with hot dog finger Deirdre, saving raccacouille from animal control). She confronts her father’s abandonment, saying that in trying not to be like him she drove away her own daughter. Her family now united, they all grab onto Jobu to stop her from going through the bagel. Simultaneously, Evelyn in her tax-doing universe apologizes to her daughter. Joy at first rejects her mother’s attempts at atonement. Joy declares that life is too painful and humans are too small in the scheme of things to matter, so why should they try to fix their relationship? Evelyn counters that while all of that is true, it is these small moments of time that matter the most and that no single moment is more important than the fleeting ones they get to spend together. Evelyn and Joy embrace while Jobu is pulled out of the bagel hole and the bagel is deactivated. Jobu is also pacified due to Joy’s resolution with her mom. Title Card: Part 3 All at Once Jumping ahead, the Wong family is dropped off at the IRS building by Becky (who’s now been fully accepted, including by Evelyn and Gong Gong). As they walk inside, Evelyn shares a loving kiss with Waymond, showing that their marriage is now strong. They arrive at Deirdre’s office with their receipts properly ordered and to Deirdre’s praise for doing much better. The film closes as we see that Evelyn is still able to experience the entirety of the multiverse…. all at once. Then, the movie ends.

text: The movie begins in New York City in 1952. Marty, a young man in his early 20s, is working as a salesman in a small shoe store. While going about his routine, a female customer, walks in looking for a pair of shoes that she accidentally left behind after buying a new pair. Marty offers to help her to search for them. As they are leaving the counter, Marty's uncle calls him and hands over a stack of freshly printed business cards with his name on it. He proudly announces that Marty has officially been promoted, making him the manager of the shoe shop. But instead of excitement, Marty shows disinterest and is reluctant to accept this promotion. He leaves, refusing to accept the promotion. Marty and the woman, Rebecca, slip away into the storage area of the store. They share a few intimate and romantic moments together, making out. Later, Marty goes to play a table tennis match. He has difficulty seeing the white ping-pong ball clearly because his opponent is wearing white. Marty confronts his opponent and friend Wall-E and a friendly argument starts. A woman suddenly interrupts the scene saying that he has an urgent phone call from his mother. Marty answers the phone. She tells him she isn't feeling well and asks him to come visit her. Around the same time, Rebecca is on her way home when she notices Marty's mother, Judy, talking to him on the phone. Curious, Rebecca quietly listens in on their conversation through the phone line. Suddenly, her husband arrives, startling Rebecca. She quickly disconnects the phone and lies that she was trying to call Judy, but the line was busy. Later, Marty and his friend Dion pay a visit to Dion's father, who manufactures table tennis balls. They pitch him an idea to produce balls in different colors so players [music] can see them more easily against different backgrounds and clothing. Marty confidently boasts that he has beaten many players who later went on to become world champions. He boldly commits that he plans to become the face of table [music] tennis in America. Later, Marty returns to the shoe shop to collect his salary. One of his co-workers, Lloyd, tells him that his uncle has already left, but Marty needs cash to catch his flight to London for his game. He calls his mother to ask about his uncle, but she says he has left for the trip. Only she can call him if he comes back to the house. Marty angrily cuts the call. As Marty gets ready to leave the premises, he catches Lloyd trying to hide a stack of cash. Furious, Marty pulls out a gun and points it at him, demanding the $700 he owes as his salary. Lloyd isn't afraid when Marty reveals that his uncle made him manager. Despite he is one who works hard. It's not his money. He can tell the cop he robbed him. Lloyd reluctantly gives him the money. With the same money, Marty heads to London to take part in a major international table tennis competition where top players from around the world have gathered. The tournament begins and Marty quickly proves his talent. In the first round, he easily defeats his opponents and moves ahead without much difficulty. His winning streak [music] continues and soon he advances to the third round. During the competition, Marty notices a player from Japan named Cotto Endo. Endo is incredibly skilled and agile, dominating his matches with ease. He uses a unique paddle that gives him a distinct advantage. Marty keeps winning his own matches. Frustrated with his living accommodation, he goes to the international table tennis officials to complain. He needs proper rest if he is expected to perform at his best. The officials, however, pay little attention to him and dismiss his concerns. The next day, while giving an interview, Marty suddenly notices a well-known actress, Kay Stone, standing nearby. The reporters immediately shift their attention to her. Marty is instantly drawn to her and can't stop staring. Later that night, Marty calls Kay from his hotel room. He introduces himself as a big admirer and asks her to look for his name in the newspaper. Boldly, he invites her to his room. Kay politely declines, saying she has to attend a promotional event for her husband's pen company and then hangs up. Marty, however, refuses to give up. He calls her again and challenges her playfully. He tells her to look out the window at the apples displayed in the room across the street. If he can hit the apples with a table tennis ball, she must agree to meet him. He takes the shot and succeeds. The next day, Kay comes to the stadium to watch him play. Sitting in the audience, she sees Marty compete in the semi-final match against Bella [music] Klitsky. Marty wins in two straight sets, showing off his talent and confidence. That evening, Marty goes out to dinner with Bella Kletsky after the match. During dinner, Bella tries to persuade Marty to join his team. He explains that they could travel the world together and compete as partners, but Marty isn't interested and politely declines the offer. While they are eating, Marty notices Kay Stone and her husband, Milton Rockwell. On impulse, Marty tells the waiter that he would like to pay for their bill. He then casually returns to his conversation with Bella, as if nothing happened. Milton notices this [music] and walks over to Marty's table. Confused, he asks why he is offering to pay for their meal when they are complete strangers to each other. Marty quickly makes up an excuse, saying he just wanted to thank Milton for his excellent pens. Milton isn't completely convinced, but lets the matter go. From across the room, Kay quietly watches Marty with curiosity. As Milton is about to leave, he notices a serial number on Bella's forearm. Realizing that Bella was once held in a concentration camp, Milton asks him about it. Bella explains that he survived because of his talent as a table tennis player. Milton says his son died trying to liberate them. Marty, not fully grasping the seriousness of the moment, laughs awkwardly. Milton, offended by his reaction, asks Marty to stop talking and listen carefully to Bella's story. Bella shares his story. He was forced to diffuse bombs outside the camp. One day, while working, he noticed a honeybee and followed it. He smoked away the bees and covered his body with honey. He let his fellow prisoners eat the honey from his body for nourishment. Later, Kay arrives at Marty's hotel suite, and the two of them spend the night together making love. The next day, the championship match begins. Endo immediately takes control of the game, showing his superior skill and technique. Marty struggles to read Endo's unusual serves and quickly falls behind, losing the first five points in a row. Completely unable to figure out Endo strategy, [music] Marty continues to lose ground as the match slips further out of his control. As the match continues, Marty slowly begins to adjust to Endo's playing style. But even after figuring out his technique, he struggles to keep up. Milton Rockwell arrives at the stadium to watch the match and seems visibly pleased to see Marty losing. Finally, the game reaches match point. The entire crowd watches intense silence. Marty serves, but the pressure overwhelms him. He makes a final mistake and loses the match. Angry and humiliated, Marty immediately demands a rematch, but the officials refuse. The result is final. Endo returns to Japan as a national hero. He becomes a massive sensation for defeating the United States champion and quickly turns into the face of table tennis across Asia. With Tokyo set to host the next championship later that year, the Japanese fully expect Marty to return for a rematch. Sometime later, Marty arrives in Paris after receiving a call from Milton Rockwell. Milton has a business proposal for him. He wants to promote his pen company in Asia by taking advantage of the growing table tennis craze. He offers Marty the chance to play a match against Endo before the championship even begins. However, there is a catch. Milton wants Marty to play well enough to entertain the crowd, but ultimately lose [music] on purpose to please the Japanese audience and boost sales. Marty is outraged by the idea and refuses outright. He asks him if he really want to impress Japanese for profit since his son died fighting against them. Milton takes offense at him and the meeting ends. With no better options, Marty continues traveling with Bella. Together, they perform trick shots and comedy routines during halftime shows at basketball games. His uncle gives Marty an ultimatum. Either he comes back to the shoe shop and becomes the manager or he goes to jail. Marty tries to argue and reason with him, but his uncle refuses to listen. He even opens Marty's luggage and takes all the money inside. Just as the officer prepares to take him away, Marty reluctantly agrees to his uncle's terms. He goes back to his room defeated. His uncle hands some cash to the officer and thanks him. Marty escapes through the fire escape. The officer enters the room and sees him fleeing. He warns the officer downstairs, but Marty runs through the busy streets [music] and manages to get away. While running, Iris spots him. Marty quickly hides in Rebecca's shop and calls his friend Wall-E for help. While waiting, he notices something surprising. Rebecca appears [music] to be pregnant. Rebecca enters the room and confirms his suspicion. The baby is his and she tried to reach him for a long time. Overwhelmed, she begins to cry. Marty moves closer to comfort her, but at that moment, Ira walks in and catches them together. A heated confrontation breaks out. Ira storms off to call the police. Marty quickly escapes through the back of the shop, hiding in a nearby trash bin. Police officers inquiries a group of Asian men who don't speak English, so Marty manages to escape. Later, Marty meets Wally at a hotel and gets a room. The receptionist tells him they can't use the shower in the room. A strange man with a foul smelling dog also enters the lobby. Up in the room, Marty prepares to take a shower while Wall-Ally sorts through Marty's mail and finds a notice from the International Table Tennis Federation. They have find Marty $1,500. As Marty leans over to see the letter, the floor suddenly collapses beneath them and land on the man with the dog below. Marty rushes to help them, then storms over to the receptionist, demanding a refund for the unsafe room. The receptionist refuses. The injured man with the dog makes Marty an unexpected offer. He asks Marty to look after the dog for two weeks and promises to pay him triple the normal rate. He even tells Marty to open his bag and take some money in advance. With little choice, Marty agrees to the deal [music] and takes responsibility for the dog. Marty and Wall-E visit a local table tennis hall where players gamble money on individual points. To sap a plan, Wally pretends to have a bruised face and tells everyone a fake story about being robbed, claiming he managed to take some money back from the thief. He even puts on a show of kindness by giving a few dollars to a player who doesn't have enough to join a match. Meanwhile, Marty begins playing against Brody, the best player among all the gamblers. They agree to bet money on the game, but Brody cheats his way to victory, and Marty ends up losing cash. The other players grow irritated with Marty's constant complaining [music] and attitude. To change the situation, Wall-Ally steps forward and challenges Marty with just a $5 bill. A curious crowd quickly gathers around them. Brody arrives and watches as Wall-Ally pretends to lose all his money to Marty. Feeling sorry for Wall-E, the crowd asks Marty to let him keep $5 so he can afford a bus ticket [music] back home. Marty coldly refuses. Seeing this, Brody challenges Marty once again. Marty, seizing the opportunity, raises the stakes to $40. The crowd pools together the money to support Brody, confident he will win. Marty and Wall-E leave the hall with $200 in winnings, laughing and thrilled with their success. In desperation, Marty grabs a gasoline nozzle and sprays fuel on the attackers. He jumps into the car and speeds away in panic, accidentally leaving the dog behind. Moments later, a huge explosion rocks the gas station. Marty assumes the dog has been killed in the blast. Shaken and angry, Marty returns to his old neighborhood and sees Rebecca again. He notices that her face is bruised, clearly showing that Ira has hit her. Furious, Marty sneaks into his home, grabs a weapon, and confronts Ira. After attacking him, Marty takes [music] Rebecca away to safety. He brings her to Dion's place and asks if she can stay there for a while, lying that Rebecca is his sister to avoid questions. Dion agrees to let Marty and Rebecca stay at his place since his father is away. While they are there, Dion excitedly shows Marty a newly designed table tennis ball that carries Marty's name on it. Marty is surprised by how high quality it feels and realizes how serious Dion's father has been about the idea. The next day, Marty calls Milton Rockwell's secretary. text: On the planet Krypton, Jor-El, a member of the Kryptonian high council, sentences criminals General Zod, Ursa, and Non to the Phantom Zone. He warns the council that Krypton will be destroyed by its exploding red supergiant sun, but they dismiss his concerns. Before the planet's destruction, Jor-El and his wife Lara send their infant son Kal-El to Earth, where his unique physiology grants him evolving superhuman abilities. Kal-El's spaceship touches down near Smallville, Kansas. Found by Jonathan and Martha Kent, who are astonished when the infant lifts their truck, they adopt him, naming him Clark. As he grows, hiding his powers, Jonathan believes Clark was sent to Earth for a special purpose. Soon after Jonathan's fatal heart attack, a glowing green crystal from his spaceship that is hidden in the barn calls to Clark. This leads him to the Arctic, where a Fortress of Solitude, echoing Krypton's architecture, ascends from the ice. Inside, Jor-El's hologram reveals Clark's heritage and trains him for twelve years. Emerging in a blue-and-red suit bearing the crest of the House of El, he is cautioned against changing human history. Clark is hired as a reporter for the Daily Planet in Metropolis. He is drawn to Lois Lane. After saving her from a helicopter accident, Clark secretly uses his powers in public acts of heroism, gaining immediate fame as the "caped wonder". Perry White, the Daily Planet's chief, seeks more information on this new hero. In costume, Clark later visits Lois, taking her on a flight, leading her to coin his name, "Superman". Criminal mastermind Lex Luthor discovers a joint U.S. Army/U.S. Navy missile test and plots to target the San Andreas Fault with reprogrammed missiles, though one is misdirected by his bumbling assistant, Otis. Suspecting Superman's interference, Lex identifies a Kryptonian meteorite, lethal to Superman. With Otis and his girlfriend Eve Teschmacher, Lex retrieves it and traps Superman in his lair, revealing his plan to sink the western U.S., making his desert land prime coastline. He weakens Superman using the meteor, now known as Kryptonite, and informs him of the misdirected missile set for Hackensack, New Jersey. Concerned for her mother in Hackensack, Teschmacher frees Superman, urging him to first stop the eastbound missile. He sends it to space but misses the westbound missile, which triggers severe earthquakes in California, endangering landmarks like the Golden Gate Bridge and Hoover Dam. Superman counteracts the devastation by mending the fault line. As Superman rescues others, Lois is trapped in her car by an aftershock, suffocating before he can save her. Distraught and enraged over his failure to save Lois, Superman disregards Jor-El's warning against altering history. Heeding Jonathan's belief in his purpose, he flies around Earth, reversing time to prevent Lois's death and the missile's destruction. After saving the West Coast, he imprisons Luthor and Otis, then soars into the sunrise.
